jobs.description:
JOB POSTING

OFFICER, CLASSIFICATION

About the Canadian Paralympic Committee

The Canadian Paralympic Committee is a private, non-profit organization that works in partnership with 28-member sport organizations to advance the Paralympic movement in Canada and support high-performance athletes with disabilities.

Through the stories, achievements, and leadership of Paralympians, the Canadian Paralympic Committee aim to inspire Canadians to embrace accessibility, challenge perceptions, and create greater opportunities for participation in sport and in society.

Job Summary

The Classification Officer plays a vital role in strengthening the Paralympic System in Canada. Their main objective is to provide classification expertise, guidance, and education to National Sport Organizations (NSO), athletes, and other partners in the Canadian sport system. They will also link closely with teams within the CPC to provide support on any classification-related topics.

The ideal candidate will have experience as a classifier and a clear understanding of classification and the associated codes, policies, and processes. Experience as a Para athlete or Paralympian is considered an asset for this position.

Type: Full-Time

Salary: $60,000-$68,000 annually based on experience plus benefits

Reports To: Senior Manager, Paralympic System and Services

Location: Remote within Canada, with travel to Ottawa and other locations

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Supports the implementation of programming that aligns with the CPC’s strategic priorities.
  • Provides guidance, support, and education to enhance the capacity and capability of athletes, stakeholders, members and performance partners in topics related to classification.
  • Supports the development of training and resources to address classification gaps identified through surveys and specific strategies such as the Paralympic Summer Sport System Strategy.
  • Works closely with NSOs to ensure that athletes have the required classifications completed, guides them through the process, and supports them with any issues that arise.
  • Works with the Paralympic performance team, Performance Sciences, Research and Innovation (PSRI) Advisor, Athlete Services team and performance partners (Own The Podium, Sport Canada, Coaching Association of Canada, etc.) to identify gaps related to classification and collaborate in finding evidence-based solutions.
  • Liaises with Athlete Services team to ensure classification services and programming provide an athlete-centric approach while driving best-prepared teams.
  • Contributes to and implements multi-year classification plans, targets, and budgets.
  • Develops rapport, establishes partnerships, and manages relationships with international stakeholders including, but not limited to, International Federations, National Paralympic Committees, officials and volunteers, advisory groups, and IPC departments.

National Priorities

  • Lead Canada’s compliance with the IPC Classification Code
  • Lead Canada’s involvement in any future reviews of the IPC Athlete Classification Code and related documents
  • Lead CPC’s National classification strategy, update where required and prioritize the implementation of recommendations. Examples of priority areas include:
    • Support development of a classification medical expert network to support NSOs and staff on classification needs
    • Support development and implementation of a Visual Impairment (VI) Classification plan for a centrally managed VI Classification system
    • Work with and support NSOs to provide tools and resources to develop national sport-specific strategies that are aligned with International Federations (IFs) and the International Paralympic Committee (IPC)
    • Support the development, refinement, and continuous improvement of Paralympic system classification tools
    • Develop a classification webpage and education materials to support different audiences

International Priorities

  • Engage with IPC and IFs to support classification protocols and processes when appropriate
  • Engage with IPC and other NPCs to support the review and implementation of the Classification Code
  • Work with NSOs and their IFs to host international classifier training in Canada as required
  • Work with NSOs and IFs to support athletes’ classification internationally as required
  • Maintain effective relationships with other NPCs to share best practices, identify opportunities for collaboration, and identify priority areas aligned with international opportunities.

At Games Priorities

  • Coordinate and support the planning and delivery of a Games-specific classification strategy aligned with the NSOs’ plans
  • Provide input and advice on classification management at Games when classification is offered, in addition to providing support for emerging issues

Qualifications

Education

  • Post-secondary education, preferably in kinesiology or sport management, or equivalent experience in a similar position with a sport organization or as an athlete or a coach.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience working in a leadership capacity in sport in Canada.
  • Experience working in a National Sport Organization.
  • Experience working in multi-sport Games environments.
  • Experience as a Paralympian is considered an asset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong sport technical knowledge including an understanding of the Canadian Sport system, the International Olympic and Paralympic Sport System, and the roles, responsibilities, and pressures of athletes, coaches, and NSOs.
  • Strong understanding of classification
  • Strong understanding of the IPC, other National Paralympic Committees, and other countries’ sport systems.
  • Strong understanding of the Games environment to best prepare team members to perform during the Paralympic Games and Parapan Am Games.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex environments and solve problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, coordinate, deliver, and review targeted initiatives as well as adapt to a changing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage relationships and work effectively and collaboratively with both internal and external colleagues.
  • Proficiency with office applications such as email, project planning, databases, word processing, spreadsheets, presentation development, etc.
  • Ability to communicate in Canada’s two official languages is considered a strong asset.

Personal Characteristics

  • Methodical and organized, able to manage different projects at the same time
  • Ability to adapt to a variety of situations, people, environments, and diverse stakeholders
  • Self-directed and disciplined
  • Innovative
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Analytical
  • Results-oriented
  • Team player
  • Cooperative and collaborative
  • Detail-oriented with a thorough approach to problem-solving and work processes

Working Conditions

· The CPC will consider applicants from across Canada who are interested in taking on this position remotely. The CPC Head Office is located in Ottawa, ON.

· This position requires overnight travel to sites within Canada (e.g., Games, events, partner meetings, etc.).

· Staff based outside Ottawa will be expected to travel to Ottawa a few times a year or as the job demands.

· Staff will be required to work evenings and weekends during busy periods, including during Games time and other special events.

Application Process:

If you share our passion for sport and are committed to the CPC values, please submit a cover letter and your résumé.

Please apply through BambooHR using the following link:

Application deadline: October 14th, 2026, at 5 PM EST

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

CPC conducts all recruitment and selection activities in-house and does not utilize external recruitment agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters as part of its hiring process. All communications regarding employment opportunities and hiring decisions will come directly from authorized CPC employees. We encourage candidates to exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of any employment-related communications.

CPC is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, record of offences, age, marital status, family status, or disability. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented or marginalized groups to apply.

CPC welcomes and encourages applications from First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, women, and/or 2SLGBTQ+ individuals. Accommodation is available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Job Description:

At Cable One and our family of brands, we keep our customers and associates connected to what matters most. For our associates, that means: a thriving and rewarding career, respect for the communities where they live and work, a focus on health and wellness, an excellent work/life balance, and an open and inclusive workplace.  

We’re looking to add to our already amazing team of associates. If you’d like to join an organization that is dedicated to customer and associate satisfaction, check out this exciting sales opportunity.

Cable One’s Retention Business Account Representatives are responsible for developing, renewing contracts, and maintaining a base of existing business customers who subscribe to our voice and broadband services. As a Representative, you will speak to small and medium-sized companies who call in to disconnect their services. Your goal will be to show them the value that Cable One can bring to their company by showing them services that may better fit their needs or troubleshoot to resolve their current concerns.

What you will do to contribute to the company's success 

  • Use a variety of problem-solving techniques to retain customers who call to reduce or cancel their services. 

  • Connect with our current customers and help them renew their contracts. 

  • Follow up with subscribers to answer their questions or confirm if we can help answer their questions. 

  • Identify reasons for customer dissatisfaction with product and provide prompt resolution in order to retain the customer.

  • Up-sells Sparklight products that include digital, HSD, and phone to existing business customers.

  • Team up with other departments here at Sparklight to help answer customer questions or resolve their concerns. 

  • This position has the expectation and responsibility to take on other duties needed to help drive our Purpose, fulfill our Brand Principles, and abide by our Organization's Values.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Associate’s degree (A.A.) preferred.

  • We prefer for you to have experience in telecommunications, but we are happy to teach you! 

  • Prior sales experience preferred.

  • Requires the ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Must be detailed oriented and self-starter.

  • You will be working with customers who may be frustrated, we are looking for candidates who can keep calm and be patient in all situations. 

  • Confidence to be persistent and professionally sell our services after a customer declines on an offer. 

  • Problem-solving is key! Sometimes you will need to look for creative routes to get the customer to say 'yes' to a sale!

Core Competencies  

  • Committed: Values each and every customer, while working hard to keep their business and support our communities.  

  • Helpful: Delivers support in the ways that are most useful to our customers and addresses their needs with expertise, respect, and empathy.  

  • Proactive: Understand what our customers need, and actively works to make their relationship with use seamless, easy, and rewarding.  

  • Personal: Knows our customers well, and tailors our communications and interactions to address their needs and expectations.  

​

Benefits 

Cable One and our family of brands appreciates the role our associates play to help the company grow, and in return an excellent benefits package is offered to our associates to recognize the importance of their contributions, such as:  

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans – start when you start!  

  • Life insurance (self, spouse, children) 

  • Paid time off (vacation, holiday, and personal/sick days)  

  • 401(k) - 100% company match (match program starts after 1 year of service, up to 5% of eligible compensation) 

  • Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection 

Additional Perks  

  • Tuition reimbursement (up to $5,250 on 1st year)  

  • Up to seventy-five dollars a month towards cable and internet services  

  • Annual community support to various organizations across the U.S.  

  • Associate recognition & awards programs 

  • Advancement opportunities  

  • Collaborative work environment  

Our Commitment 

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to ensure our continued success. Here at Cable One and our family of brands, we believe it is our individual and unique talents, backgrounds and perspectives that, when combined, truly make us an unstoppable force. "Stronger Together" is not just a verbal cue, it is the motto that our associates live by, exemplify, and embody each and every day.  

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability. 

 

Pre-hire Processes 

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background, drug screening, and reference check. Only after successfully passing these pre-hire clearances are individuals approved for hire and ready to start their successful and rewarding career.

About Delfina

Every pregnancy deserves to be seen, supported, and safe. Delfina is a maternal health technology company using AI-powered platform to support pregnant and postpartum patients. We partner with health plans, community health centers, health systems, and public sector agencies to close gaps in care before they become emergencies.

Our model is built on outcomes: we increasingly work through value-based arrangements with Medicaid and commercial health plans. That makes financial rigor central to our mission, not separate from it.

The role

We're looking for a Fractional CFO to own Delfina's financial strategy as we scale and prepare for our next phase of growth. You'll be a hands-on partner to our CEO, a trusted voice with our board and investors, and the person who translates our impact into a durable financial model.

This is a great fit for a finance leader who has done this before at an early-stage digital health company and wants their next chapter to matter for families.

What you'll do

  • Lead fundraising and investor relations: build the financial model, data room, and diligence responses; partner with the CEO on pitch and investor conversations
  • Own planning and reporting: annual budget, rolling forecasts, cash runway, and monthly board-ready reporting
  • Build the finance function: oversee accounting, close, audit readiness, tax, and outside providers (bookkeeping, payroll, legal)
  • Strengthen unit economics: cost-to-serve, gross margin, and contract profitability by partner and program
  • Manage risk and compliance: controls, grant and public-contract financial requirements, insurance, and vendor contracts
  • Shape payer contract economics: model pricing, value-based/risk arrangements with health plans and public partners
  • Advise the leadership team: bring financial clarity to hiring, pricing, and market expansion decisions

What you bring

  • CFO or VP Finance experience at one or more Seed–Series C digital health companies
  • Hands-on experience with payers and health plans — ideally Medicaid managed care, value-based contracts, or risk arrangements
  • A track record of supporting a successful priced equity round (Series A or later)
  • Board-level presence — you've presented to boards and investors and managed demanding stakeholders with clarity and calm
  • Comfort being both strategic and in depth in financial data — at our stage, there's no team to delegate to yet
  • Genuine commitment to health equity and to improving outcomes for women and families

Nice to have

  • Experience with public sector, grant, or government contract finance
  • Background in maternal, women's, or population health
  • Familiarity with FQHC or community health center economics
  • Prior experience as a fractional or part-time CFO across multiple companies

What we offer

  • Compensation: Monthly retainer or hourly rate options, equity eligibility if applicable
  • Flexible, remote-first engagement with a mission-driven team
  • Potential path to a full-time role as Delfina grows

We value that everyone at Delfina brings a unique background and perspective. Prospective applicants are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet 100% of the listed qualifications and are encouraged to use their resume and other application materials to demonstrate how their skills meet, or are equivalent to, the listed qualifications.

Experience thriving in fast-paced, early-stage environments where ambiguity is an invitation and ownership is expected. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a refined eye for detail and an instinct for storytelling that moves people. A deeply collaborative disposition, with the ability to work cross-functionally across Product, Design, Engineering, and Growth to deliver unified, high-impact initiatives. Digital Marketing Account Manager – Local SEO & Client Success | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time
Location: Remote — LATAM, Philippines, or Pakistan
Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
Function: Digital Marketing / Account Management / Local SEO

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.

This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution. You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.

The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution.

What You’ll Own

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients
  • Build trust through consistent and proactive communication
  • Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals
  • Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work
  • Track commitments and follow through on client requests
  • Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them
  • Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

  • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles
  • Maintain accurate business information and local listings
  • Support review-management workflows
  • Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance
  • Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets
  • Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility
  • Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines
  • Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics
  • Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues
  • Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations
  • Prepare client-facing performance reports
  • Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way
  • Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

  • Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows
  • Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance
  • Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables
  • Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery
  • Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives
  • Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

  • Identify performance dips or account concerns early
  • Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data
  • Coordinate internally to resolve client issues
  • Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise
  • Track issues through resolution
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

Growth & Upsell Opportunities

  • Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients
  • Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts
  • Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively
  • Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling
  • Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role
  • Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles
  • Experience with review management and local listing accuracy
  • Working proficiency with Google Search Console
  • Working proficiency with Google Analytics
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients
  • Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
  • Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content
  • Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills
  • Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities
  • Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts
  • Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team
  • Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Google Ads
  • Local SEO agency experience
  • Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously
  • Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows
  • Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues
  • Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities
  • Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms

Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates
  • Take ownership of accounts from start to finish
  • Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile
  • Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters
  • Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners
  • Flag performance issues early and take action
  • Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality
  • Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting
  • Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables
  • Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team
  • Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.

You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.

You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.

In short: you’ll own client relationships while ensuring their Local SEO work is executed, measured, communicated, and continuously improved.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Client retention and satisfaction
  • Quality and consistency of client communication
  • Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy
  • Local search visibility and performance
  • Organic traffic and search trends
  • Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting
  • Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups
  • Speed of issue identification and resolution
  • Account organization and ownership
  • Appropriate identification of growth opportunities
  • Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location

Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application & AI Rating
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screen
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Qualifying Questions

  1. Walk me through how you currently manage a Google Business Profile for a local business client. What does your optimization process look like?
  2. How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work? Give a specific example of a task you handled with AI assistance and how you quality-checked the output.
  3. Describe a time when a client’s local search performance dropped. How did you diagnose the issue, and what steps did you take?
  4. How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?
  5. Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager with hands-on expertise in Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and AI-assisted marketing workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.

jobs.excerpt: Local SEO Sales RepresentativePosition Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Local SEO Sales Representative

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, results-driven Local SEO Sales Representative to help small and medium-sized businesses improve their online visibility through local SEO services.

In this role, you’ll own the sales process from prospecting and lead qualification to discovery calls, proposals, follow-ups, and closing deals. You’ll need strong communication skills, a consultative sales approach, and a working understanding of local SEO to explain how these services help businesses attract more local customers.

This is a remote role for someone who takes ownership of their pipeline, works independently, and consistently strives to meet sales targets.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting

  • Identify small and medium-sized businesses that could benefit from local SEO services.
  • Build a consistent sales pipeline through cold calls, emails, and social outreach.
  • Prioritize prospects based on their potential needs and likelihood of conversion.

Consultative Selling & Lead Qualification

  • Lead discovery conversations to understand prospects’ online visibility challenges and business goals.
  • Explain local SEO services and how they can help businesses reach more local customers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads based on fit, potential value, and conversion likelihood.

Proposals, Objection Handling & Closing

  • Prepare and present service proposals tailored to prospect needs.
  • Address objections confidently and communicate the value of local SEO solutions.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects and guide them toward a purchasing decision.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, including prospect details, communication history, and next steps.
  • Track pipeline progress and ensure opportunities receive timely follow-up.
  • Keep sales activity organized so potential deals do not fall through the cracks.

Sales Targets & Performance

  • Work toward defined monthly revenue targets and sales quotas.
  • Monitor performance against targets and identify areas that need improvement.
  • Proactively communicate challenges, seek support when needed, and adjust outreach strategies to improve results.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in B2B or B2C sales, preferably selling digital marketing services or recurring-revenue solutions.
  • Working knowledge of local SEO concepts, including Google Business Profile, local citations, map pack rankings, and review management.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in clear, persuasive language.
  • Experience using a CRM to manage sales pipelines, track prospect interactions, and document follow-up activities.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and manage daily priorities.
  • Strong prospecting, objection-handling, follow-up, and closing skills.
  • A results-driven mindset with the ability to monitor and take ownership of sales performance.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of your sales numbers and know where you stand against your targets.
  • You act early when performance falls behind instead of waiting until the end of the month.
  • You communicate proactively, flag challenges early, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • You are curious about small business owners and take time to understand their challenges rather than relying on scripted pitches.
  • You handle rejection professionally, learn from lost deals, and move quickly to the next opportunity.
  • You are comfortable managing your own schedule, pipeline, and follow-up process without close supervision.

What Success Looks Like

  • A consistent pipeline of qualified prospects is maintained through proactive outreach.
  • Discovery conversations identify genuine business needs and opportunities.
  • Proposals, follow-ups, and objections are handled effectively to move deals toward closing.
  • CRM records remain accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Monthly sales and revenue targets are consistently pursued and achieved.
  • Sales activity and messaging improve over time based on results and feedback.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing your pipeline and prioritizing prospects most likely to move forward. Much of your day will involve outbound prospecting, including cold calls, emails, and follow-ups with business owners. You’ll lead discovery calls, explain local SEO solutions, address objections, and guide prospects through the sales process.

Between conversations, you’ll update your CRM, review pipeline performance, refine your outreach approach, and coordinate with the team when additional support is needed to close a deal. Most communication is asynchronous, with check-ins as needed to align on priorities and pipeline health.

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

About Evo

For over 20 years, The Evolution Championship Series (Evo), has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are rallying points where fans, publishers, developers, and brands celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them. Beyond our established live events, Evo’s mission continues to evolve to create, celebrate, and renew fighting game fandom.

Role Overview

As the Technical Director you will be responsible for the technical planning, development and execution of Evo's live broadcasts, select on-site experiences, studio productions and associated content creation. Over the course of your work you will collaborate with multiple teams at Evo alongside our globally located production partners to ensure that Evo productions are executed at a level that meets or exceeds the expectations of fighting game fans worldwide.

This role sits within the Evo Production team and will be working closely with all of our video production leaders to ensure effective feedback loops.

The ideal candidate has experience leading a team of engineers, designing various broadcast technical infrastructures, overseeing live streams, and working on international productions .

Reporting Structure

You will report to Evo’s Head of Production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Technical Production Management: Provide guidance, oversight, and technical expertise for Evo’s global production teams, detailing and communicating technical and creative requirements to execute productions at a level that meets Evo’s expectations.
  • Tech Bible Maintenance: Maintain the tech bible for Evo Productions, detailing best practices for Evo Broadcasts inclusive of video, audio, game capture, graphics, lighting, multi-stream feeds, stream distribution, ISO records, and game hardware; both for broadcast and in venue.
  • External Production Oversight: Review, analyze, and provide feedback on all production elements from external broadcast partners, ensuring that the planning for technical needs before and during Evo broadcasts meet our high expectations.
  • RFP Writing: Assist in writing RFPs with a focus on technical expectations for potential broadcast partners globally.
  • Evo Team Collaboration: As part of the Evo team, you will collaborate and communicate across Evo Production teams to ensure they have the technical solutions available for their productions.
  • Technical Production Design: Design the technical infrastructures needed to execute both live event and non-event productions.
  • Managing the Technical Team: Hire and manage the engineers and personnel necessary to support all of Evo’s video productions. Negotiate contracts and fees of both freelancers and full-time employees that will be your direct reports.
Qualifications
  • 10+ years experience leading a team of engineers in a live broadcast environment.
  • Proven ability to design and deliver technical infrastructures and solutions for live broadcasts.
  • Experience working in a live studio environment.
  • The ability to work weekends.
Bonus Points
  • Passion for fighting games, esports, gaming communities, and the people who make them thrive.
  • Experience working directly within the fighting game community.
  • Experience working on coverage of fighting game tournaments.
  • Existing relationships with tournament organizers, community leaders, creators, publishers, on-camera talent and other key figures within the fighting game landscape.

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

jobs.description:
SE Ranking is a profitable, growing B2B SaaS business - around 200 people, remote-first and globally distributed. As the business has scaled into a more complex multi-entity, multi-currency structure, we're hiring a senior controllership leader to own the integrity, accuracy, and audit-readiness of our books.

This is a hands-on, build-oriented role for someone who takes real pride in well-controlled, audit-grade financials - and who wants to mature the accounting function as the company's structure and ambitions grow. You'll own the accounting backbone: multi-entity consolidation, internal controls, compliance, and the path to a clean external audit.

You'll report to the CFO and work closely with the wider leadership team. If you're energised by raising the bar on how a scaling, multi-entity business runs its numbers, in a fast-moving, low-ego, global team, this is your role.

What you'll do

  • Own the integrity and audit-quality of the financials. Take ownership of the company's accounting integrity and ensure financial reporting is accurate, compliant, and defensible across all entities — in partnership with the accounting team that runs the day-to-day close and statements.
  • Own multi-entity consolidation and the controls around the close. Own clean, accurate multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation and the control framework that sits around the monthly close, so the numbers are dependable and audit-grade.
  • Drive audit readiness. Document internal controls, implement defensible revenue recognition, and bring the company to a point where it can confidently face an external audit.
  • Design and oversee the ERP migration. Lead the design of the QuickBooks-to-NetSuite (or equivalent) migration as the backbone of a more mature, audit-grade finance infrastructure, partnering with the accounting team and NetSuite consultants on execution.
  • Build the control environment. Establish the accounting policies, internal controls, and process documentation a scaling, internationally distributed business needs.
  • Own compliance, transfer pricing, and IP. Own multi-jurisdiction statutory compliance and international tax, and lead transfer pricing and the tracking of IP flows across entities for the group's structure — working closely with external advisors.
  • Own key external relationships. Own the relationships with the company's banks, CPA firm, auditors, and core finance and accounting vendors, including bank communications and reporting.
  • Lead a lean controllership team. Develop the dedicated support this function needs so controls, compliance, and consolidation scale with the business.

We're looking for someone who has

  • Senior experience. At a B2B SaaS or comparable technology company. You've built or materially upgraded an accounting function, not just maintained a mature one.
  • Audit pedigree and qualification. A Big Four (or comparable) background with roughly 10+ years in audit and controls, and an ACCA (preferred) or CPA qualification. You've prepared for or managed an external audit of consolidated entities specifically and you know what audit-ready actually means in practice.
  • ERP migration experience. You've led or played a central role in a finance systems upgrade. You understand what it takes to get from growing to audit-grade maturity.
  • Multi-currency and international finance experience. Managing books across multiple countries, entities, and currencies is second nature to you. European experience is a strong plus (VAT, local statutory regimes), and you're comfortable with international tax, transfer pricing, multi-jurisdiction compliance, and bridging GAAP and IFRS.
  • Ownership of a control environment. You've built the controls, documentation, and consolidation discipline behind a dependable close.
  • Modern, tech-forward mindset. You're comfortable in an async-first, globally distributed environment where Slack and clear written communication are the default.

Bonus points, if you have

  • Experience integrating finance teams or functions post-acquisition.
  • Experience building and experimenting with AI solutions. You've designed and implemented AI-assisted workflows or automations in a finance context, not just adopted existing tools.
  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics. NDR, GRR, deferred revenue, and how the accounting supports them.

What we offer

  • 22 days of paid time off, plus your local national holidays
  • Flexible work hours and a culture that trusts you to manage your time
  • Private medical insurance or a medical allowance (depending on your location)
  • Extended paid sick leave so you can fully recover without worry
  • AI investment. We invest heavily in AI so you'll have the opportunity to build skills that matter for the next decade of your career, not just this role.
  • A quarterly learning budget for courses, books, or anything that helps you grow professionally
  • A quarterly wellbeing budget you can use for sport, therapy, or even a good novel
  • A quarterly co-working budget so you can work from wherever feels right
  • Best hardware for your work (team Apple)
  • A transparent, flexible culture with people at the core of everything we do

Equity

About the opportunity

Imagine a WhatsApp group full of strangers who share the same dream trip. Days later, they're a community that can't wait to travel together. That's the magic you'll help create.

Epic Trips are group travel experiences guided by Social Media Creators with engaged, passionate audiences. Almost every booking happens during a 5-day live launch campaign run inside a WhatsApp community, and you're the person who makes that campaign come alive.

As an Epic Sales Representative, you'll own the moment of every trip launch: welcoming curious travelers, building genuine connections, and helping them say yes to the adventure. Between launches, you'll make sure no interested traveler is left without a follow-up, working our lead pipeline in HubSpot.

This isn't a customer support role. It's a high-energy, people-first sales role where your communication, creativity, and ability to connect with people you've never met are your greatest strengths.

What you'll do

During launch week

  • Bring WhatsApp communities of 50 to 1,000+ potential travelers to life during 5-day live launch campaigns, keeping the energy high and the conversations flowing.

  • Reply personally to every new member who introduces themselves, so each person feels genuinely seen, welcomed, and excited about the trip.

  • Run a structured daily launch sequence (content posts, Q&A, social proof moments, booking announcements, and urgency messaging) across several campaigns at the same time.

  • Spark real conversations between members, turning a group of strangers into a community that wants to travel together.

  • Answer travelers' questions about pricing, inclusions, destinations, payment plans, and logistics, quickly and accurately.

  • Take care of group settings, names, and moderation, so every community stays a warm, professional, high-trust space.

Between launches

  • Follow up by WhatsApp and email with travelers who showed interest in a trip but didn't book during the launch.

  • Keep every lead in HubSpot up to date, with a clear stage, notes, and next step.

  • Help interested travelers find their way to the next relevant launch or to a trip with open spots.

What we're looking for

  • Availability from Sunday to Thursday during active launch weeks. Launch day is Thursday, and the days leading up to it are when communities warm up and most bookings happen.

  • Outstanding written English: warm, fast, energetic, and human. Almost all of your work happens in writing, with travelers from all over the world, so your messages are their first experience of Epic Trips.

  • Comfort with fast-paced, high-volume work. During launch week you'll be present in several WhatsApp groups at once, and every member deserves your full attention.

  • Strong organization and self-direction. Launches follow a precise daily schedule, and we trust you to own it without needing reminders.

  • A genuine love for connecting with people. You're naturally curious about strangers and know how to make them feel welcome from the very first message.

It's a plus if you have

  • Experience in community management, social media, customer engagement, hospitality, or sales.

  • Experience managing group chats or online communities at scale.

  • Familiarity with the Product Launch Formula (PLF), the method behind our launches. We'll train you on it, but prior exposure helps you hit the ground running.

  • Spanish or Portuguese, which help you connect with even more travelers in our global community.

  • Experience with a CRM, especially HubSpot.

What we offer

  • USD 1,200 per month in base pay.

  • USD 20 per adjusted sale, paid at the monthly close.

  • Fully remote work, so you can connect travelers from wherever you are.

  • Independent Contractor agreement.

jobs.excerpt: At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
jobs.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

OneSpan is looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Demand Generation to lead digital pipeline generation for our Security business.

This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful ownership: paid media strategy and investment, digital sponsorships, campaign orchestration, experimentation, performance analysis and optimization. You'll also play an important role in the go-to-market motion behind DigipassONE, including our investment in passkeys.

The mandate is straightforward: build a repeatable, scalable digital demand engine that creates qualified pipeline and becomes more efficient over time.

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, deeply analytical and never satisfied with simply knowing what happened. You want to understand why it happened, what the data is telling you and what should change as a result.

What You'll Own

  • Lead paid digital strategy and execution for the Security business across search, social, display/programmatic, retargeting, content syndication and other relevant channels.
  • Own digital sponsorships and programs with industry publications, associations and other third parties.
  • Manage digital media investment and continuously reallocate budget based on performance and pipeline contribution.
  • Build the digital components of integrated Security campaigns, translating campaign strategy into channel mix, sequencing, offers, asset requirements, conversion paths and measurement.
  • Lead digital activation across 1:1, 1:few and 1:many account-based programs.
  • Develop and execute webinars and other virtual programs when they are the right vehicle for the audience and objective.
  • Partner with Product Marketing on audiences, positioning and campaign themes; Content and Creative on assets and offers; Marketing Operations on execution and measurement; and Demand Generation and Sales on pipeline progression.
  • Brief Creative and Content based on performance data, identifying where new messaging, formats, assets or offers could improve results.
  • Work closely with the teams responsible for the website, SEO/AEO and organic discovery to create strong conversion paths and a seamless prospect journey.
  • Use retargeting and digital engagement throughout the funnel, including active opportunities, rather than treating lead capture as the end of the digital journey.
  • Maintain a rigorous test-and-learn program across channels, audiences, creative, messaging, offers and conversion experiences.
  • Independently analyze performance data and turn it into clear recommendations for investment, optimization and future campaigns.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Built a repeatable, scalable digital pipeline engine responsible for a meaningful share of Marketing-sourced new-logo Security pipeline.
  • Improved conversion rates while reducing cost per qualified opportunity.
  • Established clear channel and program economics that connect marketing investment to opportunities, pipeline and revenue.
  • Built a disciplined optimization cadence that identifies what to scale, improve or stop.
  • Created an experimentation program that consistently produces actionable learning across audiences, channels, creative and offers.
  • Successfully translated Security priorities into integrated digital programs with clear objectives, sequencing and measurement.
  • Strengthened conversion throughout the buyer journey, from initial engagement through active opportunity.
  • Established digital performance as a source of insight for the broader Marketing team, influencing campaign strategy, content, creative and investment decisions.

What You'll Bring

We're less interested in an arbitrary number of years than we are in evidence that you've done this successfully before. However, success in this role typically aligns to folks with 7+ years in B2B digital/demand generation with meaningful enterprise SaaS experience.

We’re looking for:

  • A strong track record of creating B2B pipeline through digital demand generation, preferably in cybersecurity, enterprise software or another complex B2B market.
  • Deep knowledge of paid digital media and the ability to determine the right channel mix based on the business objective rather than personal channel preference.
  • Experience owning meaningful media budgets and making investment decisions based on downstream performance.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently work with campaign, funnel, opportunity and pipeline data.
  • Experience optimizing beyond clicks, form fills and MQLs to qualified opportunities, pipeline and revenue.
  • Experience building integrated campaigns across multiple channels and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion optimization and account-based marketing.
  • Excellent program management skills and the ability to drive execution across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Salesforce, marketing automation, web analytics and business intelligence tools.
  • The judgment to know when to optimize an investment and when to stop it.
  • The curiosity to challenge assumptions, test new approaches and change your position when the evidence says you should.

Even Better If You Have

  • Experience working at a digital marketing or advertising agency, where demonstrating measurable client return was essential to retaining and growing the business.
  • Experience both working within and managing external agencies.
  • Cybersecurity, identity or authentication experience.
  • Experience marketing to highly regulated industries.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience.
  • Experience supporting sophisticated ABM programs.

How We Work

  • We don't expect every experiment to work but fail early, fail often as needed.
  • We want people who are willing to challenge conventional B2B marketing, test ideas others haven't tried and learn quickly. Nothing is protected simply because we've always done it that way.
  • Come with a hypothesis. Define how we'll know whether it worked. Test it. Read the evidence. Then scale it, improve it or stop it.
  • This role begins as a senior individual contributor. Build the engine, demonstrate incremental pipeline and prove that additional investment can scale it, and there is an opportunity to build a team around the function.

You’ll be joining a talented, collaborative Marketing team that cares deeply about the work, the results and each other. We challenge assumptions, share what we’re learning, step in when someone needs help and hold ourselves to a high standard without taking ourselves too seriously. We want this to be a place where you can do some of the best work of your career, learn from great people and continue to grow. There is a lot of exciting work ahead, and we’re genuinely looking forward to welcoming the next great person to the team.

Salary: $160,000 - $175,000 (depending on experience and qualifications) plus bonus.

About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Department Code & Name: 90411- Finance-Pro

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location:Remote (U.S.-based), preference for New York City-area; with occasional travel for site visits and business-related events

Reports To: Chief Financial Officer, Pro

Direct Report: Manager, FP&A Pro

Job Summary:

The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) will lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis for LOVB Pro. This highly visible role will translate financial data into strategic insights, build scalable financial processes, and partner closely with executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and other key stakeholders to support informed business decisions.

The Director will serve as a trusted financial advisor while supporting a growing organization at the intersection of sports, entertainment, and strategy. This role requires deep FP&A expertise, strong business judgment, an entrepreneurial mindset, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Support the organization's annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.
  • Develop financial models and analyses that support business planning and strategic decision-making for the existing business and new initiatives.
  • Monitor financial performance, identify trends, and provide clear, actionable insights to senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Own workforce cost planning, including headcount and compensation cost modeling, and sporting cost and labor economics, including player, coach, and staff budgeting, forecasting, and cost controls, as part of the annual budget and ongoing forecasts.
  • Own weekly rolling cash flow reporting and forecasting.

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Partner with executive leadership on financial strategy, business performance, and key organizational decisions.
  • Support financial reporting and presentations for the Board of Directors and other key stakeholders.
  • Translate complex financial information and results into clear, accessible insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Serve as a strategic financial partner across functions, helping leaders understand the financial implications of business decisions.
  • Present unit economics analysis to leadership on a monthly basis.

Financial Controls, Reporting & Compliance

  • Support sound financial controls and adherence to GAAP accounting standards.
  • Partner with Accounting and Finance leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial reporting.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors and support audit processes and deliverables.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive financial and organizational information.
  • Prepare a monthly business reporting package containing the prior month's balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement, including variance analysis.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and improve scalable FP&A processes, tools, reporting, and operating rhythms as the organization grows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial visibility, efficiency, and decision-making.
  • Support special projects, business analyses, and emerging priorities as needed.
  • Contribute to a collaborative Finance culture while maintaining strong professional standards and attention to detail.
  • Partner with the Senior Accounting Manager to refine and audit NetSuite functionality.
  • Support the CFO in tracking and improving Finance & Accounting process KPIs.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Deep knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Deep knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP accounting principles and financial controls.
  • Strong strategic and business acumen with the ability to connect financial performance to organizational priorities.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with executives and other senior stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion.
  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining comfortable with hands-on execution.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and evolving environment.
  • Collaborative approach with humility, kindness, and strong interpersonal skills.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field required.
  • 5–10 years of progressive FP&A or related financial experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and financial analysis.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership, Boards, and other high-value stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting growing businesses, new initiatives, or entrepreneurial/intrapreneurial projects.
  • Experience working with external auditors.
  • Experience within professional sports, entertainment, or another high-growth industry preferred.
  • Experience within an early-stage or rapidly scaling organization preferred.
  • Genuine interest in sports and entertainment, with enthusiasm for the growth of women's sports and volleyball.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements (Remote):

  • Ability to operate a computer and use a keyboard, mouse, and video conferencing tools.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video, phone, and written channels.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment.
  • Periodic travel required for key meetings and events.
  • Occasional evening and weekend availability may be required during peak business periods.

Why LOVB Pro?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the financial backbone of an organization growing at the forefront of women's sports. You'll have real influence, direct access to leadership, and the chance to build something meaningful in a mission-driven, high-energy environment.

Description

Company Overview

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Strategist who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
  • Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
  • Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
  • Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
  • Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
  • Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
  • Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
  • Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  • Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

AI & Experimentation Mindset

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
  • Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Proficient English language skills.
  • Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
  • Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
  • Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

Co-Working Space

Fun Stuff

jobs.title: Freiberufliche Karriere-, Job- und Bewerbungscoaches (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Karriereservice;de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, persönliche Entwicklungsarbeit, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement.
jobs.description:
Karriereservice;de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, persönliche Entwicklungsarbeit, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement. Wir begleiten Menschen in unterschiedlichen beruflichen und persönlichen Situationen: Beim Einstieg in das Berufsleben, während des Studiums, in Veränderungsphasen, bei der beruflichen Neuorientierung und auf dem Weg zum nächsten Karriereschritt.

Dabei betrachten wir Karriere nicht isoliert. Berufliche Entscheidungen sind häufig eng mit persönlichen Zielen, individuellen Stärken, Selbstvertrauen, Beziehungen und herausfordernden Lebenssituationen verbunden. Deshalb können unsere Coachings über klassische Karriere- und Bewerbungsthemen hinausgehen und auch Fragen der Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, Entscheidungsfindung oder Konfliktbewältigung einbeziehen.

Zu unseren Auftraggebenden und Kunden zählen Unternehmen, Hochschulen, öffentliche Institutionen sowie Privatpersonen. Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Coachingangebots suchen wir engagierte Karriere-, Job- und Bewerbungscoaches (m/w/d), die uns freiberuflich bei der Durchführung unterschiedlicher Coachingaufträge unterstützen.

Aufgaben

Je nach Auftrag, Zielgruppe und persönlichem Schwerpunkt übernimmst Du unter anderem:

  • Die Durchführung individueller Karriere-, Job- und Bewerbungscoachings
  • Begleitung von Studierenden, Berufseinsteigenden, Berufserfahrenen und Menschen in beruflichen Veränderungssituationen
  • Unterstützung bei beruflicher Standortbestimmung, Zielklärung und Karriereplanung
  • Reflexion persönlicher Stärken, Werte, Interessen und Entwicklungspotenziale
  • Begleitung bei Entscheidungsprozessen und der Entwicklung tragfähiger
    beruflicher Perspektiven
  • Unterstützung bei der persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Selbstvertrauen, Selbstwirksamkeit, Kommunikation oder Abgrenzungsfähigkeit
  • Begleitung bei Konflikten im Studium, am Arbeitsplatz oder mit Arbeitgebenden
  • Unterstützung im Umgang mit beruflichen Belastungen, Unsicherheiten und Veränderungssituationen
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Lebensläufen, Anschreiben und Bewerbungsstrategien
  • Vorbereitung auf Vorstellungsgespräche, Auswahlverfahren und Gehaltsverhandlungen
  • Verlässliche Dokumentation und organisatorische Begleitung der jeweiligen Coachingprozesse
  • Kooperative Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team, um die Anliegen der Coachees und die Rahmenbedingungen der Auftraggebenden professionell miteinander zu verbinden

Die genaue Ausgestaltung richtet sich nach dem individuellen Anliegen der Coachees. Die Coachings können – abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekt – in Präsenz, remote (vorwiegend) oder in einem hybriden Format stattfinden.

Qualifikation

Wir freuen uns über Coaches (m/w/d) mit unterschiedlichen beruflichen und fachlichen Hintergründen. Entscheidend sind für uns ein professionelles Coachingverständnis, persönliche Zugewandtheit und die Fähigkeit, Menschen wirksam in Entwicklungs- und Veränderungsprozessen zu begleiten.

Idealerweise verfügst Du über:

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Karriere-, Job-, Bewerbungs-, Konflikt- oder Life-Coaching
  • Eine fundierte Coachingausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Ein ganzheitliches Verständnis beruflicher und persönlicher Entwicklungsprozesse
  • Kenntnisse des Arbeitsmarktes sowie aktueller Bewerbungs- und Auswahlprozesse
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen und beruflichen Erfahrungsstufen
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie eine wertschätzende und verbindliche Gesprächsführung
  • Die Fähigkeit, Ressourcen und Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam realistische Lösungen zu entwickeln
  • Einen professionellen Umgang mit den Grenzen des eigenen Coachingauftrags
  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Verbindlichkeit und Diskretion
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit digitalen Coachingformaten
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen sind willkommen

Auch qualifizierte Coaches (m/w/d), die am Anfang ihrer freiberuflichen Tätigkeit stehen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen, sich bei uns vorzustellen.

Benefits

Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Eine langfristig angelegte freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit
  • Vielfältige Coachingaufträge mit unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen und Themenstellungen
  • Flexible Einsatzmöglichkeiten in Präsenz, remote oder hybrid
  • Eine transparente und verlässliche Abstimmung
  • Fachlichen Austausch mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Gestaltungsspielraum bei der methodischen Umsetzung
  • Die Möglichkeit, eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte und Erfahrungen einzubringen
  • Eine wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe

Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich und Deinen Coachingansatz kennenzulernen!

jobs.description:
Are you an Analytics Engineering Lead, who knows exactly how to bridge the gap between raw data engineering and high-impact business insights? Read on to find out more!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

We are open to remote work for this position and will happily accept applicants from anywhere in Portugal, Kenya and South Africa.

The Job

In this role, you will define the technical strategy for our data environment while mentoring another Analytics Engineering Senior to build, maintain, and scale reliable, well-documented data models. Sitting right at the center of our data ecosystem, you will collaborate across Data Engineering, Analytics, Product, Finance, and Operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Semantic Architecture: Oversee the architecture of performant, cost-effective dbt and Tableau data models, establishing clean semantic layers with validated metrics, standardized business logic, and dimensional modeling best practices.
  • Governance & Engineering Standards: Enforce software best practices (CI/CD, Git, automated testing) alongside data contracts and playbooks to ensure exceptional data reliability and elevate organizational self-service analytics.
  • Technical Leadership & Enablement: Mentor and grow the analytics engineering team while bridging the gap between Data Engineers, Analysts, Product, and Architecture to align technical strategy with core business goals.
  • You document your work and make sure that your documentation is clear and understandable for future use by others.
  • Our team works in an agile way, and you will be part of the rituals and practices.

About you

You care deeply about the business context behind the numbers, not just the pipelines that process them. You sit naturally at the intersection of software engineering discipline and business strategy. You are a builder and a mentor who takes pride in turning chaotic raw tables into clean, trustworthy semantic layers, and you get genuine satisfaction from enabling analysts and non-technical stakeholders to self-serve with total confidence.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, or guiding data teams, alongside strong stakeholder management experience (particularly with Product and Architecture leads)
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Analytics Engineering and BI Engineering
  • Advanced proficiency with dbt, SQL, and analytics-focused data modelling (dimensional modelling, ELT/ETL design)
  • Strong experience building and optimising data models within Tableau
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Git, automated testing, pull request workflows, and modern data stack tooling
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex technical data concepts into clear, business-friendly language
  • Fluent written and verbal English skills
  • You are currently based in Portugal / South Africa / Kenya

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Airflow or workflow orchestration tools
  • Background in Data Engineering, cloud data warehouses, or lakehouse architectures
  • Exposure to streaming architectures / event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis)
  • Hands-on experience building dedicated metric layers (dbt Semantic Layer, MetricFlow, LookML)

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Technical Challenge | Final interview with the Tech Team

The Rewards

The gross monthly salary brackets for this position are:

Kenya: Ksh444,178 - Ksh740,000 (x12)

South Africa: R88,008 - R146,600 (x12)

Portugal: €3,660 - €6,100 (x14)

Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location.
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
  • A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website Tiko – Do more with Tiko. We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

  • Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
  • Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
  • Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures.
We value your privacy and understand the importance of safeguarding your personal data. How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.
