Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote- Eligible US Locations

About the role and about You:

As the Senior Engineering Manager for the Game Experience (GAMEX) team, you will directly manage a senior team of engineers focused on Zwift's core game loop – from new gamified experiences and competitive racing systems to real-time physics and experiences built on top of our widely-deployed game controller ecosystem. You will navigate technical and product ambiguity, drive alignment across game designers, product managers, program managers / producers, UX designers, engineers, and QA, and ensure our cross-platform C++ features are fun, engaging, and perform seamlessly across desktop, mobile, and Apple TV.

You will balance strategic leadership as a team/people manager with deep technical stewardship, guiding architectural decisions, setting a high bar for engineering quality, and fostering an environment where engineers can grow, deliver predictably (and without crunch), and do their best work.

If you're an experienced game engineering leader who excels at building agile, high-performing teams and owning complex game features from prototype to live production, please apply!

What you’ll do:

  • Lead and support a senior engineering team: Directly manage a dedicated team of 6-8 engineers and be responsible for coaching, career development, performance management, and hiring while fostering a culture of high-autonomy engineering excellence.
  • Drive technical architecture: Provide technical oversight for C++ gameplay systems, partnering with your engineers to ensure scalable and maintainable designs, optimal cross-platform performance, memory management, and long-term technical health.
  • Own the end-to-end software development life cycle: Zwift is a continuously evolving live-service game. You will own the operational excellence of your features in production, championing automated testing, feature flagging, phased rollouts, and real-time telemetry to safely experiment and iterate in a live environment.
  • Drive predictable delivery: Lead efficient, agile team processes (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) that empower the team to plan, iterate, and deliver predictably. You will manage incoming requests, own your team's roadmap, unblock your team, mitigate risks, and maintain clear visibility for stakeholders.
  • Navigate ambiguity: You'll drive cross-functional alignment between engineering, game design, product management, program management / producers, UX, QA, and hardware teams to establish a clear technical strategy and milestones for your team and projects.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years in a software engineering management role (e.g., Engineering Manager, Technical Director, or Lead Programmer/Engineer), with experience directly managing, coaching, and growing engineers in the games industry.
  • 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in game development, with deep fluency in C++ and commercial or custom game engines.
  • Strong understanding of game performance, profiling, memory management, and multi-platform game architecture.
  • Experience operating and maintaining features within a live-service game, with high standards for production quality, operational monitoring, phased deployments, feature flag management, and support.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently define technical strategy and team roadmaps while successfully navigating ambiguity and cross-team dependencies.
  • Proven ability to lead game engineering teams using modern agile practices to run sprints, mitigate delivery risks, and establish reliable release schedules in an iterative environment.

Bonus points:

  • Experience integrating game clients with backend services, persistence layers, and cross-platform mobile ecosystems like iOS, iPadOS, and Android.
  • Experience in console game development, including optimizing for performance and stability in constrained platforms (memory, processing power).
  • Experience integrating modern, AI-assisted development tools to unlock team productivity, balanced with mechanisms to help teams audit, maintain, and scale the use of agentically generated code.
  • Experience building gameplay systems that take advantage of external hardware controllers or physical inputs.
  • Experience with live-game experimentation, A/B testing, and using analytics tools or data pipelines to inform decisions (e.g., Amplitude, Databricks).
  • Interest in building products that support our engaged Zwift community of cyclists, runners, and fitness enthusiasts.

For All US Based Full-Time Positions:

The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. Researcher | Community Empowerment Lab (CEL)

Do you envision an organization beyond rigid structures and hierarchy – as a living, breathing system where people, learning, and energy flow purposefully?

Community Empowerment Lab (CEL) is a purpose-driven evidence-to-scale lab working to transform the care of mothers and newborns across India and the Global South. We work at the intersection of rigorous science and human experience, co-creating and scaling health systems and community-led solutions for maternal, newborn, and child health.

At CEL, we are sparking a movement where science and compassion come together to build a thriving world – one mother, one newborn, one community at a time.

To bring this vision alive from the inside out, within our research, we are seeking aResearcher, someone who can help shape CEL’s research architecture.

The Role

You will collaborate with the Director of Research Systems and a dynamic team of scientists to transform how CEL’s research delivers real-time impact for communities. By blending robust scientific expertise with an innovator’s mindset, you will challenge conventions, advance frontiers, and accelerate the translation of evidence into life-saving solutions. As a key leader, you will shape CEL’s approach to scientific inquiry and impact by designing research frameworks and collaborative methodologies grounded in compassion, rigour, and excellence. Through your guidance, CEL will cultivate a culture of continuous learning, dynamic knowledge exchange, and evidence-based innovation—ensuring our research generates new insights and delivers meaningful outcomes for the communities and partners we serve.

Your work will include:

• Lead the design of rigorous research protocols (cluster RCTs, implementation science, mixed-methods studies).

• Drive/Support proposal development, donor reporting, grant management, and ethical reviews.

• Supervise research teams, field operations, and ensure data quality and adherence to SOPs.

• Develop advanced statistical analysis plans using R, STATA, or equivalent tools, including SPSS, SAS, or Python libraries (e.g., pandas, stats models).

• Publish/contribute in peer-reviewed journals and present findings to academic, policy, and practitioner audiences.

• Collaborate with government, academia, frontline health workers, and community partners.

• Mentor early-career researchers and contribute to institutional research capacity building.

Education/ Experience

• You hold a PhD, MD, DrPH, or equivalent advanced degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Paediatrics, or a related field.

• You have a publication record and proven experience in securing competitive research grants.

• You bring expertise in implementation research, epidemiology, biostatistics, and mixed methods approaches.

• You have successfully led/part of multisite research teams working in low-resource settings.

• You possess a deep understanding of ethical guidelines, research governance, and donor compliance standards.

• You are committed to innovation, capacity building, and advancing public health impact through rigorous research and collaboration.

At CEL, you’ll join a team that believes in science with soul, combining intellectual rigour with deep compassion for those we serve.

Location

Who You Are:

You are a highly organized and detail-oriented inventory professional who has experience in all aspects of processing inventory-related transactions, preferably with high-growth, product-based companies. You have a strong background in hands-on inventory control, are comfortable using various reporting platforms, and thrive in environments where structure is being built from the ground up. You are a strategic thinker who can identify solutions to issues while bringing solutions to fruition by working across the organization, collaborating with others, and ensuring execution through direct, hands-on involvement in any required change efforts.

The Task At Hand:

The Inventory Specialist reports to the Inventory Operations Manager, processing daily inventory transactions from various business partners and assisting with expediting the month-end close processes. This role possesses a strong understanding of how inventory transactions are processed. The incumbent must understand the financial impact of the transactions. The Inventory Specialist interacts effectively with all levels of management across all functional areas.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Assist with processing consumption and production of inventory for various co-manufacturers
  • Investigate and resolve variances discovered through the book-to-book process
  • Assist with analyzing usage variances for work orders
  • Help with closing work orders every week
  • Overseeing transactions for the co-manufacturer in the automation platform
  • Support month-end and year-end inventory reconciliation activities
  • Maintain accurate inventory reports and dashboards to support supply planning, procurement, and logistics teams
  • Collaborate with co-manufacturers to reconcile inventory data, confirm production usage
  • Assist with accounting policies and procedures and the effectiveness of internal controls

  • Supporting other activities, projects as assigned or dictated by business priorities

jobs.description:
Eversheds Sutherland's US Innovation Team is seeking an experienced AI Application Developer to drive the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions across the firm. In this role, you will be the technical authority on all things AI — from architecting enterprise-grade machine learning systems to building intelligent agents that transform how our lawyers and business professionals work. You will collaborate closely with attorneys, business stakeholders, and IT to translate complex legal and operational needs into scalable, secure, and elegant technology solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties:

AI Solution Architecture & Development

  • Lead end-to-end development of AI-powered applications, including large language model (LLM) integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous agent frameworks.
  • Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to enable interoperability between AI agents and firm systems.
  • Architect solutions on Azure AI Foundry, ensuring alignment with enterprise security, compliance, and scalability requirements.
  • Develop and maintain AI workflows using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps, and AI Builder, to extend AI capabilities to non-technical users across the firm.
  • Build and optimize SQL-based data layers to support AI applications, reporting, and analytics pipelines.

Technical Leadership & Best Practices

  • Establish and champion coding standards, code review processes, and documentation practices for the innovation team.
  • Define and implement DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for AI and software projects, ensuring reliable deployment, monitoring, and rollback capabilities.
  • Recommend and maintain version control strategies using Git, with branching models appropriate for collaborative legal technology development.
  • Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, tools, and methodologies and provide recommendations for adoption where appropriate.

Firm-Wide Scalability & Governance

  • Design AI systems with firm-wide deployment in mind, accounting for multi-office use, role-based access control, data privacy, and performance at scale.
  • Partner with IT, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure all AI solutions meet regulatory obligations and internal governance standards.
  • Create architecture decision records (ADRs) and technical roadmaps to guide long-term platform development.
  • Lead technical onboarding and knowledge transfer for new team members and firm stakeholders.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to firm leadership, practice groups, and business services teams on AI feasibility, risks, and opportunities.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and lead solution design sessions with cross-functional teams.
  • Present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • 5+ years of software or AI development experience, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or architect role.
  • Hands-on expertise with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated experience building RAG applications, including vector database integration (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate) and document chunking strategies.
  • Proficiency with Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI Service, AI Studio, Azure Machine Learning) and related Azure services.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform — including Power Automate, Power Apps, and AI Builder.
  • Strong SQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and integration with AI/ML pipelines.
  • Experience implementing MCP or similar agent communication protocols to connect AI models with enterprise tools and APIs.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for AI and application development.
  • Solid understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), infrastructure as code, and environment management.
  • Experience with Git-based version control, branching strategies, and collaborative code management.
  • Prior experience working in a law firm, legal department, or professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, including collaborating with stakeholders across practice groups and business services to maintain ruthless prioritization of the most impactful work.
  • Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns and agentic workflow design.
  • Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, model explainability, and privacy-preserving techniques.
  • Microsoft certifications in AI, Azure, or Power Platform.
  • Experience with enterprise knowledge management platforms or legal document management systems (e.g., iManage, NetDocuments).
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Teams integration for AI application delivery.

Responsible for leading the delivery of test management to multiple CQC technology products and IT projects, working with other teams to proactively manage dependencies, overcome obstacles and get the best value against constraints.

Upscale AI’s SOCs are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help to manufacture the SoC’s that power these data centers by developing and deploying comprehensive manufacturing test and data analytics solutions for high-volume manufacturing at wafer fabrications and Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Tests (OSAT’s).

You will have an opportunity to create silicon in the most advanced technologies and follow it into the field to close the loop back to design and test for the next-generation of chips. You will help to integrate SoC technologies into devices and drive manufacturing test flows to assure performance and screen devices.

You will drive yield improvement, cost optimization and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the optimal test coverage in production to ensure high quality SoCs. You will need to have a strong understanding of Integrated Circuit (IC) flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, diagnostics, and failure analysis.

You will work with various groups to deploy screening methodologies and flows for data processing, analytics and diagnostics. You will drive the release of cost-effective production test solutions into mass production to hit yield and quality goals.

Responsibilities

    • Develop and implement high-volume manufacturing strategies for SoC products, optimize ATE/SLT test coverage, reduce Defective parts per million (DPPM) and test costs, and manage product data integration.

    • Experience with product engineering, supply chain data analytics and diagnostics for High Volume Manufacturing and NPI.
    • Experience evaluating customer returns with ATE and SLT, identifying coverage gaps, developing incremental structural and functional patterns to address quality issues, Statistical analysis (e.g., JMP), Yield Management Systems (e.g., Exensio, YieldExplorer, JMP), and Python for data analytics.
    • Understanding of skew lot definition, data collection, characterization, data analysis and report.

    • 12 years of experience in product engineering or test engineering.
    • 3 years of experience in people management, developing employees.

⚡ About Amber

Amber is an entirely new way of thinking about buying, banking and selling energy where home energy technology works to put money back in customers’ pockets and accelerate the renewable energy transition.

We’re an Australian headquartered company, where we are both an energy technology company and a utility providing energy directly to households and small businesses. In Australia (the world leader on rooftop solar and a 2-way energy grid), we’ve proven that the cheapest, fastest and most rewarding way to reach 100% renewables is to automate the growing wave of home batteries, EVs, and other smart energy devices.

Customers get direct access to the real-time electricity prices and the technology to shift energy usage to the times when cheaper renewables are available in the grid and export to the grid at times when the price they can be paid for it is highest.

We are a clear market leader in energy automation in Australia, and are now partnering with utilities across Europe to bring our technology to European markets and consumers.

We’re at a critical moment in taking the business to scale in Europe. You’ll be joining a rapidly growing regional team of 25, and be part of a global team of over 240, with expertise across energy, technology, marketing, and operations. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and a great culture of people who love coming to work to build a better world.

We’re backed by leading VCs in Australia and Europe, as well as impact-focused investors and world-leading energy companies.

💻 About the role

Want to help improve the environment by shifting the world’s energy usage towards renewables?

We are currently hiring for a mid-level Full Stack Software Engineer. Amber provides a great opportunity to apply your skills as an Engineer to help enable the uptake of renewable energy. Our technology optimises thousands of batteries and other devices in the customers' homes, enabling them to time their usage to consume power at times of high renewable penetration (and cheap prices), and then export power back to the grid at critical times - letting them outbid energy generators and earn potentially >£50 in an afternoon.

At Amber, we believe that enabling a culture where everyone is set up to do the best work of their lives, and feels connected and supported, is one of the most important things we can do to ensure our long-term success.

The Amber Electric product team develops and supports:

  • Home automation integrations (to batteries, solar systems, and EVs) that control electricity usage in response to pricing and renewable availability
  • Mobile & Web apps for customers to monitor and manage their energy usage
  • A pricing and billing engine for real time energy pricing

The European team adapts and expands these systems to local energy markets across the UK and Europe, getting them to the customers of our partner utilities.

The tech stack is React Native mobile app, some React web frontends, and a Serverless Lambda backend on AWS. We’re using Typescript top to bottom, and Apollo GraphQL sits in the middle. We keep our data in DynamoDB, Postgres, and Snowflake, using one or the other as best suits a particular workload.

You can learn more about our tech stack at

While we’re looking for talented and driven individuals our desire is to build a champion team, not a team of champions. We’re full-stack-ish; while it’s impossible for everyone to excel across every layer of the stack we value people who can chip in wherever they’re needed. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace from the ground up. We want engineers who are as comfortable communicating with people as they are with their code.

🛠️ Qualifications and Skills

At Amber, we want to hire self-starters who are eager to learn, and are comfortable working in a changing environment. Some of the key traits we are looking for in this role:

  • You have a positive mindset: equal parts collaborative, curious, and can-do
  • Between 3 and 5 years of commercial development experience
  • Commercial experience with the specific technologies in our stack is a strong plus
  • Commercial experience with Typescript is preferred, though languages sharing similar features (such as JavaScript, C#, Go) are also acceptable
  • We favour generalists with strong backend skills, who are open to flexing across the stack (front end, back end, infrastructure)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills built on a foundation of empathy for your fellow humans is essential, with English proficiency of C1/C2 level at a minimum.

👉🏽 Your Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain high quality program code across the stack
  • Work collaboratively within the product team, taking a high degree of ownership not just of the code you write but of the product that makes it to end users and the processes we employ to get it there
  • Contribute your knowledge to the wider Amber org through RFCs, shares and active engagement in shared discussions
  • Research, consult, and evaluate our system requirements to identify and discuss appropriate iterations and tradeoffs to meet our goals
  • Test, debug, diagnose, and correct errors in our tech stack according to our operational specifications
  • Support the apps that are live with our partners, ensuring their customers have a great experience
  • Work directly with external partners while collaborating across internal teams, including leadership, product, design, engineering, and customer operations to deliver impactful solutions.

🎉 Benefits

  • We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and a great culture of people who love coming to work to build a better world
  • Join a growing technology start-up that will shape the future of household renewable energy use
  • You’d be a part of a growing team of over 240 people with expertise across energy, technology, marketing, and operations
  • Flexible working hours & remote working - see "How You Work" for more info
  • Competitive salary within your local market
  • Share options in Amber Electric
  • Employment and leave entitlements as per your local country
  • An external Employee Assistance Plan for mental health support
  • Annual Learning & Development budget to support your personal growth
  • Annual company conference in Melbourne, Australia.

💰 Salary range

Between £45,000 and £70,000 base per annum. All roles at Amber include employee stock options.

The salary for this role is benchmarked to London, UK, with a location-based adjustment reflecting cost, tax and collaboration factors across Europe. You're free to work from any of our preferred locations in Europe - pay simply reflects where you're based.

This is a full-time role to be based from the UK/Germany/Netherlands. We have an office space in London for those based there.

🇬🇧How You Work🇦🇺

You will be working almost entirely remotely within a high-trust environment where transparency and accountability are foundational to our engineering culture. Amber's flexible approach allows you to shape your schedule around core collaboration hours, which are 7am - 12pm Tuesdays and Thursdays London time. This overlap enables meaningful collaboration with your Australian colleagues.

Outside these core hours, we trust you to manage your time effectively. We expect consistent communication and reliable delivery with a focus on outcomes and impact. Proactive check-ins and sharing progress updates transparently are part of how we maintain this balance of flexibility and responsibility.

We value work-life balance and sustainable pace—we don't want team members to overwork or burn out, nor do we expect you to be available 24/7. Instead, we promote clear boundaries and open dialogue about workload and capacity.

Our headquarters is located in Melbourne, Australia. jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated.
jobs.description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands and launching very soon in Luxembourg and Austria. Backed by 17 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system. Why not join us?

🔎 What's in it for you

Play a key role in protecting Europe’s next-generation payment infrastructure. As an Operations Security Engineer, you will be at the heart of EPI’s Security Operations capability: triaging alerts, responding to incidents, improving detection coverage and proactively hunting for threats across cloud, identity, endpoint and application environments.

This is a high-impact opportunity to combine hands-on SOC expertise, threat hunting and detection engineering in a remote-first, pan-European company where security directly supports the resilience and trust of Wero.

🐝 About the team

You’ll join the Security Operations team within Operations Services Delivery. The team brings together highly skilled security profiles, including SOC, IAM, general security, threat hunting and penetration testing expertise.

You’ll collaborate closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, IT and Operations teams to strengthen detection and response capabilities, improve tooling and ensure strong visibility across our environments. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on investigation, structured incident response and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

💥Your impact

  • Act as a central point of contact for alert triage, incident identification and security event investigation across EPI environments.

  • Execute incident response activities using structured frameworks such as SANS PICERL, from preparation and identification through containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.

  • Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts based on attacker behaviour, emerging threats, threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

  • Parse, analyse and correlate logs from authentication, application, system, endpoint and cloud telemetry sources, including AWS and Azure.

  • Design, tune and maintain detection rules, use cases, dashboards, custom alerts and automation workflows to identify anomalies, lateral movement and persistent threats.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of SOC playbooks, runbooks, SIEM and EDR integrations.

  • Document and communicate threat findings, incident outcomes and remediation recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with engineering, SOC, IR and IT teams to improve detection coverage, response readiness and operational resilience.

💻 Technology stack & way of working

  • Primary security tools: Rapid7, Microsoft Defender, SIEM and EDR technologies

  • Cloud, identity & operations: AWS, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, PagerDuty

  • Scripting, querying & automation: Python, PowerShell, KQL, custom alerting and auto-remediation workflows

  • Collaboration & delivery: Jira, Confluence, GitHub

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

  • +8 years of experience in cybersecurity, with strong hands-on experience as a SOC analyst, incident responder, detection engineer or similar role.

  • Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German, Dutch or other European languages are a plus.

  • Thrive in a remote-first, multicultural and fast-paced environment.

  • Strong familiarity with the full SOC lifecycle, from Tier 1 to Tier 3, including alert triage, incident response, threat hunting and threat intelligence.

  • Proven experience in threat hunting, detection engineering or threat intelligence, with the ability to turn attacker behaviours into actionable detections.

  • Solid understanding of SIEM and EDR technologies, log parsing, detection engineering and alert tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting and querying tools such as Python, PowerShell or KQL to support automation, investigations and custom alerting.

  • Ability to analyse and correlate logs from diverse sources, including authentication, application, system and cloud telemetry across AWS and Azure.

  • Knowledge of attacker TTPs, MITRE ATT&CK, threat exposure and attack path analysis.

  • Experience creating or improving incident response playbooks, runbooks and automation workflows.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and security risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation, approximately one week per month, to support incident response and operational continuity.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Rapid7 and with TaHiTI.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and its integration into detection and response workflows.

  • Nice-to-have certifications such as GSEC, GCIH, BTL1/2, SC-200 or AZ-500.

  • Experience in payments, banking, fintech or another highly regulated environment.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A first call with one of our recruiters

  2. A technical interview with our CISO and a security expert

  3. A final interview with our COO

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You prefer a purely reactive SOC role where you only handle out-of-the-box alerts and escalations.

  • You don’t enjoy digging into logs, building queries, tuning detections or investigating ambiguous signals across distributed systems.

  • You are looking for a role with no on-call responsibilities or no operational incident response exposure.

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with engineering, DevOps, IT and business stakeholders.

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits programme

  • The opportunity to be part of a true pan-European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year

Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

KOLSQUARE MISSION

Kolsquare is a Benefit Company, certified B-Corp in 2024.

At Kolsquare, we firmly believe in this new media and are convinced that it's the best way for ideas, people and organisations to grow and reach their greatest potential. KOLSQUARE CULTURE & VALUES

  • Deliver WOW

  • Be Responsible in your actions

  • Pursue Growth & Learning

  • Be passionate and determined

  • Share your Power, Knowledge & Wealth

  • Build Authentic relationships

📌 More info about culture here in our Culture Book.

Reporting to the Field Marketing Manager Team Lead, you will lead the US marketing strategy, defining and executing high-impact initiatives that drive awareness, credibility and lead generation. You will define the most efficient go-to-market (GTM) strategy for the US market spanning paid media, KOLs, content and other acquisition channels while working closely with the sales team to define market opportunities, create the right marketing materials and ensure effective communication and engagement with potential customers.

This is a senior role that stays close to execution: you will set positioning, messaging and strategic direction while remaining hands-on across content, PR, partnerships, events, sales enablement and digital marketing to position Kolsquare as a leader in the US market against already established US competitors.

Your key responsibilities :

GTM Strategy, Positioning & Sales Enablement

  • Build sales enablement assets and equip the sales team with the positioning, messaging, and communications tools they need to convert leads.

  • Take a 360° view of digital marketing: paid, organic, content, and email to build a cohesive, full-funnel US strategy.

  • Build relationships with media, industry experts, and associations to amplify our thought leadership.

  • Working with the central content team, localize blog posts, reports, and whitepapers that showcase Kolsquare's expertise and proprietary data for the US audience.

Lead Generation & Sales Collaboration

  • Implement localized lead generation campaigns, including content marketing, paid media, and events.

  • Track key KPIs to measure impact and optimize campaigns for lead conversion.

Events, Partnerships & Community Engagement

  • Develop strategic partnerships with marketing associations, agencies, and key industry players.

  • Engage with influencer marketing communities & ambassadors to create advocacy and strengthen Kolsquare's reputation.

Public Relations & Media Management

  • Manage local PR initiatives in collaboration with local PR agencies and journalists.

  • Pitch and distribute newsworthy content to key media outlets.

  • Monitor and analyze market trends & competitors, ensuring we stay ahead of industry changes.

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves 🫵

  • You have 8+ years of senior-level experience in marketing or brand management, ideally in Influencer Marketing or SaaS Martech.

  • You're a strategic thinker and hands-on executor, ready to own and scale Kolsquare's presence in the US, senior enough to set direction, hands-on enough to execute it yourself.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: International Business Development Manager

Compensation range:AUD $2,000 / month base salary, plus a performance bonus of up to AUD $1,000 / month (total up to AUD $3,000 / month)

Work Schedule:Full-time, with core AEST overlap for head office coordination plus availability to reach distributors and customers in assigned export markets

Who We Are:

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

The client is an established Australian medical imaging company with roots going back to the 1970s. It manufactures its own products in Australia and exports them through a network of international distributors and resellers in 20 to 30 countries.

This role owns export sales growth for the client. You’ll find and develop new business, win and grow distributor and customer relationships, and push opportunities through to close. You’ll pull in the internal support each deal needs across pricing, product, regulatory and shipping.

You’ll report to the Business Manager and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Supply Chain and Regulatory. This is a self-directed role. There is no script or playbook. You decide how each market gets developed, within the agreed targets, pricing authority and response standards.

Role Overview:

This is a business development role first. The client needs someone who can spot opportunities, build new business and take sales through to close on their own. The international distributor network is central to the role. You will grow the existing network and add new distributors and customers across MENA, ASEAN and undeveloped territories.

Many of the client’s distributors and customers do not speak English as their first language, so clear, easily understood communication is essential.

You do not need medical or export experience. The client will provide hands-on product and market training, including in-person training in Australia soon after onboarding. Established sales skills need to be in place from day one.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build a data-driven plan for which countries, distributors and customers to target, and show the reasoning behind it.
  • Prospect and generate your own leads using lead generation tools (for example Apollo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator) and AI tools.
  • Research, prospect and assess new distributors and resellers in assigned markets, then move the right ones through the client’s approval and distribution agreement process and onboard them.
  • Act as the primary contact for assigned distributors. Hold a regular call and review cadence, know their business and their market, and track their performance against the distribution agreement so that underperformance and unmet demand both get raised early.
  • Keep visibility of every open opportunity and follow it through to close. Provide quotes, reference pricing, product information and tender support to move deals forward. Any pricing or discount outside the approved price list must be signed off in writing by the Business Manager before you quote it.
  • Deliver product and sales training to distributors. Build monthly sales and product campaigns and a quarterly distributor newsletter with Marketing.
  • Support distributors with local product registration, import and regulatory requirements, and gather the product, quality and regulatory documentation with the internal owners. Report back what you learn about competitor moves, pricing pressure and market access.
  • Track open orders, coordinate with Supply Chain on preparation and shipping, and resolve documentation or fulfillment issues while keeping the distributor informed.
  • Keep the CRM accurate and current. Log distributors, contacts, opportunities and activity within agreed timeframes, and give regular territory and pipeline updates to the Business Manager.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • A proven track record in B2B sales or business development, including identifying opportunities, developing new business and taking sales from prospecting through quotation to close.
  • Strong commercial judgment around pricing and margin, and the attention to detail that quoting demands.
  • Able to build and grow customer and distributor relationships independently, prioritize across multiple markets and deliver against targets with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Comfortable thinking on your feet and building your own approach to a market, without a script.
  • Hands-on experience with prospecting and lead generation tools. Comfortable using AI in your sales process.
  • Strong written English.
  • Clear, easily understood spoken English, strong enough to run commercial discussions with international distributors whose first language is not English, and with Australian head office stakeholders.
  • A technical and professional mindset, and comfort picking up technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. Candidates from other industries are welcome.
  • Confident with CRM and ERP platforms, or able to learn them fast.
  • Tertiary qualification is strongly preferred. A qualification in business, sales or marketing is a plus.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Export, distributor or channel sales experience, or international account management.
  • Medical device, healthcare or medical imaging background.

Benefits

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Be available for meetings and collaboration during core AEST business hours, and arrange enough overlap with assigned export markets to meet agreed response standards.
  • Acknowledge distributor enquiries and support requests within one business day.
  • Be willing and able to travel internationally when required, including industry conferences, distributor visits and periodic travel to the Australian head office.
  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work.
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”).

About USRowing:
USRowing is the national governing body for the sport of rowing in the United States, responsible for stewarding, strengthening, and growing American rowing by championing performance and igniting new passion for the sport. USRowing serves a broad and dedicated community—athletes, coaches, referees, volunteers, clubs, and event organizers—and the U.S. National Team. Through events, programming, education, and fundraising, USRowing supports participation at every level—from novices through the high performance athletes dedicated to reaching Olympic and Paralympic podiums.

Position Summary:
The Communications Manager leads USRowing's public relations, media relations, editorial programs, and has day-to-day oversight of USRowing.org. This role is responsible for the writing and editing of press releases, feature stories, athlete profiles, and long-form content across USRowing's platforms. The Manager will also own the relationships and storytelling with national, regional, and sport-specific media, and serve as USRowing's lead media contact and a key point of contact for athletes, coaches, and staff around media engagement, supporting clear communication and a consistent, high-quality editorial standard across all team deliverables. The position also provides on-site media support at our owned regattas, and at National Team training centers, camps and events, while working closely with the Marketing and Communications team to ensure coverage, storytelling, and partner and member communications are compelling, accurate, and aligned with USRowing's organizational goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Editorial Writing, Editing, and Publishing

  • Write, edit, and distribute press releases, competition previews and recaps, compelling feature stories, athlete profiles, media kits, and long-form content for USRowing.org and other digital platforms.
  • Own day-to-day oversight of content on USRowing.org, including copywriting, editing, and page building.
  • Own and uphold AP style and USRowing’s brand voice across press materials, feature content, and team deliverables; serve as the department’s editorial standard-bearer.
  • Review and edit copy produced across the team — including social captions, email copy, and web content — raising the standard of accuracy, depth, and craft.
  • Develop and maintain the editorial calendar for National Team and organizational storytelling in partnership with the Director of Marketing and Communications and the Social Media and Content Associate.

Media Relations & Athlete Appearances

  • Own the National Team communications calendar across the high-performance cycle, including selection events, World Cups, World Championships, and the Olympic and Paralympic Games.
  • Serve as USRowing’s primary media contact; build and maintain productive relationships with national, regional, and sport-specific media.
  • Manage inbound media requests to support the placement of stories: athlete features, team storylines, selection and results coverage, and human-interest narratives that elevate the National Team and organization.
  • Oversee media operations at competitions, including credentialing, media availability, interview scheduling, and on-site facilitation.
  • Maintain and continuously improve athlete and media databases, press kits, and athlete bios that make National Team coverage easy for media to access.
  • Prepare athletes and staff for media engagement, and coordinate with the Chief Marketing Officer on sensitive or crisis-adjacent communications.
  • Facilitate and coordinate on-demand National Team athlete appearances and autograph signings at events.

Team Support and Quality Management

  • Coach and develop interns and where necessary freelance personnel, raising the standard of accuracy, depth, and craft across all team deliverables.
  • Support the Social Media and Content Associate with social content and real-time coverage, and the Director with email, SMS, web, and campaign workloads, when capacity allows.
  • Translate the Chief Marketing Officer’s strategy into actionable editorial and communications plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measures of success.
  • Balance short-term execution with long-term process improvements, building proactive systems and planning that keep multiple storylines and campaigns moving reliably.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, sports information, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 6–8 years of experience in communications, public relations, media relations, journalism, or sports information, including at least 1–2 years coaching, leading, or managing others, vendors, or freelancers.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with demonstrated command of AP style and experience producing press releases, feature stories, and athlete profiles.
  • Proven media relations and pitching track record: placing stories with national, regional, or sport media outlets, and managing reporter relationships over time.
  • Experience with media operations at live events, including credentialing, interview scheduling, and on-site facilitation.
  • Experience producing and maintaining press kits, athlete bios, and media databases.
  • Comfort with sensitive communications, and exposure to crisis or issues-management support.
  • Working familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing; comfort adapting editorial content for web, email, and social formats.
  • Data fluency: comfortable tracking coverage results and content performance, and using analytics to sharpen storylines and pitches.
  • A passion for rowing or the power of sport in general. A rowing background is highly preferred.
  • Preferred software experience: HubSpot, Canva, Craft CMS, Meta Business Suite, all major social media platforms, Monday.com (or other project management platforms)
  • Bonus not required: hands-on marketing experience (email marketing, social campaign execution, or partnership marketing) that would allow the Manager to support the Director and Social Media and Content Associate with their workloads when needed.

Compensation/Benefits: $70,000–$75,000 annual salary. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role. Please note that due to salary restrictions and requirements, we cannot hire from Washington state for this role.

How to Apply: Online Application. Please provide resume, cover letter, and URLs for 3x writing samples of published work.

USRowing Values:
USRowing is committed to the following values to fulfill its mission and achieve its priorities:

CULTURE OF MUTUAL RESPECT. Foster an inclusive culture honoring the rights, views, and inherent value of others, treating all with dignity and courtesy.

PROFESSIONALISM. Develop and share expertise, act effectively and efficiently, and be responsive and reliable, honoring all pledges and promises in a timely and trustworthy manner.

SAFETY. Be constantly mindful of safety on and off the water, taking proactive measures to prevent injury, abuse, or other harm, and help others both within USRowing and among member organizations.

Talkspace pioneered the ability to text with a licensed therapist from anywhere and now offers a comprehensive suite of mental health services, including therapy for individuals, teens, and couples, as well as psychiatric treatment and medication management (18+). How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

  • Manage creative fatigue as an operating discipline. Watch frequency and CTR decay, know when a winner is done before CPA tells you, and keep enough in the queue that a refresh is never an emergency. TikTok will demand a faster cadence than Meta plan for it.
  • Own audience strategy on Meta. Lookalikes built off funded customers rather than leads, exclusions of existing and in-process borrowers, and geographic weighting toward our Sun Belt concentration. Broad-plus-good-creative is a legitimate answer; be able to prove it against the alternative.
  • Run the creator and Spark Ads program on TikTok. Source creators, manage whitelisting and spark codes, and run paid amplification of organic posts. Extend our celebrity roster onto TikTok in a way that reads as native rather than repurposed.
  • Own the measurement stack on both platforms. Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API: event placement, quality scores, deduplication, and the connection between platform-reported conversions and what actually funds in Salesforce. Both platforms will claim more credit than they earned; your job is to know the real number. Most TikTok accounts fail on tracking configuration before creative ever gets a fair test; yours will not.
  • Guard lead quality, especially on TikTok. Cheap CPL is a trap in lending. You are measured on cost per MQL and MQL-to-fund rate, not volume. That includes the lead-form-versus-site-apply call on Meta; Instant Forms convert cheaper and fund worse, so test it and make the decision on fund rate.
  • Work hand in hand with the influencer program. Influencers are central to how Cardiff markets, not a side experiment. You are the person who turns that talent into performance: deciding which creators and celebrity assets get paid budget behind them, briefing what you need shot, holding each partnership accountable to a fund-rate number, and feeding results back into who we work with next. Talent-specific creative also deserves talent-specific landing pages and vanity URLs; work with the web team on a repeatable template so a new creator can go live without a custom build.
  • Lead the growth-audience push. Spanish-language creative and creators, and a serious, well-funded program aimed at women entrepreneurs: our most under-penetrated segment, and one where social audience composition works in our favor.
  • Protect the accounts. Financial services advertising carries real policy risk on both platforms. Manage restrictions, special ad category requirements and appeals proactively; a disabled ad account is a company-level event at our spend.
  • Report honestly, including on what is not working. Bring a clear scale-or-hold recommendation on TikTok backed by fund-rate data. We would rather hear "this is not working at this spend level and here is why" in month three than watch a budget quietly leak for a year.

What we are looking for: Social-specific

  • 5 years+ managing paid social directly at scale in a direct-response or lead-gen context.
  • Experience personally managing at least $500,000 in monthly paid social spend, with experience approaching or exceeding $1 million per month strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on management of both Meta Ads and TikTok Ads is required, not one plus familiarity with the other. Both, with real spend and real optimization decisions behind you.
  • Proven Conversions API and TikTok Events API implementation and troubleshooting experience; you can debug a broken event yourself.
  • Experience with Spark Ads, creator whitelisting and creator sourcing or management.
  • A creative point of view. You should be able to look at a rough cut and say what will and will not hold a thumb, and be right often enough that the creative team listens.
  • Genuine native fluency in both platforms. You should be able to explain why a specific ad works, not describe TikTok as "short-form video."
  • Familiarity with Meta and TikTok financial services and special ad category policies.

Nice to have: influencer experience especially

  • Direct influencer and creator marketing experience is the single biggest plus for this role. Cardiff works with influencers heavily (celebrity talent and creators are the backbone of our social creative) and someone who has sourced talent, negotiated and briefed partnerships, managed deliverables and whitelisting rights, and measured a creator's performance down to a conversion metric will be a step ahead here from day one.
  • Experience running an influencer program alongside paid amplification, so organic partnerships and paid social reinforce each other rather than running on separate tracks.
  • Video editing ability or fast-turn creative production experience: the difference between waiting a week for a variant and testing one tomorrow.
  • Experience running paid social in a regulated or lending category.
  • YouTube, Snapchat or Reddit paid experience, as we look at where social expands next.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • CAPI and TikTok Events API audited and fixed; platform-reported versus Salesforce-funded reconciliation running weekly.
  • Meta lookalike and exclusion architecture rebuilt on funded-customer seeds.
  • TikTok creator and Spark Ads pipeline established with a repeatable whitelisting process.
  • First women-entrepreneur creative program live across both platforms with its own read on fund rate.
  • A written, data-backed point of view on the right Meta-to-TikTok budget split, and a credible plan for where the next $500K a month goes.

Compensation and benefits

  • Base salary target: $100,000- 125,000
  • Up to 15% annual performance bonus.
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • 401(k) plan.

jobs.excerpt: Social Content & Growth Strategist Fully Remote Work From Home Role Compensation Based on Experience JOB ID: (SCBF2026) RoleOur client is a comic and entertainment company looking for a hands on Social Content & Growth Strategist to help build audiences around their characters, stories, digital products, games, and upcoming entertainment projects.
jobs.description:
Social Content & Growth Strategist
Fully Remote Work From Home Role
Compensation Based on Experience

JOB ID: (SCBF2026)

Role

Our client is a comic and entertainment company looking for a hands on Social Content & Growth Strategist to help build audiences around their characters, stories, digital products, games, and upcoming entertainment projects.

This is not a traditional social media manager role. They need someone who can research what is working, generate original ideas, create content, direct a graphics team, publish, analyze results, and continually evolve the strategy.

You should be equally comfortable coming up with a meme, editing a Reel, researching why an account is suddenly growing, building next week’s content calendar, and looking at analytics to determine what to try next.

They are looking for someone curious, resourceful, organized, creatively ambitious, and deeply familiar with how internet culture and social platforms actually work today.

What You'll Do

Creative & Content

  • Develop original concepts for memes, static posts, carousels, short-form videos, character content, and recurring social series.
  • Turn concepts into finished, publishable content using the company’s existing artwork and assets.
  • Write strong captions, hooks, headlines, and short-form copy in distinct character voices.
  • Edit short-form videos and create social-first graphics.
  • Use AI-assisted creative tools intelligently while ensuring finished content feels intentional, polished, and human rather than generically AI-generated.
  • Identify opportunities to repurpose comics, animation, games, trailers, and other existing assets into social content.

Growth & Research

  • Constantly research emerging social formats, platform changes, algorithm behavior, creators, entertainment brands, fandoms, memes, and cultural trends.
  • Identify what’s driving growth for other accounts and translate those observations into experiments the team can run.
  • Develop strategies for reaching non-followers through shares, recommendations, collaborations, creators, trends, and other organic distribution.
  • Find relevant creators, communities, accounts, and potential collaborators.
  • Proactively bring new growth ideas to the team rather than waiting for assignments.

Publishing & Organization

  • Own and maintain the social content calendar.
  • Schedule and publish consistently across active accounts.
  • Keep assets, drafts, approvals, captions, and publishing schedules organized.
  • Coordinate with designers, animators, editors, and other team members for assets as needed.
  • Help manage multiple distinct social accounts.

Analytics & Experimentation

  • Track reach, non-follower reach, engagement, shares, saves, watch time, profile visits, follower growth, clicks, and other relevant metrics.
  • Identify which content and formats are actually driving discovery and audience growth.
  • Run small experiments, evaluate the results, and quickly iterate.
  • Provide simple, actionable reporting focused on what worked, what didn’t, why, and what should be done next.
  • As the company’s commerce ecosystem grows, help connect social performance to digital product sales, game engagement, email acquisition, and app growth.

What we're looking for

  • Strong understanding of Instagram/Meta and TikTok, particularly short-form content and organic discovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create compelling social content, not simply manage other creators.
  • Strong copywriting instincts and a good sense of humor.
  • Fluency in memes, internet culture, entertainment, fandoms, creators, and emerging social trends.
  • Comfortable with Canva and/or Adobe tools, plus short-form video editing software.
  • Experience using modern AI creative tools is strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several content streams simultaneously.
  • Analytical enough to understand performance data without losing the creative instinct behind great content.
  • Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • Proactive — someone who brings ideas and opportunities to the team rather than needing a detailed assignment for every task.

Most importantly: The client is less interested in years of experience than in evidence that you understand how audiences grow today and can turn that understanding into actual content. Know how to learn.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, the client expects this person to help establish consistent publishing across their accounts, develop recognizable content formats for individual characters, improve non-follower reach and organic discovery, identify repeatable growth opportunities, and create a faster feedback loop between research → idea → content → performance → next experiment.

The larger goal is to turn the company’s social channels into an audience engine that supports its characters, digital products, games, original shows, and ultimately the broader company ecosystem.

Location

Remote

Availability

Part-Time (20h per week)

Must be available to collaborate during U.S. Pacific Time (PT) business hours

Compensation
Based on experience. Please indicate your desired hourly rate when submitting your application.

The Team:

Marketing Science sits within Upstart's Growth, Product, and Ops Analytics team and partners with growth marketing on every channel that brings borrowers to Upstart: direct mail, paid search and social, video, mobile, email, brand campaigns, and lending partnerships. Our job is to tell the business which of those dollars are working, and then help decide where the next one goes.

As our Marketing Measurement lead, you'll own how Upstart answers some key questions about its marketing spend. What did each channel actually cause? How should credit be shared across the touches a borrower saw before applying? Where should next quarter's budget go? The answers decide whether a dollar of spend buys a funded loan or takes credit for one that would have arrived anyway.

We're looking for a data scientist with deep experience in causal inference and marketing measurement to be the measurement partner for our marketing, finance, and product leaders, and the person they trust to say when the evidence is strong enough to move the budget.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Guide incrementality measurement across our marketing channels, working with the analysts who run tests in each channel on design and interpretation, so the team knows what each channel causes rather than what it gets credit for
  • Apply causal inference methods when a clean test isn't feasible, so budget decisions still rest on causal evidence
  • Build and maintain the attribution approach that splits credit across direct mail, digital, partnerships, and email, including channels where a borrower never clicks anything
  • Turn measurement results into spend allocation recommendations that marketing and finance use to plan budgets
  • Use marketing mix models alongside experiments and attribution, and work out which to trust when they disagree
  • Automate recurring measurement reporting, so your time goes to interpretation and recommendations
  • Mentor analysts across the team and review their measurement work

  • Strong Python and SQL skills
  • A track record of measurement work that changed how a marketing budget was spent
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the judgment to push back when the evidence doesn't support the plan
  • Good judgment about when a result is solid enough to act on and when it needs another test
  • Ability to work independently, scope your own projects, and drive them end to end in ambiguous situations

jobs.description:
About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

Department: Patient Solutions

Reports To: VP of Operations

About the Role

Scene Health is on a mission to solve medication non-adherence. We're a diverse team of clinicians, technologists, and public health enthusiasts building high-impact, patient-centered solutions.

The Director of Clinical Video Engagement will lead and scale the clinical team at the center of Scene's asynchronous video-based care model. This is a video-first leadership role: you will own how our nurses, pharmacists, and health coaches show up on camera, and you will be accountable for the quality, consistency, and impact of every video-based patient interaction. Operations and people management are core to the job — but the differentiator we're hiring for is the ability to lead a team whose primary craft is engaging patients through video.

You will build the standards, coaching systems, and performance frameworks that turn video into Scene's most powerful adherence and retention tool, while also running the day-to-day operations — staffing, QA, compliance — that keep a clinical video program running at scale.

We’re looking for a dynamic, strategic leader to be the driving force behind building, managing, and scaling a high-performing clinical organization that delivers exceptional, patient-centered care through Scene’s digital patient engagement platform, anchored by asynchronous video. This role centers on people leadership, operational discipline, and accountability, with a strong emphasis on driving innovative, high-quality digital patient engagement at scale.

This hands-on leadership role blends operational rigor with compassionate team development to build a strong, values-driven clinical culture and to improve retention in care and long-term patient engagement. You will lead teams delivering Video Directly Observed Therapy (VDOT), video-based medication engagement and health coaching, pharmacy services (including MTM and CMRs), and other clinical interventions delivered through Scene’s platform, while fostering a department where clinicians feel supported, accountable, and proud of the care they provide.

Key Responsibilities

Video Engagement Strategy & Standards

  • Own Scene's Engagement Standards for video-based care — defining what “good” looks like on camera for clarity, empathy, tone, adherence support, and clinical accuracy.
  • Set the vision for how asynchronous video is used to motivate, retain, and support patients over time, and continuously evolve that vision as the platform and patient population grow.
  • Identify, test, and scale new video engagement approaches — formats, cadence, messaging — that improve adherence and continuity of care.
  • Serve as the clinical and video-engagement voice in program and workflow design, recommending enhancements that improve video quality and patient experience.
  • Develop and articulate a clear vision for clinical operations that aligns with organizational goals for quality, patient outcomes, digital patient engagement, innovation, and operational performance.
  • Translate strategy into operating plans, team structures, staffing models, and performance expectations.
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders (e.g., Enrollment, Customer Success, Growth, Product) to ensure clinical programs are launched, optimized, and scaled with operational excellence.
  • Serve as a clinical voice in product and workflow design, recommending enhancements that improve team efficiency, video quality, and patient experience

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a diverse clinical team — nurses, pharmacists, health coaches, and support staff — into confident, effective video communicators.
  • Build performance management frameworks that explicitly measure video engagement quality, not just throughput — including clarity, empathy, and impact on medication adherence.
  • Coach individuals and teams directly on on-camera presence and technique; model high-quality video engagement yourself, including appearing on video.
  • Own patient engagement and retention KPIs; oversee staffing, scheduling, and coverage to hit service levels and engagement targets.
  • Partner with HR to design training, hiring criteria, competency assessments, and succession plans built around video engagement skills, not just clinical credentials.

Operational Discipline & Quality Assurance

  • Implement and maintain QA programs that evaluate video engagement effectiveness alongside clinical quality and protocol adherence.
  • Monitor performance in real time; identify engagement, quality, or compliance gaps and act quickly and consistently.
  • Standardize SOPs and escalation pathways to reduce variability in how video is delivered across the team.
  • Ensure accurate, timely documentation to support billing, reporting, and compliance.
  • Use operational platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Talkdesk, Scene's platform) to track KPIs and inform decisions; analyze performance data to find engagement innovation opportunities and intervention needs.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Enrollment, Customer Success, Growth, and Product to launch, optimize, and scale video-based clinical programs.
  • Represent the clinical video engagement function at external meetings and events.

About You

  • You lead with video engagement as a craft, not an afterthought — you can articulate what makes a patient video interaction land, and you can teach it.
  • You're a strong people manager who builds high-performing teams through structure, clarity, and accountability.
  • You set a high bar and enjoy coaching teams to excellence, using direct, candid feedback and clear expectations.
  • You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, unafraid to tackle hard problems and challenge assumptions in service of better outcomes.
  • You are comfortable on camera yourself — modeling high-quality video engagement and leading your team by example.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Job Requirements

  • Clinical background (e.g., Nurse, Pharmacist, PA, or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience leading clinical teams, including in technology-enabled or digitally delivered care models.
  • Demonstrated experience building and coaching teams on video-based or camera-facing communication — e.g., telehealth, video coaching, virtual care, or similar.
  • Proven success in building team structures, performance frameworks, and engagement or retention metrics.
  • Experience developing and enforcing clinical protocols, QA programs, and quality standards within scalable, tech-driven care models.
  • Strong data and technology fluency, with hands-on experience using digital tools to manage operations and performance.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading digital health or virtual care programs, especially those leveraging asynchronous video engagement.
  • Experience working in a startup or health tech company.
  • Experience partnering with hospitals, health plans, or public health organizations on quality improvement initiatives.
  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MPH, MScN).
  • Spanish language capabilities.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive salary range
  • Paid vacation, paid sick leave, plus paid holidays
  • Health, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan

The biggest perk is that you will be working on a game-changing solution in healthcare with people who are talented, motivated, and passionate. Scene has impacted thousands of lives to date, and you will be integral in scaling that impact — while working remotely and helping define what world-class video engagement looks like in healthcare.

Be part of an innovative healthcare solution addressing a $500B medication adherence challenge. Collaborate with passionate professionals across healthcare, technology, and public health sectors, with professional development and growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling company.

If you are a compassionate, tech-savvy healthcare leader with a passion for video-based patient engagement and medication adherence, we want to hear from you! Apply today to help us transform healthcare and empower patients toward better health outcomes.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We believe in reflecting the diversity of our customers and their patients in our team. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Scene is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental ability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

The Academic Coach serves as the primary contact for learners from matriculation (orientation) through the completion of their program. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are looking for aProduct Managerto take ownership ofSuite– the part of our platform every hotelier meets first and uses every day. Join us to make a significant impact as we enter our next chapter of success. With the backing of MCI Capital, a leading European private equity group, we have accelerated our growth starting in 2024, setting the stage for even greater innovation and market expansion.

About the product area

Suite is our platform layer: the admin panel and the shared foundation – navigation, login and user management, the UI framework, in-product help – that every Profitroom product sits on top of. It is where hoteliers configure their property, manage access and administration, and find the answers they need without leaving the product. Every one of our clients passes through it, and how well it works shapes their entire relationship with Profitroom.

Because the layer is shared, you have users on both sides: hoteliers who work in the product daily, and the product teams who build on top of your components.

Alongside the day-to-day of the platform layer, you will own two of the most visible challenges on our product roadmap.

The first isthe client's first experience with us. Getting a hotel live is a moment that sets the tone for everything that follows, and you will design a journey that is faster, simpler and increasingly self-service – so hoteliers can get up and running on their own terms. It is a rare chance to redesign a first impression at scale, with results you can measure directly.

The second ishotel groups. As we grow into larger portfolios, you will build the model that lets a group manage many properties as one business: hierarchy, clusters, portfolio-level configuration, and a navigation experience that feels equally natural for a single boutique hotel and for a chain running dozens. This is genuine product architecture work, not incremental tweaks.

You will do it with real ownership of the area, direct access to hoteliers across 55 countries, and internal teams – Onboarding, Support, Training – who work with your product daily and will tell you exactly what to fix next.

Key goals and responsibilities

  • Own the Suite roadmap, translating business goals into a pragmatic, sequenced plan with clear success criteria.

  • Own the shared platform layer – navigation, UI framework and other common components used by every product team. Set standards, balance their needs, and make the platform efficient to work in: navigation that helps hoteliers find the right feature fast, measured on real usage rather than opinion.

  • Redesign the onboarding journey: reduce time-to-live from months to weeks, remove manual steps, and deliver a self-service onboarding path for clients who want to move on their own.

  • Build multi-property capabilities: switching between properties, shared and inherited configuration, bulk changes, and a navigation model that scales from a single hotel to a portfolio of dozens.

  • Improve the Admin experience – invoicing, consent and terms management, and the everyday configuration hoteliers rely on.

  • Own authentication and access: login, SSO, user management and permissions in a multi-tenant environment where security and compliance are not optional.

  • Develop the Support & Knowledge layer: ticketing integration, knowledge base, in-platform contextual help and chatbot, so hoteliers get answers at the point where they are stuck, without leaving the product.

  • Voice of the customer – run continuous discovery with hoteliers together with the UX team, and stay equally close to our internal users: Onboarding, Support, and Training/eLearning teams whose daily work depends on this area.

  • Use data and AI-supported analysis to find friction across the platform – from the onboarding funnel to daily navigation – prioritise fixes, and measure the impact of every release.

  • Work closely with stakeholders across Onboarding, Support, Sales, Customer Success and Training as well as with other product teams – keep them aligned on priorities and make sure changes land well operationally, not just technically.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager(or a closely related role such as Product Owner with real discovery and prioritisation ownership).

  • Experience in the hospitality industry– you understand how hotels operate and what hoteliers actually need from a system.
