Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Our new client is a rapidly growing, private equity-backed startup in the travel experiences industry, pursuing an ambitious global buy-and-build strategy.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the strategy, operating model and day-to-day effectiveness of IT across the group.

This is astrategic and hands-on leadership role. You will define the Group IT Target Operating Model, covering infrastructure, end-user computing, service desk, cybersecurity, identity and access management, data protection, vendor management and IT governance.

You will build a pragmatic, scalable service model through a combination ofManaged Service Providers (MSPs), specialist partners and internal resources, while ensuring that everyday technology issues are resolved effectively.

You will also play a central role in acquisitions, assessing target companies’ technology environments and leading their integration into the group.

IT Strategy & Target Operating Model

  • Define and implement the Group IT strategy and Target Operating Model.
  • Determine which capabilities should be managed internally, outsourced to MSPs or delivered through specialist partners.
  • Establish clear responsibilities and decision rights at group and local levels.
  • Develop an IT organisation and service model that supports continued international acquisitions.
  • Introduce appropriate standards, policies, governance and KPIs.
  • Build a roadmap for moving portfolio businesses from fragmented local environments towards the agreed target state.

Infrastructure & End-User Technology

  • Own the strategy and standards for devices, networks, connectivity, cloud infrastructure and workplace technology.
  • Establish group standards for hardware, software, device management and lifecycle management.
  • Improve technology resilience, performance and support across the portfolio.
  • Lead infrastructure consolidation and migration initiatives where appropriate.
  • Ensure acquired businesses can be onboarded efficiently into the group’s technology environment.

IT Service Management

  • Design and implement a scalable Group IT service-management model.
  • Establish service desk, incident, request, problem and change-management processes.
  • Define service-level agreements and performance KPIs.
  • Ensure employees across multiple countries receive responsive, high-quality technology support.
  • Personally engage with operational issues when required.

Cybersecurity

  • Establish and maintain an appropriate cybersecurity framework.
  • Define minimum security standards for all portfolio companies.
  • Own identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, backup and recovery, security monitoring and incident-response capabilities.
  • Assess cybersecurity maturity across acquired businesses and prioritise remediation.
  • Coordinate MSPs and specialist cybersecurity providers.

Discover a new kind of career in healthcare as a Functional Specialist.

We have clinic locations across Wales and offer a hybrid working environment.

Working in healthcare, and looking for a change? If you’re a nurse (RMN, RNLD, RGN), occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic, you could use your skills in a different way as a functional specialist.

At Capita Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) we provide unbiased, comprehensive assessments for claimants of Government benefits.

Job title:

Functional Specialist - Wales (Welsh Speaking).

Job Description:

Our functional specialists write reports which help the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) make important decisions about a person’s health and care.

Maybe you’re a nurse right now and you’d like to move away from direct care - this role offers you the chance to not only improve your assessment skills, but also to use your knowledge and experience to make important clinical recommendations.

Or you might be an occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic wanting to learn how to evaluate situations in a different way in a different setting. We’re looking for people with the compassion and experience to understand our claimants’ health conditions/disabilities and how they impact their lives.

This role is different from other healthcare professions, and that’s why we take your training and development seriously. You’ll receive comprehensive training with time set aside for self-development learning.

If you’re looking for a change, including more regular working hours, a competitive salary and are ready to expand your skills and experience, this could be the role for you.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit. 

  • Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence. 

  • Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required. 

  • Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing. 

  • Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you. 

What are PIP and WCA?

  • Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.

  • Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

jobs.description:
Founding Head of Client Success PurpleBinder | Kansas City, MO (Remote-Friendly) | Equity Compensation

About PurpleBinder

PurpleBinder is an AI-powered compliance document governance platform that helps businesses create, manage, and continuously monitor operational documents like employee handbooks, policies, and SOPs. We generate documents using AI-assisted drafting with human review, then monitor federal, state, and local regulations to alert clients when their documents need updating. We serve restaurants, hospitality groups, HOAs, small businesses, and professional services firms. Based in Kansas City, MO, we are pre-launch with a production-ready platform and seeking our first paying customers.

The Role

We're looking for a Founding Head of Client Success to own the entire post-sale client experience from day one. You are the person who turns a signed customer into a happy, retained, expanding customer. When a client purchases a document, you fulfill it. When their compliance monitoring flags a regulatory change, you guide them through the update. When they're ready for their second document, you're the reason they don't hesitate.

You'll work directly with the founder and alongside our Head of Marketing. Marketing drives demand. You deliver on the promise. Together, you create the complete revenue cycle that turns PurpleBinder from a product into a business.

This is an equity-only position. There is no salary. You are joining as a co-builder, not an employee. The equity reflects that — you will hold a meaningful stake in a company you help build from pre-revenue to revenue. Your work directly determines whether clients stay, expand, and refer others. That makes you one of the most important people in the company.

What You'll Own

Client onboarding. When a new client signs up and purchases their first document, you're their first real interaction with PurpleBinder. You'll welcome them, walk them through the platform if needed, answer their questions, and make sure they feel confident they made the right decision. First impressions determine retention — you own that moment.

Document fulfillment. PurpleBinder uses an Account Manager-driven fulfillment model. Clients submit their intake and payment. You generate the document draft using our AI-assisted tools, review it for quality and accuracy, and deliver it to the client. You're not writing documents from scratch — the AI does the heavy lifting — but you're the human layer that ensures every deliverable meets a professional standard before a client sees it. You'll handle revisions when clients request changes and manage the back-and-forth until they accept.

Compliance monitoring response. When our regulatory scanning engine detects a change that affects a client's monitored document, you're the person who acts on it. You'll review the regulatory change, create a revised version of the affected document sections, and deliver the update to the client. This is the core value loop of our subscription product — the client pays $29/month because you make sure their documents never fall out of compliance without them knowing.

Upsell and expansion. Clients who purchase a one-time document but don't add compliance monitoring are leaving value on the table. You'll manage upsell campaigns using our built-in drip email system and promotions engine. You'll decide which clients to target, what promotions to offer, and when to reach out. Every client who converts from a one-time purchase to a monitoring subscription is recurring revenue you created.

Client retention and relationship management. You'll own the ongoing relationship with every client. That means checking in proactively, responding quickly when they have questions, managing subscription renewals, and being the person they trust to keep their compliance documents current. You'll track client health informally at first and help us build the formal processes as we grow.

Product feedback. You'll be the first person to hear what clients love, what frustrates them, what they wish the platform did differently, and what would make them refer a colleague. That feedback goes directly to the founder and shapes the product roadmap. At this stage, your voice carries more weight than any survey or analytics tool.

What a Typical Week Looks Like

Monday: Review the work queue. Three new document orders came in over the weekend — two Employee Handbooks and a PTO Policy. Generate drafts using the AI tools, review each one, deliver to clients. Check compliance monitoring alerts — one client in Missouri got flagged for a state leave law change. Review the regulatory update, draft the revised section, deliver to the client.

Tuesday: Follow up with a client who received their Employee Handbook last week but hasn't accepted it yet. Quick email — "Just checking in, let me know if you'd like any changes." Review the upsell campaign dashboard — two clients are in the drip sequence for compliance monitoring. One opened all three emails but hasn't subscribed. Send a personal follow-up offering the 20% launch promotion.

Wednesday: Onboard a new HOA client who just purchased a CC&Rs + Community Rules bundle. Walk them through the platform, explain how monitoring works, help them set up their organization profile with their community's location. They have questions about what regulations apply to HOAs in their state — you don't give legal advice, but you explain what PurpleBinder monitors and how they'll be alerted.

Thursday: A client requests changes to their delivered Arbitration Agreement — they want to modify the dispute resolution section. Review their notes, update the draft, re-deliver. Another client's monitoring subscription is up for renewal in two weeks — send a retention check-in with a summary of the compliance alerts they received this quarter and the value provided.

Friday: Sync with the founder. Share what you're hearing from clients — three people asked about a Workplace Violence Prevention Policy that we don't offer yet. Two clients mentioned they'd refer us if we had a referral program. One client said the intake questionnaire was confusing on question 7. This is the feedback that shapes the next product sprint.

What We're Looking For

Someone who has managed client relationships in a professional services, SaaS, HR, legal, or compliance context. You understand that client success at a startup isn't about playbooks and health scores — it's about making every single client feel like they're your most important account, because right now, they are.

You're a strong written communicator. Most of your client interaction will be through email and the platform's messaging system. You need to write clearly, professionally, and warmly. When a client receives a delivered document or a compliance update, the accompanying message should inspire confidence.

You're detail-oriented and quality-driven. The documents you deliver represent PurpleBinder's brand. A typo in an Employee Handbook or a missed section in a compliance update erodes trust instantly. You review everything before it goes out.

You're comfortable with AI tools. You don't need to be technical, but you need to be comfortable using AI-assisted drafting tools, reviewing AI-generated content, and understanding when the AI got it right versus when it needs human correction. You'll be trained on our specific workflow.

You're proactive, not reactive. You don't wait for clients to complain. You check in, you follow up, you anticipate needs. The best account managers make clients feel taken care of before they even realize they had a question.

You believe in what we're building. Equity-only compensation means you're betting on the outcome. You should genuinely believe that small businesses deserve better compliance tools and that PurpleBinder is the right product to deliver that.

What You're Getting

A meaningful equity stake in a company at the earliest possible stage. You will be named on the cap table as a founding team member. The exact percentage is negotiable based on your experience and commitment level, but it will reflect the fact that you are building this company alongside the founder.

Full ownership of the client experience. You define what great client success looks like at PurpleBinder. The processes you build, the communication templates you create, the retention strategies you develop — these become the foundation for the entire client success function as the company grows.

A production-ready product. You're not selling vaporware. The platform is built, tested, and ready for real clients. When you deliver a document to a client, it's generated by real AI, reviewed through a real governance workflow, and monitored by a real compliance engine. You're delivering genuine value, not a demo.

Direct access to the founder. You'll work side-by-side with the person who built every feature on the platform. When a client asks a question you can't answer, the founder is one message away. When you have an idea for improving the product, it goes directly to the person who can build it.

A path to a leadership role. If you perform in this role, you become the VP of Client Success or the Chief Customer Officer as PurpleBinder grows. You'll hire and build the team underneath you. The founding title isn't honorary — it reflects the trajectory.

Industries We Serve

Restaurants and food service, hospitality groups, HOAs and community associations, small businesses, nonprofits, professional services, healthcare, retail, construction, education, and financial services.

How to Apply

Send a note to with the subject line "Founding Account Manager." Tell me three things: a time you turned a frustrated client into your biggest advocate, how you'd approach onboarding PurpleBinder's very first paying customer, and why equity-only comp works for you right now.

Strong preference to candidates located in the Kansas City metro.

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.

At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

Executive Clinical Assistant

Location: Remote
Travel: Approximately 10%
Position Type: Full-time
Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated, personable, and technology-savvy nurse to serve as an Executive Clinical Assistant specializing in clinical operations. This position will provide direct support to clinical leadership while coordinating essential authorization, recertification, utilization, admission, and documentation processes.

The ideal candidate has experience working with Department of Labor programs, including DEEOIC requirements and authorization processes. This individual must be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with patients, case managers, providers, office staff, and outside organizations.

This role will initially focus on clinical operations. The selected candidate will also be cross-trained in training, education, and compliance functions to provide operational flexibility and continuity across the organization.

Primary Responsibilities

Authorizations and Recertifications

  • Maintain a comprehensive authorization and recertification tracking system.

  • Submit authorization requests and supporting clinical documentation to Acentra.

  • Track pending submissions, approvals, denials, expiration dates, response deadlines, and required follow-up.

  • Draft routine initial and recertification letters of medical necessity using approved templates.

  • Prepare standard responses to requests for additional information from Acentra or DEEOIC.

  • Escalate delayed, incomplete, or complex authorization matters to the appropriate clinical leader.

  • Help ensure that authorization and recertification activities are completed accurately and within required timeframes.

Patient Utilization

  • Monitor patient utilization against currently approved service hours.

  • Identify unserved approved hours, utilization gaps, and trends requiring follow-up.

  • Prepare weekly utilization reports organized by patient, office, and case manager.

  • Communicate utilization concerns to case managers, office teams, and clinical leadership.

  • Track identified issues through resolution and document actions taken.

Clinical Documentation and Medical Records

  • Request, collect, organize, and review medical records for completeness.

  • Confirm that authorization requests and supporting documentation align with each patient’s accepted DEEOIC conditions.

  • Identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or outdated documentation.

  • Coordinate document follow-up with case managers, providers, Intake, and office staff.

  • Maintain organized and accurate documentation in applicable clinical and operational systems.

  • Protect confidential patient information and follow all applicable privacy and security requirements.

Intake and Admissions

  • Track the intake and admission process from initial referral through start of care.

  • Monitor outstanding requirements and identify barriers that may delay admission.

  • Coordinate with Intake, case managers, providers, and office staff to obtain missing information.

  • Escalate unresolved admission barriers and delays to clinical leadership.

  • Assist new offices with admission packets, required forms, systems, and clinical workflows.

Case Conferences and Operational Reporting

  • Prepare case-conference agendas, patient lists, utilization data, and supporting reports.

  • Document decisions, assignments, and follow-up items resulting from case conferences.

  • Track action items through completion and escalate overdue items when appropriate.

  • Maintain clinical operations dashboards and recurring reports.

  • Analyze operational information to identify trends, workflow gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Provide timely updates to clinical leadership regarding deadlines, risks, and unresolved issues.

Executive and Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as an administrative and clinical follow-up resource for clinical leadership.

  • Help organize priorities, track delegated assignments, and ensure timely follow-through.

  • Communicate professionally with internal teams, patients, providers, and external partners.

  • Collaborate closely with the training, education, and compliance function.

  • Participate in cross-training related to clinical education, employee training, documentation standards, and compliance processes.

  • Provide coverage for cross-trained responsibilities when operationally necessary.

  • Support special projects and other clinical initiatives as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Current nursing license in good standing.

  • Experience working with Department of Labor programs, preferably including DEEOIC cases.

  • Working knowledge of authorization, recertification, utilization, and clinical documentation processes.

  • Strong technology skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams.

  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and follow-up activities independently.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Professional, approachable, and highly personable demeanor.

  • Ability to work effectively with clinical and nonclinical team members across multiple locations.

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Registered Nurse credential.

  • Home health, case management, occupational health, or complex care experience.

  • Direct experience with Acentra submissions or DEEOIC authorization processes.

  • Experience preparing letters of medical necessity or responding to requests for additional information.

  • Experience developing or maintaining dashboards, trackers, and recurring operational reports.

  • Familiarity with electronic medical records and document-management platforms.

Key Competencies

  • Highly motivated and proactive

  • Technologically confident and adaptable

  • Organized and deadline-driven

  • Accurate and detail-oriented

  • Personable and collaborative

  • Discreet with confidential information

  • Strong clinical judgment

  • Clear and professional communicator

  • Resourceful problem-solver

  • Dependable follow-through

Role Expectations

This is a hands-on support and coordination position and does not require previous leadership or supervisory experience. Success in this role will be measured by timely authorization and recertification activity, accurate clinical documentation, improved utilization visibility, reduced admission delays, effective follow-up, and dependable support of clinical leadership.

Title: Senior Manager of Category Management Planning, Analytics & Operations

Reports to: Senior Vice President of Category Management Watches

The Senior Manager of Category Management Planning, Analytics & Operations is a strategic leader responsible for overseeing the end-to-end inventory planning, order management, and operational execution processes that support the Category Management function. Acting as a player-coach, this role leads the Category Management Operations while providing advanced planning, forecasting, allocation, and analytical support to the buying organization. The incumbent serves as the organization's technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Dynamics 365 (D365), Power BI, and Board planning software, leveraging data, systems, and insights to drive operational excellence, inventory optimization, and informed decision-making.

This role is accountable for managing the operational backbone of Category Management, ensuring efficient execution of critical processes, continuous improvement initiatives, and cross-functional projects. Working closely with Category Managers and key stakeholders across Sales, Logistics, CRM, POS, and Project Management teams, the Senior Manager serves as a strategic business partner, translating business objectives into scalable operational processes and actionable analytics.

Strategic Planning & Allocation Analysis
• Provide complex planning and allocation analysis to the buying team to optimize inventory investment, improve sell-through, and maximize returns.
• Partner with Category Managers and leadership to build robust OTB (Open-to-Buy), model stock, and assortment plans using Board planning software.
• Translate macro-level performance data into localized stock distribution strategies, proactively mitigating global overstock, stock aging, and stock-out risks.
• Monitor, support and analyze inventory levels to meet customer demand while minimizing carrying costs and stock-outs by providing suggestions to optimize stock efficiency to Category Managers
• Review stock KPIs, track performance and analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement and suggest necessary action to Category Manager.
• Conducting reviews on model stock, procurement and collection management configurations and challenging Category Managers.

Business Intelligence & Systems Leadership (SME)
• Serve as the primary developer and architect for operational dashboards in Power BI, converting raw system data into scalable, self-service tools while collaborating with the global team to ensure full alignment with established global design templates and data standards.
• Own the administration, configuration, and optimization of Board planning software, ensuring data flows seamlessly between enterprise systems.
• Act as the functional Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Dynamics 365 (Commerce/Supply Chain), establishing best practices for data integrity, pricing lifecycles, and order management.

Managing Complex & Critical Category Management Processes
• Regularly review and check master data information and follow-up with Category Managers (e.g. pricing, sales push activities)

  • Continuously evaluate supply chain processes and identify opportunities for improvement, implementing best practices and lean principles where applicable
    • Challenge and optimize key processes within merchandising, buying, logistics and any other operations functions.

Leadership & Operational Oversight
• Supervise, mentor, and develop the category management operations, establishing clear KPIs and ensuring flawless execution of daily purchasing, allocation, and master data workflows.
• Lead and manage projects within Category Management team.
• Work closely with other departments such as Sales, Marketing, Logistics, Finance, CRM, and Project Team to align activities and facilitate communication and collaboration.
• Act as the senior escalation point for supply chain, logistics, and master data bottlenecks, collaborating directly with internal and external stakeholders.
• Oversee consignment agreements, high-value vendor return frameworks, and inventory reconciliation standards.

Qualifications:

  • 5-7+ years of experience in retail merchandise operations, planning, or inventory management, with at least 2+ years in a supervisory role.
    • Proven, expert-level proficiency in Dynamics 365 (D365), Power BI (DAX, data modeling, dashboard development), and Board (or equivalent enterprise planning software like Anaplan or o9).
    • Advanced proficiency in Excel and retail math; demonstrated capability to translate complex datasets into actionable buying and allocation directives.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.

jobs.excerpt: Propósito del rolEl Performance & Commerce Lead será responsable de diseñar, escalar y optimizar la arquitectura integral de performance y comercio digital de la agencia, integrando paid media, retail media, eTailers y marketplaces bajo una visión omnicanal y data-driven.
jobs.description:
Propósito del rol

El Performance & Commerce Lead será responsable de diseñar, escalar y optimizar la arquitectura integral de performance y comercio digital de la agencia, integrando paid media, retail media, eTailers y marketplaces bajo una visión omnicanal y data-driven.
Su misión será garantizar la trazabilidad y eficiencia del gasto publicitario a lo largo del funnel, conectando la inversión en medios con resultados de negocio: conversión, rentabilidad y crecimiento sostenido de ventas online y offline.

Este rol actúa como conector entre medios, data, martech y eCommerce, asegurando que la ejecución técnica y estratégica de campañas responda a una lógica de performance full funnel y a un entendimiento profundo del consumidor digital.

Responsabilidades principales

1. Estrategia técnica y de comercio digital

  • Diseñar la arquitectura técnica y de data que conecte campañas, plataformas publicitarias, CRMs, DMP/CDP y sistemas de eCommerce.
  • Desarrollar estándares de tracking, tagging, nomenclaturas y QAaplicables a entornos de medios, retail media, marketplaces y eTailers.
  • Supervisar la correcta integración entre ecosistemas publicitarios y de venta (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, Amazon Ads, Mercado Ads, Criteo, Shopify, VTEX, entre otros).
  • Implementar modelos de atribución y medición de conversión omnicanal, vinculando awareness, tráfico, engagement y venta.

2. Automatización y eficiencia operativa

  • Diseñar procesos automatizados para optimización de campañas, flujos de datos y actualización de feeds de productos.
  • Coordinar con el área de Martech y Data Analytics el desarrollo de dashboards predictivos, scripts y conectores entre plataformas.
  • Aumentar el grado de automatización del ecosistema de performance, eliminando fricciones y tareas manuales.
  • Desarrollar playbooks técnicos para escalar mejores prácticas en tagging, feeds, tracking y reporting.

3. Optimización de performance y retail media

  • Analizar data de performance, ROAS, share of shelf, CTRs y pricing dynamics en marketplaces.
  • Ejecutar estrategias de optimización para Retail Media Networks (Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Mercado Ads, Cencosud, Liverpool, etc.).
  • Desarrollar frameworks de Full Funnel Commerce, integrando awareness, consideración, conversión y recompra.
  • Coordinar experimentos de A/B testing, segmentación avanzada y automatización de pujas basadas en IA.

4. Liderazgo y colaboración

  • Coordinar un equipo técnico y comercial especializado en performance, commerce y retail media.
  • Alinear estrategias con las áreas de Media, Martech, Creatividad y Client Services, garantizando coherencia operativa y consistencia de datos.
  • Participar en sesiones con clientes y partners tecnológicos para definir roadmaps de innovación y automatización.
  • Asegurar la transferencia de conocimiento técnico dentro del equipo y la capacitación continua en nuevas plataformas.

Competencias y habilidades clave

Técnicas

  • Dominio avanzado de plataformas publicitarias (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, TikTok, Amazon Ads, Mercado Ads, Criteo, Trade Desk).
  • Conocimiento profundo en eCommerce (Shopify, VTEX, Magento, WooCommerce) y feeds de producto (DataLayer, Merchant Center, XML, API).
  • Experiencia en tagging y tracking (GTM, Floodlight, pixel management, server-side tracking).
  • Deseable conocimiento de APIs, flujos de datos y herramientas de automatización (Zapier, Python, Apps Script, Power Automate).
  • Capacidad de diseñar estrategias omnicanal basadas en datos de conversión y rentabilidad.

Blandas

  • Mentalidad estratégica, analítica y orientada al negocio.
  • Comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos y de marketing.
  • Liderazgo colaborativo y enfoque en formación de talento.
  • Capacidad de innovación y experimentación constante.
  • Curiosidad tecnológica y visión de integración entre medios, data y comercio.

Indicadores de desempeño (KPIs)

  • Trazabilidad completa del funnel (tracking accuracy >99%).
  • Incremento del ROAS y reducción del CPA/CPL.
  • Nivel de automatización alcanzado (% de procesos automatizados).
  • Eficiencia operativa: reducción de tiempos de QA y reporting.
  • Crecimiento de ventas y rentabilidad en eCommerce / marketplaces.

Relaciones clave

Internas:
Head of Media Martech, Desarrollo de Datos, Servicios al Cliente, Creatividad, Estrategia.

Externas:
Clientes estratégicos, plataformas tecnológicas (Google, Meta, Amazon, Mercado Libre, TikTok), eTailers y Retail Media Networks, partners de analítica y automatización.

Reporting to the Co-Executive Directors (Co-EDs), the Chief of Staff will be a key strategic partner to the Co-EDs for WeVote's programs, fundraising, expansion, and execution of its mission. Operational responsibility will be shared with the other existing senior leaders at WeVote. S/he will need to develop deep knowledge of the field, core programs, operations, and business plans. The Chief of Staff will act as a central figure in translating leadership vision into actionable plans while fostering a culture of clarity, accountability, and high performance.

This is a volunteer position (WeVote is 100% volunteer) and we expect that this role will require at least 8-12 hours per week - much of this time will be during "work hours."

Dein Profil

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung aus mehreren Projekten im CMDB-Management (Datenmodellierung, CSDM, IRE, CMDB Health)
  • Vertiefte Praxiskenntnisse in ITOM: Discovery, Service Mapping und Event Management
  • Fundiertes Verständnis für CI-Datenqualität, Reconciliation und Governance auf Enterprise-Niveau
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MID Server, Credentials und Discovery-Patterns, inkl. Troubleshooting

  • Gutes Verständnis der ITIL-Prozesse, die auf der CMDB aufsetzen (Change, Incident, Asset)

  • Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägtes Datenqualitätsbewusstsein
  • Deutsch und Englisch (mind. gute Kenntnisse)
  • Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen (CIS-Discovery, CIS-Event Management, CIS-Service Mapping, CSA)

About the job

About ShiftCareShiftCare's innovative software is a market leader that helps Australian & American disability support providers, in-home aged carers, and allied health professionals streamline the way they work by creating efficiencies in rostering, client management, and billing, enabling businesses to grow.

About The Team You'll Be JoiningThe ShiftCare Engineering team is on a mission to make ShiftCare accessible to more businesses across Australia & the United States, but this is just the beginning of our journey. Doubling in revenue every year, we are having a fun time scaling our systems and processes appropriately.

Positioned within ShiftCare's Engineering team, you'll be joining our infrastructure team to help propel our cloud Infrastructure and DevOps principles into the future! At ShiftCare, we treat our work as a craft and are passionate about reliability, security, our customers, and doing more with less.

The RoleAs ShiftCare scales, the requirements of our platform and team evolve. But we like to think that's all part of the fun! To give you a taste of the cool things you'll be working on when you start:

  • Iterative improvements for our CI/CD pipelines
  • Contributing to our Terraform codebase
  • Developing cloud infrastructure solutions with a focus on scalability, high-availability, and security
  • Collaborating with the rest of the engineering team and wider business to work out the best solutions to their cloud problems
  • Proposing improvements and contributing to the continuous evolution of ShiftCares platform, infrastructure, and way of working to ensure we build future-proof solutions as we continue scaling globally
  • Taking part in routine security, reliability, and DR exercises

You will be joining our Infrastructure team as a Cloud Engineer, playing a pivotal role in the next evolution of our technology stack and DevOps processes.

What You'll Do In The RoleAs part of the infrastructure team, you'll:

  • Support and enable our development teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions
  • Contribute to the development of secure, reliable, and scalable Cloud infrastructure solutions and processes, reducing the complexity and burden of using the cloud for our development teams
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable cloud solutions. Help drive architectural decisions that align with the company's long-term goals and vision
  • Contribute to the implementation of robust monitoring and observability solutions to improve system visibility, detect anomalies, and troubleshoot issues proactively (we use New Relic, CloudWatch)
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (specifically, in Terraform)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to our SaaS platform, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum reliability
  • Identify and implement improvements to our products and processes to support our growth

Requirements

About You

  • You are passionate about cloud infrastructure, security, reliability, and building secure solutions that scale
  • Your ideal role is where you get to wear multiple infrastructure hats, and you're comfortable getting into the unfamiliar. In this role, you'll get to touch all aspects of cloud infrastructure - from ACLs and security services, to networking, compute, CI/CD, and deployments
  • You have experience in AWS and shipping scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems that operate at large scale. Ideally, in a similar stack as ours: AWS, Cloudflare, Docker in ECS Fargate, Lambdas, and SQS
  • You are passionate about learning, continuous improvement, and excellence. Treating your work as a craft, and lovingly nurturing a culture that embraces those values
  • You thrive when given autonomy and responsibility to identify problems, drive solutions, and bring the team along, encouraging a healthy and inclusive work environment that's both supportive and challenging to promote growth

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead product design from discovery through launch and iteration across the product lifecycle
  • Balance user needs with business objectives to make strategic product decisions
  • Conduct user research and use data to inform product strategy and design decisions
  • Define and prioritize features in collaboration with product managers and stakeholders
  • Analyze competitive landscape and market trends to identify opportunities
  • Design end-to-end user experiences including research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
  • Establish success metrics and measure product performance against business and user goals
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, and design decisions to diverse audiences

  • Use AI as an enablement tool to maximize productivity and delivery

Minimum Qualifications

  • Expert proficiency with Figma, including prototyping and design systems

  • Proven ability to collaborate with product managers on product strategy and roadmapping
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of key product metrics (adoption, retention, conversion, revenue)
  • Demonstrated professionalism in behavior and presentation
  • Active listener who is kind and passionate about building successful products
  • Experience working directly with U.S. based clients and stakeholders
  • Adaptable and quick to adopt AI tools to improve design workflow and delivery
  • Knowledge of actionable UX, including designing AI-powered experiences that guide users to clear next steps

Required Technical Skills

Product Strategy & Business

  • Product Strategy Documentation: Document clear design goals aligned with business objectives, including competitive analysis, target user segments, and feature prioritization
  • Job-to-be-Done Analysis: Conduct analysis to ensure solutions focus on the actual jobs users need to accomplish
  • Feature Prioritization: Strategically plan and prioritize features based on user needs, business value, and technical feasibility
  • Competitive Analysis: Analyze competitive landscape and market positioning to identify opportunities and differentiation
  • Success Metrics: Define and track product success metrics including adoption, retention, conversion, and business KPIs
  • Product Lifecycle Management: Lead product design across discovery, definition, development, launch, and iteration phases

User Research & Testing

  • Interview Methodologies: Conduct contextual inquiries, ethnographic research, and user interviews to deeply understand user needs and motivations
  • User Testing Methodologies: Design and conduct usability testing, task-based testing, and A/B testing to validate product concepts
  • Data Synthesis: Skillfully synthesize quantitative data from analytics with qualitative insights to inform product decisions
  • Analytics Tools: Use tools like Google Analytics to analyze user behavior, track key metrics, and optimize the product journey
  • Presentation of Insights: Create compelling presentations using storytelling techniques and data visualization to influence product decisions

User Understanding

  • Persona/User Identification: Define and document users and personas based on research to guide product strategy
  • Journey Mapping: Map user journeys to visualize touchpoints, pain points, and opportunities for product improvement

  • As-Is-State Mapping: Map current state of user flows to identify how customers accomplish their goals and where opportunities exist
  • Designing to Meet User Goals: Prioritize user goals while balancing business requirements and technical constraints

Product Design Process

  • User Flowcharts & Diagrams: Create visual maps that define user interactions and refine product journeys
  • Site-Mapping: Visualize product structures to ensure intuitive navigation and support roadmapping
  • Wireframing: Create wireframes that communicate product structure, functionality, and intended behaviors
  • Flow Prototyping: Generate detailed user flow maps and create prototypes to test product concepts
  • Broad Solution Exploration: Generate multiple ideas quickly, showing clear rationale for why certain ideas were eliminated

Interaction & Visual Design

  • Responsive Design: Ensure product experiences are optimized for all devices and usage contexts

jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

jobs.description:
Company Summary

Started in 2023, HeyMax is the fastest growing fintech company in Singapore. We leverage technology to revolutionize the way people maximize their miles and rewards through merchant affiliation, credit card rewards, and more. We are committed to simplifying personal finance and delivering equitable personal finance optimizations to our customers. For businesses, HeyMax is shaping up to be the most advanced customer acquisition platform for high-value customers.

HeyMax is started by 4 ex-Meta veteran engineers, joined by a founding team of extremely talented hustlers from Endowus, Aspire, Funding Society, Singsaver and beyond. HeyMax is supported by a list of top tier investors that includes founders, VCs and industry leaders.

What we're looking for

Ever found yourself trapped in an endless meeting, where discussions spiral into oblivion and the only decision made is to schedule yet another meeting? You glance at the clock, it's past 5 PM, and not a single line of code has been penned all day. Or perhaps you're ready to deploy a new feature, only to be held back by layers of bureaucratic red tape? You've tested it, you know it works, but you're stuck waiting for approval from a committee that doesn't understand the first thing about code.

Maybe you've been part of a team, working on a minuscule fragment of a colossal puzzle. You wake up each day, questioning the real impact of your work, spending more than 30% of your mental energy convincing yourself that it's meaningful. Or worse, you're forced to work with outdated technology, even though you know there are better, more efficient tools out there. You're itching to innovate, but you're stuck in the past.

If these scenarios sound all too familiar, it's time for a change. Welcome to HeyMax, a pioneering fintech startup where your work matters, your ideas count, and you're free to make a real difference!

But there's another frustration that's becoming just as real: the way work gets done has fundamentally changed, and most companies haven't caught up. AI isn't a feature to add later — it's the engine that drives how the best teams ship today. At HeyMax, this isn't limited to engineering. From product and design to operations and business development, we're building an AI-augmented company where every team moves faster. On the engineering side, that means AI-augmented workflows end-to-end: from spec generation and architecture design to implementation, testing, and code review. The result? A lean team that ships with the velocity of one three times its size.

Yet most orgs are still stuck. Engineers writing boilerplate by hand, debugging without AI assistance, treating LLMs as glorified autocomplete. Tech leads running the same playbooks from 2020 — manual code reviews as bottlenecks, waterfall-ish sprint planning, and no systematic approach to integrating AI into how the company operates.

If you're the kind of engineer who's already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to radically accelerate your own output — and you're frustrated that the teams around you aren't doing the same — HeyMax is where you come to fix that at the team level.

We're looking for a Tech Lead who doesn't just use AI tools personally, but knows how to set up frameworks, workflows, and culture so that every engineer on the team is shipping 3-5x faster with AI assistance.

What You'll Do

  • Architect AI-Augmented Workflows: Design and implement development workflows where AI is deeply integrated — from spec-to-code pipelines, AI-assisted code review, to automated testing generation. You'll define how the team builds software in the AI era.
  • Multiply Team Output Through AI: Set up frameworks, tooling, and best practices so every engineer leverages AI effectively. This isn't about mandating tools — it's about creating an environment where AI-assisted development is the natural, efficient default.
  • Make High-Leverage Technical Decisions: Own architecture, tech stack, and process decisions across our platform. You'll balance speed with quality, knowing when to let AI handle the heavy lifting and when human judgment is critical.
  • Stay Hands-On: You'll be in the code daily. We believe the best tech leads maintain deep technical context by building alongside their team, not managing from a distance.
  • Build and Elevate the Team: Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers who thrive in an AI-augmented environment. Foster a culture where continuous learning and rapid experimentation are the norm.
  • Ship Real Impact: At HeyMax, you won't be optimizing a tiny corner of a massive system. You'll work across the full stack — mobile, backend, infrastructure, data — on problems that directly affect 100,000+ users across multiple markets.
  • Drive Continuous Innovation: Evaluate and adopt new AI tools, models, and methodologies as they emerge. The landscape is moving fast, and you'll keep HeyMax at the cutting edge.

Responsibilities

With great power comes great responsibility. Here's what you'll own:

  • Define the AI-First Development Playbook: Establish how the team uses AI across the entire development lifecycle — spec generation, implementation, code review, testing, and deployment. Create reusable prompts, workflows, and guardrails that make AI-assisted development reliable and scalable.
  • Lead and Inspire: Guide your team through complex technical challenges, inspire them to push boundaries, and foster a culture where experimentation with AI tools is encouraged and celebrated.
  • Hands-On Coding: Build features and systems alongside your team. Demonstrate AI-augmented development by example — show what's possible when a senior engineer pairs effectively with AI.
  • Own Architecture & Technical Direction: Make critical decisions on system design, tech stack, and infrastructure. Ensure our architecture supports rapid iteration and can scale across Singapore, Hong Kong, and Indonesia.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with product, design, and business teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Bridge the gap between what AI makes possible and what the business needs.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish quality standards, observability practices, and incident response procedures. Balance shipping speed with reliability — AI helps you move fast, but you ensure nothing breaks.
  • Build the Team's AI Muscle: Onboard engineers into AI-augmented workflows, share effective patterns, and continuously raise the bar on how the team leverages AI. Turn individual AI proficiency into team-wide capability.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong technical depth in one or more areas: Mobile (React Native), Backend, Infrastructure, Data, or AI.
  • AI-Augmented Development Experience: You actively use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions on how to make teams effective with them. This isn't a nice-to-have — it's core to the role.
  • Proven Technical Leadership: Track record as a Tech Lead or similar role, having led projects from conception to completion. You've made architecture decisions that stood the test of scale.
  • Systems Thinking: You can design end-to-end workflows, not just write code. You think about how specs get written, how code gets reviewed, how tests get generated, and how to optimize the entire pipeline.
  • Technical Breadth: Proficient in multiple programming languages and familiar with modern tech stacks. You're always learning and adapting to new tools and practices.
  • Leadership & Communication: You can inspire a team, make tough calls under ambiguity, and clearly convey complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bonus: Experience with fintech, loyalty/rewards systems, or multi-region deployments across Southeast Asia.

About

Our Mission

At HeyMax, we believe that travel brings joy and foster empathy. Our mission is to make aspirational travel experiences accessible to everyone.

Our Vision

Weve created a platform that connects you to any brands you love. Every time you interact, your purchases are rewarded in the form of a universal travel currency, Max Miles, to travel anywhere.

Our Values

  • Deliver Long-Term Customer Value Every decision starts with our users. We listen, design, and iterate with their needs at the center.
  • Transparency We believe trust is built on honesty. Whether it's our product, policies, or partnerships, we communicate openly and proactively so our team and users can rely on us to deliver exactly what we promise. We want users to trust in HeyMax every step of the way.
  • Be The Owner - Ownership is our mantra. More than just accountability, it's taking initiative, making informed decisions, and leading with integrity. We each own the impact we have on our customers, the well-being of our team, and the outcomes of our actions.

jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission to get therapy into the hands of everyone!

We’re looking for a part-time, contract Therapist (Independent Contract Provider) who is passionate about reaching individuals who need mental healthcare but lack easy access to it. This role is perfect for those seeking the opportunity to work with a diverse client base while enjoying the flexibility and rewards of private practice—without the hassle of administrative work. Let Talkspace handle the insurance billing, marketing, and administrative costs, so you can create your own schedule and focus fully on providing impactful care!

We are currently hiring licensed providers in all states within the United States except FL, MA, MI, TX, VT. Providers licensed in NC will be required to provide at least 10 hours of availability during evenings or weekends. No minimum hour requirement applies to providers in all other states.

What you'll do:

  • Treat clients remotely in your state(s) of licensure on the secure (HIPAA compliant) Talkspace platform
  • Conduct client sessions using video, audio, and live messaging services
  • Respond to asynchronous client messages each week, in a timely manner
  • Complete your required clinical documentation after each client session
  • Offer availability during evenings and/or weekends

About you

  • Current license to practice independently without supervision in your state(s) of licensure
    • Note: Associate licensed providers who require supervision are not eligible for this role
  • Individual professional malpractice liability insurance policy
  • Individual NPI number
  • Comfortable learning new online tools and technology
  • Reliable internet connection and video-capable device

Perks

  • Clients Ready for You: Talkspace provides new client referrals
  • Flexible Schedule: Set your own schedule with no minimum requirement for your weekly hours or caseload size
  • No Membership Fees: No provider fees
  • Accept Insurance Without Hassle: Talkspace will take care of all aspects of client insurance including credentialing, billing, and claims

  • Free CEUs: NBCC and ASWB accredited continuing education credits via Talkspace-provided Learning Communities
  • Health Perks: Access Stride Health to support your health and financial well-being

Compensation

  • Compensation for sessions is determined by the state in which your client resides. Rates for shorter live sessions (30- and 45-minute) are prorated.
    • CA: $90 per hour for live chat, audio, or video sessions (this rate is prorated for 45 and 30 minute sessions)
    • DC, MA, MD, NY, VA, WA: $78 per hour for live chat, audio, or video sessions (this rate is prorated for 45 and 30 minute sessions)
    • All other states: $70 per hour for live chat, audio, or video sessions (this rate is prorated for 45 and 30 minute sessions)
  • Additional compensation for asynchronous messaging
  • Earn a new client engagement bonus, varying by plan type

Please note: If you treat clients in multiple states, different rates will apply accordingly. Rates could be subject to change and may vary over time based on the market and shifts in demand.

Why Talkspace

Talkspace is a leading virtual behavioral healthcare provider committed to helping people lead healthier, happier lives through access to high-quality mental healthcare. At Talkspace, we believe that mental healthcare is core to overall health and should be available to everyone.

Talkspace pioneered the ability to text with a licensed therapist from anywhere and now offers a comprehensive suite of mental health services, including therapy for individuals, teens, and couples, as well as psychiatric treatment and medication management (18+). With Talkspace’s core therapy offerings, members are matched with one of thousands of licensed therapists within days and can engage in live video, audio, or chat sessions, and/or unlimited asynchronous text messaging sessions.

All care offered at Talkspace is delivered through an easy-to-use, fully-encrypted web and mobile platform that meets HIPAA, federal, and state regulatory requirements. More than 151 million Americans have access to Talkspace through their health insurance plans, employee assistance programs, our partnerships with leading healthcare companies, or as a free benefit through their employer, school, or government agency.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.
