jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long.
jobs.description:
At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long. School transportation is a critical part of everyday life for millions of students and families, yet much of the industry still depends on fragmented, manual processes.

We’re building a modern transportation platform that makes school buses safer, smarter, and more efficient for students, families, schools, and communities nationwide.

Our product ecosystem spans web, mobile, backend, mapping, real-time systems, and integrations. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll take a leading role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall quality of that ecosystem.

This role goes beyond executing test cases. You’ll help define how we approach quality, identify risks before they become customer problems, investigate complex production issues, improve automation and tooling, and influence engineering practices across teams.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll join an established QA function and help take it to the next level.

We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, make sound quality and risk decisions, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering and product teams.

You’ll work across the entire development lifecycle—from requirements and technical design through implementation, release, production monitoring, and incident investigation.

You’ll be expected to question assumptions, uncover difficult edge cases, identify systemic quality risks, and improve how we test and ship software.

This is a hands-on senior role. You’ll still test products directly, but you’ll also help shape test strategy, automation, tooling, processes, and quality standards across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Own Quality Across Complex Product Areas

  • Take ownership of quality for complex features and product areas across Web, Android, and Flutter applications.
  • Define appropriate test strategies based on technical complexity, customer impact, risk, and system architecture.
  • Perform exploratory, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing across interconnected systems.
  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone.
  • Help teams determine appropriate release confidence and identify gaps before changes reach production.

Investigate Complex Problems

  • Lead investigation of difficult bugs and production issues across frontend, mobile, backend, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
  • Analyze application logs, network traffic, API requests, database data, monitoring signals, and source code to isolate root causes.
  • Reproduce complex or intermittent issues and provide engineers with clear technical findings.
  • Distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and identify patterns across seemingly unrelated incidents.
  • Build scripts, utilities, or debugging tools when they can accelerate investigation or improve future troubleshooting.

Drive Test Automation and Engineering Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain E2E and integration automation using tools such as Playwright/Maestro/Appium.
  • Identify where automation provides meaningful value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
  • Improve automation architecture, reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Work with engineers to improve testability at the application and system level.
  • Improve automated quality checks on CI/CD workflows.

Influence Engineering and Product Decisions

  • Partner with engineers and product managers during planning and technical design to identify risks early.
  • Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions, and implementation decisions when they introduce unnecessary quality risk.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly and help teams make informed release decisions.
  • Represent the customer and operational perspective during technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with Support and other customer-facing teams when investigating reported issues.

Improve QA Processes and Quality Culture

  • Identify weaknesses in existing QA processes and propose practical improvements.
  • Improve test documentation, defect reporting, release validation, incident analysis, and quality metrics.
  • Help establish scalable testing practices as the product and engineering organization grow.
  • Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and help less-experienced QA engineers develop stronger testing and debugging skills.
  • Promote the idea that quality is a shared engineering responsibility rather than something owned only by QA.

Who We’re Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering in Test, or another strongly technical software quality role.
  • Significant experience testing complex web and mobile applications involving multiple interconnected services.
  • Advanced exploratory testing and risk-analysis skills.
  • Strong experience investigating production issues using logs, APIs, databases, monitoring tools, and other technical signals.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and methodologies.
  • Strong programming and debugging skills—you should be comfortable reading, understanding, and navigating production codebases.
  • Ability to write automation, debugging utilities, scripts, data-analysis tools, or other engineering support tooling when needed.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, client-server architecture, and data flows between services.
  • Strong understanding of the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis and test design through execution, release validation, and production monitoring.
  • Experience working with defect tracking systems and test management practices.
  • Understanding of software security and privacy considerations, including authentication, authorization, data handling, access control, and common OWASP risks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with mapping, GPS/location systems, real-time applications, or transportation technology is a strong plus.

Technical Background

Experience with some of the following technologies is useful, but expertise in every technology listed is not required. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems.

  • Web: React, TypeScript
  • APIs & Backend: REST APIs, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase
  • Mobile: Android, Flutter
  • Automation: Playwright, Maestro, Appium
  • Observability & Debugging: Datadog, Sentry, Google Cloud Platform, Proxyman
  • Data & Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase Firestore, Google Cloud Platform
  • API tooling: Postman or similar tools
  • Security: OWASP, authentication/authorization concepts, privacy and data-handling practices
  • Delivery: CI/CD pipelines, Agile software development practices
  • Mapping / Location: GPS, geospatial systems, mapping SDKs, routing, or other location-based technologies

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally think in terms of risk, failure modes, and customer impact, not just expected behavior.
  • You are comfortable investigating problems across multiple layers of a system.
  • You can work independently when requirements are incomplete or the problem is poorly understood.
  • You know when deeper investigation is necessary and when additional testing provides diminishing returns.
  • You communicate quality concerns clearly without becoming a bottleneck for delivery.
  • You are comfortable challenging assumptions and advocating for technical improvements.
  • You look for opportunities to eliminate recurring problems rather than repeatedly testing around them.
  • You enjoy building tools and processes that make engineering teams more effective.
  • You balance attention to detail with pragmatic decision-making.

We are GDIT. We build cutting‑edge applications and deliver mission‑critical technology for the nation’s most complex government, defense, and intelligence programs. Bring your creativity, technical depth, and leadership to help us solve challenging problems and prepare our nation for the future.


At GDIT, people are our differentiator. GDIT Technology Shared Services (TSS) is where you shape the future of how we design, deliver, and operate enterprise and cloud network solutions. By owning your opportunity at GDIT, you help ensure today is secure and tomorrow is smarter.


Position Overview


GDIT is seeking a dynamic and highly technical Network Engineering Sr Manager to lead cloud and data center network teams across project delivery and operations. This role blends engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership to drive successful program execution, modernize network platforms, and support the growth of our business.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and manage project‑delivery network engineering teams and network operations teams supporting cloud and data center infrastructures.
  • Define and delegate engineering and project tasks; oversee project budgets, schedules, resource planning, and quality objectives.
  • Mentor and develop engineering managers and staff, enhancing both technical capabilities and essential soft skills.
  • Serve as escalation point for critical issues; assess situations and deliver timely, effective resolutions.

Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • Design, develop, and review technical network solutions aligned to customer requirements and organizational goals.
  • Drive innovation by researching emerging technologies, conducting pilots, evaluating vendors, and developing business cases.
  • Build scalable, resilient architectures using Cisco Data Center technologies, Palo Alto firewalls, cloud networking, and modern automation approaches.

Business Engagement & Growth

  • Support proposal development, solutioning, and service delivery efforts to help secure new business and re‑compete contracts.
  • Translate customer and program requirements into actionable technical and service solutions.
  • Work collaboratively across leadership, stakeholders, and clients to communicate program status, trends, risks, and opportunities.

Operational Excellence

  • Evaluate and improve existing policies, processes, and operational practices to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and overall performance.
  • Measure and assess product, process, and team performance; develop strategies and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to financial planning, ensuring technology decisions align with budget expectations and long‑term business impact.

  • 5+ years managing network engineering teams required; 7+ years strongly preferred
  • 3+ years hands‑on Network Engineering/Architecture experience
  • Experience with Cisco Data Center technologies
  • Experience with Palo Alto firewall platforms
  • Familiarity with enterprise and cloud networking solutions
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail, documentation, and requirements interpretation

Security Clearance Level: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret or higher clearance


US Citizenship Required

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Nurse Auditor 2 performs clinical audit/validation processes to ensure that medical record documentation and diagnosis coding for services rendered is complete, compliant and accurate to support optimal reimbursement. The Nurse Auditor 2 work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

The Nurse Auditor 2 validates and interprets medical documentation to ensure capture of all relevant coding. Identifies members with high risk CMS Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCC) and refers cases for annual follow-up care by disease management, case management, and primary care providers as appropriate for assessment/intervention. Identifies the root cause analysis of audit findings and submits recommendations for appropriate change management. Applies clinical and coding experience to conduct reviews of provider codes and billing. Understands department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas. Makes decisions regarding own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations, and requires minimal direction and receives guidance where needed. Follows established guidelines/procedures.


Use your skills to make an impact

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Medical Virtual Biller to join our remote operations team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Medical Virtual Biller to join our remote operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) tasks, with a heavy emphasis on patient benefit verification, tracking maximum benefits, and coordinating complex payer documentation.

If you have a strong background in U.S. healthcare billing, possess deep familiarity with insurance verification protocols, and excel at securing prior authorizations and clinical letters, we want to hear from you!

Requirements

  • Benefit Verification & Eligibility: Accurately verify patient insurance coverage, active policy status, copays, deductibles, coinsurance, and maximum benefit limits prior to service delivery.
  • Prior Authorizations & LOAs: Proactively initiate, track, and follow up on Letters of Authorization (LOAs) and pre-authorizations with insurance payers to ensure timely approvals and prevent claim denials.
  • Payer Correspondence & LOIs: Draft, compile, and submit Letters of Intent / Medical Necessity (LOIs) alongside clinical documentation to support appeals, gap-in-network exceptions, or specialized treatments.
  • Full-Cycle RCM Support: Handle tasks across the billing lifecycle, including charge entry, claim submission, payment posting, and handling accounts receivable (A/R) follow-ups or denials.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain meticulous records of payer interactions, authorization numbers, and patient financial clearances within our Electronic Health Record (EHR) / Practice Management systems while maintaining strict HIPAA compliance.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 2–3+ years of hands-on experience in U.S. Medical Billing, Medical Virtual Assisting, or RCM roles.
  • Core Knowledge: Proven expertise in handling insurance verification, calculating/tracking maximum benefits, and securing LOAs and LOIs.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with major U.S. EHR/PM platforms (e.g., Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Kareo, or similar systems) and clearinghouse portals.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate professionally with U.S.-based insurance providers, patients, and internal team members.
  • Home Setup: A reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25+ Mbps) and a quiet, secure, HIPAA-compliant home office workspace.

As the senior individual contributor delivery lead, this person turns governance tooling strategy into concrete implementation plans and owns their execution. They also manage two Senior Data Governance Architects. The Principal Data Governance Architect sets the architectural guardrails, and this role builds the implementation engine within them. The ideal candidate combines hands-on depth in catalog, data quality, and access-control tooling with the leadership to deliver across a complex, multi-platform data estate.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Governance Catalog Implementation: Lead the full implementation of the enterprise governance catalog (Informatica Cloud Data Governance & Catalog). This covers scanner configuration, taxonomy design, glossary seeding, and lineage mapping across legacy systems and modern platforms (for example, the enterprise data warehouse, Databricks, and Palantir Foundry), with consistency, auditability, and scalability as the goals.
  • Implementation Patterns & Technical Leadership: Define the implementation patterns that the Senior Data Governance Architects apply to their platform clusters. Be their main point of technical escalation. Mentor and develop team members in governance engineering best practices.

  • Automation & Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated metadata ingestion, data quality rule deployment, and alert-driven workflows that cut manual processing and make governance tooling faster and more reliable. Use scripting (Python, SQL) alongside platform-native automation.

While generic AI struggles with hallucinations and shallow analysis, Fortune 500 brands need strategic intelligence they can trust with billion-dollar decisions. We're building the specialized AI that delivers it.

We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.

Stravito transforms how Consumer Insights professionals and Brand Managers work by building AI that automates their core workflows while eliminating hallucinations. We help world-leading organizations across industries accelerate strategic decision-making by turning millions of market research documents into intelligent systems that generate reports, discover insights proactively, and synthesize knowledge across vast content libraries.


The Mission

Design plays a central role in how we build and talk about Stravito. You'll take our public website from where it is now to where it should be. You'll design and build the pages that matter most, tighten the theme everything runs on, and leave behind a site the next person can pick up and understand. Both halves of the work, done by one person, with no handover in the middle.

Who you'll work with

You'll work closely with our marketing team. They decide what the website needs to say. What we build in the product, and how we position it, reaches the website through them, and it moves fast. A lot of the work is campaign and landing pages for paid traffic, where every page has a clear job and someone is checking whether it does it.

You won't do this alone. Our Creative Director sets the art direction and creates the unique pieces when a page needs more than the system offers. Our Visual Designer makes campaign and content assets. An engineer is there for the heavy technical work. But the website is yours to drive, and the decisions about how it looks and how it's built are yours.

What you'll do

  • Design and build pages, campaign landing pages and new sections of stravito.com, from first sketch to live.

  • Turn positioning and campaign briefs into pages that work.

  • Build the modules that campaign and landing pages are made from, so marketing can move without waiting for you. Care about whether those pages convert.

  • Work in our HubSpot theme: templates, modules, the local build setup, and the discipline that keeps it tidy.

  • Write clean, hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript when the design needs more than the tools offer.

  • Keep the site fast, accessible and consistent. Treat performance and accessibility as design problems, not as someone else's checklist.

  • Document what you build and hand over a site someone else can run. This is part of the job from day one, not something for the last week.

  • Bring in the Creative Director and Visual Designer when a page needs art direction or new content, and run the rest on your own.

About you

  • You design and you code. You have several years of experience where you did the visual design and wrote the code that went live, on the same sites.

  • You have strong visual and typographic judgement. You can explain a layout decision without pointing at a mood board.

  • You're fluent in HTML and CSS, including modern layout, and comfortable enough with JavaScript to build the interactions you design.

  • You're comfortable in React, or close enough to be productive in a React codebase within a couple of weeks. HubSpot and HubL experience is a plus, not a must.

  • You know when to ask for help. An engineer is available for the hard technical parts, and people who use that support well move much faster than people who struggle alone.

  • You're happy to work from someone else's brief. Marketing decides what the site says. You decide how it looks and how it's built, with art direction from our Creative Director when a page needs it. If you need to own the message too, this isn't the right fit.

  • You build landing pages fast without leaving a mess. You use reusable modules where it makes sense and one-offs where speed matters, and you know the difference.

  • Reliable, able to self manage and keep people updated without being chased.

  • You use AI in your work.

Nice to have

  • Motion and interaction design, in code or in After Effects.

  • Experience with marketing websites for B2B software.

  • A personal website you built yourself and still like.

The practical details

  • Six-month contract, full time.

  • This is a contractor position.

  • Fully remote. You need to be based within two hours of Central European Time.

How to apply

The application form asks you to share two or three live sites and to tell us, for each one, what you designed and what you coded yourself. Please be specific.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.excerpt: Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes.
jobs.description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. As AI reshapes how software is built and used, we're building the foundation enterprises need to adopt it with confidence.

We're building the control plane for enterprise AI agents, enabling organizations to run, govern, and secure them on the infrastructure they already trust. Through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers running across Kubernetes and private cloud environments, AI agents can securely connect to internal data and systems while meeting the security, compliance, and operational requirements of highly regulated and security-conscious organizations. We've also extended this foundation to the model layer with an enterprise AI gateway.

The Stacklok Enterprise Platform is built on ToolHive, our open source MCP platform, and is already being adopted by leading technology companies and organizations in regulated industries. We also help maintain the official MCP registry and contribute openly to the community shaping the future of enterprise AI.

Location

This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

The Opportunity

Enterprises are moving AI agents from experimentation into production, and they need infrastructure that is secure, auditable, and runs behind their own firewall. As a Software Engineer II on Stacklok's core platform team, you will help build and harden the systems behind Stacklok Enterprise, the production distribution of ToolHive, the open source platform for running and governing MCP servers.

This is a hands-on role with real independence. You will deliver features and fix issues across the systems that let Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies run AI agents securely at scale, from the runtime that isolates MCP servers and the Kubernetes operator that manages them to the gateway, registry, and identity layers. You will go deep in one area while building a system-wide understanding of how the whole platform fits together.

The timing is what makes it compelling. Customers are signing on now, the platform is being hardened for their production environments, and you will build alongside engineers, managers, and product partners defining this category as it emerges.

What Success Looks Like: First 6-12 Months

  • Ramped quickly on the platform codebase and began contributing independently, self-organizing on tasks without needing close guidance.
  • Shipped your first features and fixes into an enterprise release within the first few months, then delivered core platform work consistently thereafter.
  • Resolved assigned production issues within SLA, keeping enterprise customers unblocked and their deployments stable.
  • Supported users in the open source ToolHive community, helping them resolve issues and get more value from the platform.
  • Strengthened the team by reviewing pull requests thoughtfully and building strong working relationships across engineering and product.

In This Role, You Will

  • Build and deliver features across the platform services that make up Stacklok Enterprise, including the runtime, Kubernetes operator, gateway, and registry.
  • Fix bugs and harden platform systems for enterprise production use, improving stability across customer deployments.
  • Write testable, readable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, and produce clear design docs for the work you take on.
  • Review pull requests and contribute to design discussions, working alongside technical leads, product, and fellow engineers on shared platform efforts.
  • Plan and sequence your own tasks and small epics independently, knowing when to pull in a teammate or escalate a design question.
  • Contribute to the open source ToolHive codebase and collaborate with community contributors on shared work.

Desired Skill & Experience

We do not expect every candidate to meet every point below. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we encourage you to apply.

  • Proficiency in Go, writing clean, testable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container technologies such as Docker, including isolation and networking, ideally in self-hosted environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver features independently across a backend or platform codebase, from implementation through testing and into a release.
  • Experience building or operating platform services such as APIs, gateways, Kubernetes operators, or release and deployment tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear design docs and give thoughtful code reviews that raise the quality of shared work.
  • Comfort collaborating in an open source environment. Familiarity with MCP or AI-agent infrastructure is a plus.
  • AI-first mindset: integrates AI tools into their development workflow to accelerate delivery and improve the quality of what they build.
  • Communication: excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain complex technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Startup mentality and intrinsic motivation: self-directed and hands-on, thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and drives clarity through action.

Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $157,500 - $192,500. In addition to base salary, this role offers equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Join Us?

At Stacklok, we believe great technology is built by teams that support, challenge, and inspire one another. We are AI maximalists, confident in its potential and committed to ensuring it is used in ways that are safe and sustainable.

You will join a highly motivated, collaborative team with deep experience building some of the world's most impactful technologies, with strong roots in open source, cloud-native technologies, security, and developer tools.

We offer competitive compensation and equity, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO and paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a flexible, hybrid-or-remote work environment, plus team offsites in unique destinations to collaborate and connect in person.

If you're excited about the future of AI and want to build alongside people who care deeply about their craft, their community, and each other, we would love to hear from you.

Stacklok Inc, is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. Sr Finance Business Partner - Commercial

➡️ Do you combine strong FP&A expertise with commercial curiosity and a drive to turn financial insights into business decisions?

➡️ Excited to partner directly with Commercial leaders, influencing sales strategy, investment decisions and sustainable growth?

➡️ Want to connect the dots between sales capacity, productivity and incentives to understand what drives commercial performance?

➡️ Ready to own planning and forecasting, challenge assumptions and help leaders decide what to do next? If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our Commercial organization, partnering closely with business leaders across our go-to-market teams. This is a highly business-facing finance role sitting at the intersection of Finance and the Commercial organization. The successful candidate will combine strong FP&A fundamentals with commercial acumen to help leadership understand performance, make informed investment decisions and drive sustainable growth.

The role will own financial planning and performance management for assigned business areas, with a strong focus on commercial performance, including ACV, sales capacity and productivity, incentive compensation, headcount investment, and business decision support. The role will have significant exposure to new logo acquisition and expansion while supporting the broader needs of the Commercial organization as priorities evolve.

This person will work closely with the Head of West Finance and will be expected to operate as a trusted finance partner to commercial leaders - going beyond reporting the numbers to understand what is driving performance, why it is changing, and what actions the business should take.

This is a remote position with a preference for candidates based on the U.S. East Coast who work Eastern Time hours, supporting close collaboration with our Commercial teams across the U.S., UK, and Canada.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, Series E, unicorn SaaS platform that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. More than 12,000 R&D and IP teams worldwide use and trust Patsnap to innovate and commercialize new products.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in Toronto, London, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

Finance Business Partnering & Commercial Support

  • Serve as a Finance Business Partner for assigned Commercial teams and business areas, developing a strong understanding of sales motions, product mix, customer segments and key performance drivers.

  • Partner closely with Commercial leadership and cross-functional teams to translate financial and operational data into actionable insights and support business decisions.

  • Provide financial perspective on resource allocation, growth initiatives, investment decisions, and risks and opportunities.

Commercial Performance & Sales Capacity

  • Own sales capacity and productivity analysis, including headcount, hiring and ramp assumptions, quota capacity, attainment, pipeline and other key commercial drivers.

  • Analyze ACV/bookings and broader commercial performance versus plan and forecast, identifying the underlying drivers of over- or under-performance.

  • Partner with Commercial leadership and Revenue Operations to strengthen forecasting, scenario planning and visibility into business performance.

Sales Commissions & Incentives

  • Support the design and ongoing management of sales commission and incentive plans, ensuring alignment with commercial priorities and desired behaviors.

  • Provide financial analysis and insights around commission structures, performance and effectiveness to support business decisions.

  • Partner with Commercial leadership, Revenue Operations, HR and Finance stakeholders on commission-related planning and continuous improvement.

FP&A, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead budgeting, quarterly and rolling forecasts, and monthly budget-versus-actual analysis for assigned business areas.

  • Build driver-based forecasts connecting commercial assumptions, headcount and operating plans to financial outcomes.

  • Partner with business leaders on headcount planning, investment decisions, risks and opportunities while working closely with the broader FP&A team on company-wide planning.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Provide recurring and ad hoc analysis across commercial performance, product mix, sales productivity, headcount, commissions and investments.

  • Develop clear, scalable reporting that helps leadership understand what changed, why it changed and the implications for the business.

  • Work closely with Accounting and cross-functional teams to ensure financial results are understood and connected to underlying business performance.

Requirements

What We'd Love From You:

  • 5–8 years of progressive experience in FP&A, commercial finance, sales finance or Finance Business Partnering.

  • Strong experience supporting a Sales or broader Go-to-Market organization within a SaaS, enterprise software or technology company.

  • Demonstrated experience with sales capacity, productivity and topline forecasting models.

  • Experience with sales commissions and incentive compensation, including commission modeling and/or plan design, strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS commercial metrics and revenue drivers, including ACV/ARR, new logo, expansion, renewals, quota attainment, pipeline, sales productivity and rep ramp.

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, with advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience working with CRM and financial/planning systems; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong business acumen and ability to connect operational and commercial decisions to financial outcomes.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge assumptions and influence business partners.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.

What Success Looks Like:

The successful candidate will become a trusted finance partner to Commercial leadership, combining strong financial discipline with a deep understanding of the business. They will bring greater visibility and rigor to commercial performance, sales capacity, productivity, incentive compensation and investment decisions; improve the quality and predictability of forecasts; and help business leaders understand not only what happened, but why it happened and what actions should follow.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 24/7 employee assistance program which provides access to virtual healthcare, therapy, financial and legal assistance, wellness counselling and resources for family support.

The base salary range for this role is $110,000–$130,000 USD, plus eligibility for a performance-based bonus with a target equivalent to two months of base salary. Actual bonus payouts depend on individual and company performance.

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionOcean is building the future of email security.
jobs.description:
Description

Ocean is building the future of email security.

The attacks getting through today often look completely normal. AI did not invent targeted phishing or social engineering. It changed the economics of it. What once required a highly skilled attacker can now be created at scale, in minutes, and often looks like a completely legitimate message from someone you trust.

Ocean is the first agentic email security platform built for this new reality. Our agents investigate suspicious emails the way a great security analyst would: understanding context, following the evidence, and explaining what they find.

Founded in 2024 by Shay Shwartz and Oran Moyal, who spent years building targeted email attacks for homeland security, Ocean is the system they know would have stopped them. Today, we protect hundreds of thousands of mailboxes and analyze more than a billion emails every month for companies including Kayak, Headspace, and Fortune 500 enterprises. We're backed by $28M from Lightspeed Venture Partners, Picture Capital, Cerca Partners, and some of the best operators in cybersecurity. We're headquartered in New York and Tel Aviv.

And we're just getting started. This is an enormous market opportunity. The problem is getting harder, the category is changing quickly, and Ocean is growing fast.

We're hiring our Head of Product Marketing

﻿

This is not a role where you inherit a team or a playbook and spend your time managing it. You'll be the team (at least to start) and define how Ocean tells its story, creates demand, and shows up in the market from the ground up.

﻿

We also don't want you to spend the first month executing a template. We want you to spend it figuring out what Ocean actually needs, in what order, and then tell us. Some of what we think we need will turn out to be wrong, and we'd rather hear that from you early than politely later.

You'll work in genuine co-ownership with our head of product, not adjacent to her. Our product and R&D team is in Tel Aviv and ships fast. Our sales and field teams are in the US. You'll be the connective tissue between them, which in practice means holding your early mornings ET open for Israel. It's also the best part of the job, because you'll get closer to how the product actually works than most product marketers ever get to be.

You'll help turn a genuinely differentiated product and an incredibly interesting problem into stories and experiences that make people understand Ocean, remember Ocean, and want to learn more.

We move quickly. Good ideas can become real very fast. We care about quality, but we don't believe great work requires endless meetings, layers of approval, or bureaucracy. You'll have real ownership, direct access to the people making decisions, and a huge amount of room to make your mark.

If you want to join a company at a moment when your work can have a disproportionate impact, work on one of the most interesting problems in security, and build something that you can genuinely look back and say you created, this is a rare opportunity.

Responsibilities

Own Ocean's story

Develop and evolve how we position Ocean in the market, including how we're different from the alternatives buyers are already considering. Build messaging that is clear, differentiated, and compelling, and adapt it for the audiences and moments that matter most.

Turn complex technology into something people care about

You don't need to be able to build what our engineers build. You do need to know what to ask them. What did you assess before you built this, who is it for, what pain does it remove, why now. Then turn those answers into a reason a buyer should care, in language a buyer actually uses.

﻿Build the content engine, don't become it

You'll write, and you'll write a lot, especially early. But the goal is not for you to be the place all content comes from. It's for you to build the system that produces it: the single source of truth, the AI workflows on top of it, the structures that let a rep generate a tailored one-pager without waiting on you. Volume matters here, and so does not being the bottleneck. If in year one every piece of content still has to pass through your hands, we've built the wrong thing.

To be clear about that first year, though: you will be writing and making a great deal of this yourself. There is no one to hand it to, and we are not hiring someone to design a system and wait for it to produce. The system is what you build while you're shipping, not instead of shipping.

Make enablement programmatic

Give our sales and customer-facing teams the messaging, materials, narratives, and content they need, including the competitive work: how we talk about the alternatives and how we handle the objections that show up in real deals. Then go further than shipping the asset. If we ask for a new pitch deck, we want the deck and a view on whether the story is actually landing, what would fix it, and how we'll know. Stay close to what's happening in deals, including why we win and why we lose.

Shape how Ocean shows up in the market

Help build Ocean's voice and presence across the places and conversations that matter most, including how buyers discover and evaluate us when they're researching on their own. You'll have significant freedom to experiment with new formats, channels, and ideas, and you'll help identify opportunities to get Ocean into the conversations our buyers and the security community care about.

﻿Lead major product and company moments

Help lead how we introduce important product and company moments to the world. From the initial story through execution, you'll help ensure that the work is clear, compelling, coordinated, and actually gets noticed.

Build the function

You're our first product marketer. You'll define what great product marketing looks like at Ocean, and that starts with diagnosis rather than prescription. We're less interested in which programs you'd stand up than in how you'd decide what Ocean needs first, and what you'd deliberately leave alone for now. Spend your first few weeks listening hard, then come back with a point of view and start shipping against it.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who has owned product marketing inside a cybersecurity startup and knows what it takes to operate in a fast-moving, highly technical market. We care much more about what you've shipped recently than about how many years you've been doing this.

You should have:

  • Product marketing experience at a cybersecurity startup. This is a must. You understand the security market, how security buyers think, and what it takes to market a complex technical product in a crowded category.
  • Exceptional content creation and writing skills. You can take an idea, technical insight, product capability, customer problem, or emerging trend and turn it into compelling content that educates the market, builds credibility, creates demand, and gives our sales team something worth sharing. You're at ease writing for US buyers, analysts, press, and the broader security community, and you create excellent work yourself rather than briefing agencies or managing freelancers.
  • Experience owning positioning and messaging. You know how to take a technical product and figure out what matters, who it matters to, and how to communicate why it is different from what else is out there. You can turn that thinking into messaging and content that people actually remember.
  • Experience leading analyst briefings yourself. You can sit across from Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and other industry analysts, clearly explain a technical product and point of view, answer hard questions, and build credibility.
  • The instinct to interrogate rather than accept. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need real curiosity about how things work, and the confidence to keep asking product and engineering questions until you understand something well enough to explain it simply and accurately.
  • Experience operating as the whole product marketing function, or close to it. You are comfortable owning a broad surface area, moving from strategy to execution, and figuring out what needs to happen without waiting for someone to hand you a perfectly defined plan.
  • You build with AI, not just alongside it. AI is embedded in how you work, and you've made things with it that other people use. Not prompts you keep to yourself, but workflows, agents, and systems that let a team move faster than it could without you in the loop.
  • Comfort appearing on camera and communicating publicly. You're at ease explaining complex security concepts, sharing a point of view, and telling technical stories to an external audience.

The person we're really looking for: You're unusually curious.

When someone tells you something interesting, your instinct is to ask more questions. When you encounter a technical concept you don't understand, you want to keep digging until you do. When a new AI tool comes out, you've probably already tried it.

You diagnose before you prescribe. Handed a new company, your first move isn't to open the playbook. It's to listen hard, work out where the real constraint is, and go after that even when it isn't the obvious or most impressive thing to fix.

You're a creator at heart. You see an interesting technical problem, product insight, customer story, or shift in the market and immediately start thinking about the story. You can turn that thinking into something people actually want to read, watch, share, and talk about.

You think in systems. When something is going to happen more than twice, your instinct is to build the thing that makes it repeatable rather than doing it again by hand.

You can move between worlds comfortably. You can spend time with an engineer getting deep into how something works, then turn around and explain why it matters to a CISO, a sales team, an analyst, or someone who has never heard of it before.

You have strong taste and high standards, but you're not precious about your work. You want feedback. You change your mind when the evidence says you should. You care about getting to the best answer.

And because this is an early-stage company, you need to genuinely enjoy the building part. There will be ambiguity. There will be things nobody has done before. You should find that exciting, not frustrating.

Most importantly, you're someone who wants to understand the future before everyone else does, and then help explain it to the world.

How to apply

Send us your CV along with three things you made yourself in the last 12 months.

Blogs, white papers, launch materials, videos, presentations, customer stories, or anything else you're genuinely proud of. We care much more about seeing how you think and create than seeing a perfect list of logos on your resume.

Please send work that you personally created, rather than work you only managed or briefed someone else to produce. And if any of it surfaces when you ask an AI assistant about the topic, tell us which piece and what you asked. We'll read the work before the resume.

Talkspace is a leading virtual behavioral healthcare provider committed to helping people lead healthier, happier lives through access to high-quality mental healthcare. At Talkspace, we believe that mental healthcare is core to overall health and should be available to everyone.

Talkspace pioneered the ability to text with a licensed therapist from anywhere and now offers a comprehensive suite of mental health services, including therapy for individuals, teens, and couples, as well as psychiatric treatment and medication management (18+). With Talkspace’s core therapy offerings, members are matched with one of thousands of licensed therapists within days and can engage in live video, audio, or chat sessions, and/or unlimited asynchronous text messaging sessions.

All care offered at Talkspace is delivered through an easy-to-use, fully-encrypted web and mobile platform that meets HIPAA, federal, and state regulatory requirements. More than 151 million Americans have access to Talkspace through their health insurance plans, employee assistance programs, our partnerships with leading healthcare companies, or as a free benefit through their employer, school, or government agency.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Job Title: Senior Digital Product Strategy and Innovation Manager (AI)

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Digital Product Strategy and Innovation Manager (AI)

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We are seeking a Senior Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Lab Product Management Team. This role will lead the identification, evaluation, and validation of high-potential AI and data-driven opportunities across Amgen, shaping strategic opportunities and providing evidence-based recommendations that inform enterprise investment and scaling decisions.

The Senior Digital Product Manager will establish product discovery and validation approaches that enable Amgen to determine where AI can create meaningful business and patient value, where opportunities warrant further investment, and where initiatives should be redirected, paused, or stopped.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the identification, framing, prioritization, and validation of a variety of AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen, ensuring resources and validation efforts are focused on opportunities with the greatest potential enterprise value and strategic alignment.
  • Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, solution architects, platform teams, and cybersecurity partners to shape solution concepts, understand technical tradeoffs, and identify dependencies early in the validation process.
  • Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
  • Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
  • Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
  • Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives.
  • Provide senior leaders with clear, evidence-based recommendations on investment, prioritization, scaling, and termination decisions, including explicit articulation of tradeoffs, uncertainties, dependencies, and risks.
  • Own and actively manage a portfolio of AI opportunities across discovery, prototype, pilot, and scale-readiness stages, balancing strategic value, feasibility, risk, resource requirements, dependencies, and organizational readiness.
  • Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
  • Lead executive and cross-functional decision forums that align business, scientific, technology, data, security, and governance stakeholders around opportunity priorities, product direction, technical tradeoffs, investment decisions, and paths to scale. Navigate competing perspectives and drive clarity and decisions in ambiguous or high-impact situations.
  • Translate Amgen business and transformation priorities, emerging AI capabilities, technology strategy, and portfolio learnings into strategic product opportunity areas, identifying where reusable capabilities, platforms, data assets, or common patterns can create value across multiple functions rather than through isolated point solutions.
  • Provide product leadership, coaching, and thought partnership to product managers and cross-functional teams, helping raise the maturity of AI product discovery, experimentation, evidence-based decision making, and product management practices across the organization.
  • Act as a thought leader for AI product management, bringing external product, technology, and industry perspectives into Amgen and translating emerging AI capabilities into practical implications for enterprise product strategy.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Senior Digital Product Manager professional we seek has these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience

OR

Master’s degree and 6 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years of experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.
  • 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments, independently frame complex problems, make sound recommendations with incomplete information, and drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience leading AI or data products through discovery, validation, investment decision, and scale.
  • Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.
  • Understanding of data architecture concepts, including data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, APIs, metadata, master data, data governance, and data quality.
  • Experience shaping product strategy and investment decisions involving enterprise AI platforms and capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional product decisions across business, engineering, architecture, data, security, and governance teams.
  • Experience establishing and leading product discovery and experimentation approaches across multiple complex initiatives.
  • Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness.
  • Experience developing business cases, opportunity assessments, technical feasibility summaries, executive narratives, or investment recommendations.
  • Familiarity with biotech, pharmaceutical, R&D, manufacturing, medical, or enterprise business workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive decisions through clear product narratives, recommendations, and evidence.
  • Hands-on ability to analyze user feedback, usage data, workflow metrics, model outputs, experiment results, or AI product performance.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments where priorities evolve quickly.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.excerpt: Accurate books.  Clear answers.  Better decisions.
jobs.description:
Accurate books. Clear answers. Better decisions.

You enjoy getting the numbers right. You also want to understand what they mean, what needs attention, and how the business can run better because of them.

We’re looking for a Controller who can own our internal finances, bring useful insight to leadership, and improve the systems behind the work. Someone who is equally comfortable reconciling an account, building a cash-flow forecast, and explaining why a trend deserves attention.

If your idea of a satisfying day includes solving a financial puzzle and retiring an unnecessarily complicated spreadsheet, we should talk.

A little about us

R.D. Barnett PLLC is a growing tax, accounting, and advisory firm serving entrepreneurs and privately held businesses. PracticeDen, our veterinary-focused brand, helps independent veterinary practice owners navigate the financial side of ownership from startup through succession.

Relationships matter here. So does clear communication, thoughtful work, and follow through. We take our responsibilities seriously, keep our personalities intact, and continually look for better ways to serve our clients and support our team.

We’re technology-forward and comfortable questioning how things have always been done. We want people who bring ideas, exercise judgment, and help turn a good suggestion into a working process.

The role

As Controller, you’ll own the firm’s day-to-day finance work and provide the analysis and recommendations that help leadership make informed decisions.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll personally manage accounting, billing, receivables, payables, payroll, and close activities while building stronger reporting, forecasts, controls, and workflows. You’ll also oversee benefits administration and selected operational projects connected to finance, employees, vendors, insurance, and systems.

Working directly with our Finance Operations Manager, you’ll have meaningful responsibility and room to improve how the work gets done. Success means dependable financial operations, fewer surprises, and leadership that can act on the numbers with confidence.

What you’ll actually do

Keep the financial foundation solid.

  • Maintain accurate books and records for R.D. Barnett PLLC and PracticeDen.
  • Complete and review reconciliations, journal entries, schedules, and month-end close work.
  • Own accounts receivable and accounts payable.
  • Maintain a weekly cadence for invoices, payments, A/R reconciliation, collections, and outstanding balances.
  • Apply and reconcile payments across QuickBooks, Practice CS, Anchor, CPACharge, Ignition, and other systems.
  • Resolve billing discrepancies, unapplied payments, credits, and unusual transactions.
  • Prepare excise-tax filings and related recurring compliance work.
  • Maintain complete supporting documentation and a reliable financial close calendar.
  • Coordinate with outside accounting, tax, banking, legal, insurance, and benefit partners.
  • Escalate material matters to the Managing Member when leadership approval is required.

Turn financial information into useful decisions.

  • Perform a higher-level review of the firm’s financial activity and records.
  • Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow projections.
  • Produce budget-to-actual and financial-performance reporting.
  • Analyze revenue, expenses, margins, staffing costs, cash flow, and operational trends.
  • Identify financial risks, unusual activity, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial results into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Support hiring, compensation, pricing, investment, and growth decisions with financial analysis.
  • Help leadership understand what happened, why it happened, and what should happen next.

Make payroll and employee-related finance dependable.

  • Own payroll preparation, verification, processing, and records.
  • Manage routine benefit enrollments, changes, terminations, and employee communication.
  • Review expense reimbursements within established policies and approval limits.
  • Coordinate finance-related onboarding and offboarding.
  • Evaluate benefit and insurance options and manage renewals with leadership and outside partners.

Build systems that make the work better.

  • Establish practical financial controls, approval paths, and documented procedures.
  • Manage finance-related vendor relationships and selected operational projects.
  • Keep recurring commitments, deadlines, and responsibilities visible.
  • Improve workflows across QuickBooks, Practice CS, Ignition, Anchor, Double, Missive, Excel, and related tools.
  • Use automation and AI intentionally, with appropriate confidentiality, verification, and human review.

What you bring

  • Strong accounting experience. You’ve owned a full accounting cycle, including month-end close, reconciliations, financial statements, and supporting schedules.
  • Financial judgment. You can build forecasts, interpret results, identify risks, and make recommendations that go beyond reporting the totals.
  • Hands-on ownership. You’re comfortable completing the recurring work yourself and building a more efficient process around it.
  • Payroll and operational fluency. You have experience with payroll, billing, receivables, payables, and the coordination required to keep them running reliably.
  • Strong Excel and systems skills. You can organize data, build useful analyses, troubleshoot discrepancies, and learn new platforms quickly.
  • Clear communication. You explain financial information in plain language and share updates before someone has to ask.
  • Sound discretion. You handle financial, payroll, benefits, and employee information carefully.
  • Curiosity with follow-through. You question inefficient processes, test improvements, and document what works.

Experience in a CPA firm or another professional-services business is especially helpful. A CPA or CMA credential, benefits administration experience, and familiarity with our systems are welcome advantages.

You’ll probably enjoy working here if…

You like having ownership and being accountable for the outcome. You can move between detailed work and the bigger picture without losing either. You’re comfortable with a growing firm where some processes need refinement and others need to be built.

You communicate directly, welcome thoughtful feedback, and raise concerns while there’s still time to address them. You care about making life easier for your teammates. And you take the work seriously without taking yourself too seriously.

What success looks like

The books are accurate, supported, and closed on schedule. Billing, collections, payments, payroll, and benefits administration run reliably. Leadership receives reporting that helps them make decisions. Issues surface early, responsibilities are clear, and recurring work moves forward without repeated follow-up.

Over your first 90 days, you’ll learn our systems, assume ownership of core responsibilities, strengthen financial visibility, and develop a prioritized plan for further improvements.

Pay, benefits, and the practical stuff

  • Salary: $110,000-$135,000, based on experience and demonstrated capability.
  • Remote work: Within approved U.S. work locations, with dependable availability for Pacific Time collaboration and scheduled meetings.
  • Equipment: The firm provides the computer and standard technology equipment needed for the role, including monitors, keyboard, mouse, headset, and related accessories.
  • Medical, dental, and vision: The firm currently pays 100% of the employee premium for its medical plan (BCBS PPO) and dental and vision plans (Delta Dental PPO). Coverage begins on the first day of the month following the employee's start date. Dependents may be added at the employee's cost. Benefits remain subject to plan terms.
  • 401(k): The firm currently matches employee contributions up to 3% of eligible pay. Eligibility begins on the employee's start date, subject to plan terms and the applicable vesting schedule.
  • Paid holidays: Ten in total: Six firm holidays - New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day - plus four floating holidays.
  • Vacation: 22 vacation days per calendar year, prorated based on the official start date. Vacation is subject to the firm calendar and busy-season blackout periods.
  • Paid sick and safe time: Accrual begins on the first day of employment. The firm uses Seattle's paid sick and safe time requirements as its minimum standard and applies any more protective law required by the employee's work location.
  • Volunteer time: Two paid volunteer days.
  • Professional development: Continuing education and growth opportunities, including reimbursement for approved certification, licensing, professional membership, and destination CPE expenses within firm policy.
  • Optional cell-phone coverage: Participation in the firm's Verizon plan is available under the current cell-phone policy. The firm does not subsidize or reimburse the purchase of the device.
  • Personal tax support: Employees may use firm software to prepare their personal income tax returns and may request reasonable tax guidance from the firm's principals at no charge, subject to firm policy.

How to Apply and How to Stand Out

We notice thoughtful follow-up. A respectful LinkedIn message or direct email to a member of our team after applying can help us understand your interest and how you communicate. Please keep it human, specific, and concise. We’d love to hear what you’ve owned, what you’ve improved, and why this opportunity caught your attention.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

R.D. Barnett PLLC is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact .

Our Business

team.blueis an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group, with a team of more than 3,000 experts serving 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue’s brands span traditional hosting businesses — offering domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server solutions — as well as specialist SaaS providers offering compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad portfolio makesteam.bluea one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Analytics Engineer to join our AI & Data function. This role sits at the critical intersection between our Data Management team (responsible for ingesting raw data into our Databricks-based data platform) and our Analytics team (responsible for insights and reporting).

You will take raw data, at various stages of conforming, and transform it into trusted, analytics-ready datasets — building KPIs, semantic models, and data products that feed our presentation and reporting layers. Working across a wide variety of data domains (marketing, product usage, customer care, revenue, and more), you will need to be intellectually curious, self-directed, and proactive: comfortable exploring unfamiliar data landscapes with limited guidance, engaging business partners to understand what the data really means, and making sound judgement calls independently.

We need someone we can trust to pick up a new data domain, figure it out, and deliver at pace. Reporting to the Director of Analytics, you will work closely with data engineers, analytics engineers, and business stakeholders across the group.

Where you sit in the team

The Data function is structured around three layers:

  • Data Management:Ingests raw data from all sources into the Databricks platform. Owns the bronze/raw layer.
  • Analytics Engineering → YOU:Takes raw data, conforms and transforms it, builds KPI definitions and semantic models, and delivers reliable data products to the presentation layer.
  • Analytics & Insights:Consumes the analytics-ready data to produce dashboards, reports and strategic insights for the business.

Key responsibilities:

Data Transformation & Modelling

  • Design and build robust dbt models on Databricks that transform raw, ingested data into clean, conformed, and analytics-ready datasets.
  • Define and implement KPI logic in collaboration with business and analytics stakeholders, ensuring consistent definitions across domains.
  • Maintain and evolve the semantic/presentation layer, ensuring data products are reliable, tested, documented, and performant.
  • Apply software engineering best practices to analytics code: version control, testing, CI/CD, and documentation.

Cross-Domain Data Exploration

  • Independently onboard new data domains (e.g. marketing attribution, product usage, customer care, subscription data) with limited guidance — exploring the data, understanding its structure and meaning, and deciding how to best model it.
  • Proactively engage business partners and domain owners to understand context, validate assumptions, and align on KPI definitions.
  • Identify data quality issues early and work with the Data Management team to resolve them at source.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Act as the connective tissue between data engineers and analysts: translating analytical needs into engineering tasks, and surfacing data realities back to the business.
  • Work with the Analytics team to ensure the presentation layer meets reporting and self-service needs.
  • Contribute to data governance: naming conventions, lineage documentation, and model cataloguing.
  • Support the broader team in extending analytics coverage to new brands and domains over time.

Required Experience/skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related data role.
  • Strong, hands-on proficiency with dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud) — this is a core requirement.
  • Experience working on Databricks (or a comparable cloud data platform such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modelling, data vault, or similar data warehousing patterns.
  • SQL excellence: complex transformations, window functions, query optimisation.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously across multiple data domains simultaneously, figuring out unfamiliar data with limited documentation.
  • Strong analytical mindset: able to interrogate data critically, spot anomalies, and validate logic end-to-end.
  • Excellent communication skills — comfortable talking directly with business stakeholders to elicit requirements and explain data concepts.
  • Experience working across diverse data domains (e.g. marketing, product analytics, customer care, financial/subscription data).

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with SaaS GTM tooling and metrics — e.g. Amplitude, HubSpot, or similar marketing and product analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Python for data transformation or pipeline orchestration.
  • Exposure to BI/visualisation layers (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and how they consume semantic models.
  • Experience in a multi-brand or portfolio company context.
  • Background in a consulting or contractor capacity: comfortable delivering impact quickly in complex environments.

Right to Work

country you’re applying for. Unfortunately, we are unable to support relocation

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for solving complex challenges and driving meaningful impact for patients, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team.


HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is a field-based patient access and reimbursement specialist responsible for supporting patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and sites of care in navigating insurance coverage and reimbursement pathways for Amgen therapies.

The PAL serves as a key resource in helping stakeholders understand payer requirements, prior authorization processes, reimbursement considerations, and available patient support resources. The role focuses on ensuring timely and sustained access to therapy by addressing reimbursement barriers and providing education to patients and providers on coverage and financial assistance programs.

Working within a collaborative field environment, the PAL partners with internal teams including Market Access, Medical Affairs, Advocacy, Marketing, Case Management, and Site of Care teams to support the patient journey. The role operates with independence in managing assigned patient cases and contributes field insights that inform broader access strategies.
