VDC Operations Manager

Fully Remote

The VDC Operations Manager will lead the operational and people-management functions supporting a growing BIM/VDC organization. This position oversees project workflows, team capacity, client escalations, process development, and the ongoing coaching and development of BIM/VDC coordinators.

The role requires a combination of construction/AEC project management experience, hands-on BIM/VDC knowledge, and proven people leadership. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between technical project issues, team development, client communication, and operational planning.

This is a fully remote leadership position with significant opportunity to develop processes, systems, and team structure as the organization grows.

VDC Operations Manager Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee project and contract-management processes across the BIM/VDC portfolio.
  • Monitor project schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and document control.
  • Manage, coach, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators through regular one-on-one meetings, feedback, training, and individual development plans.
  • Provide technical and operational support when team members encounter complex coordination issues.
  • Monitor team workload, project assignments, and capacity to identify resource needs before they affect project performance.
  • Partner with technical quality leadership to align project processes with BIM/VDC standards.
  • Serve as an escalation point for clients and general contractors regarding schedule, scope, coordination, and process issues.
  • Coordinate with estimating and project leadership on scope, pricing, budget, and drawing-related questions.
  • Monitor project changes and help ensure contractual changes are properly documented and communicated.
  • Develop and improve operational systems for project tracking, reporting, onboarding, resource planning, and team performance.
  • Establish consistent workflows across MEP and structural VDC projects.
  • Identify recurring operational problems and develop sustainable solutions rather than relying on short-term fixes.
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, training, and long-term development of the VDC team.
  • Promote effective communication, accountability, quality, and collaboration across a distributed team.
  • Maintain appropriate cybersecurity and data-protection practices for client information and project files.

Required Qualifications for VDC Operations Manager

  • Previous experience directly managing and developing employees.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting one-on-one meetings, providing performance feedback, and creating employee development plans.
  • Experience managing construction, design, or AEC project workflows involving schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project documentation.
  • Professional background in BIM/VDC coordination or a closely related AEC, MEP, or construction discipline.
  • Strong hands-on experience with BIM/VDC processes, including clash detection, drawing production, RFIs, and submittals.
  • Working proficiency with Revit, Autodesk Fabrication CADmep, Navisworks, and Autodesk Construction Cloud or similar platforms.
  • Ability to understand technical coordination issues well enough to review work, coach team members, and participate in problem-solving.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable managing client and general contractor escalations.
  • Ability to provide direct, constructive feedback and hold team members accountable.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Sound judgment regarding cybersecurity and protection of confidential project information.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications for VDC Operations Manager

  • Experience working for or closely with specialty subcontractors or trade contractors.
  • Experience developing new processes, systems, or workflows within a growing organization.
  • Experience managing remote or geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience across multiple VDC disciplines, including MEP and structural coordination.
  • Experience supporting organizational growth, recruiting, or team expansion.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically credible BIM/VDC professional who has successfully transitioned into people and operational leadership. They can coach a coordinator through a technical problem, identify a process weakness across multiple projects, communicate effectively with a client or GC, and make practical decisions about staffing and workload.

This person should be comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist and developing both people and processes as the organization grows.

jobs.description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens is establishing a dedicated finance function, and the Finance Operations Specialist is the first position on the team. The role reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and manages the day-to-day billing, accounts receivable, collections, accounts payable, and procurement processes. These processes currently run across multiple spreadsheets, inboxes, and systems. Working closely with the CFO, the Finance Operations Specialist will help consolidate them into documented, repeatable workflows that support the company's growth.

The Finance Operations Specialist will manage invoicing and receivables for both the Single Event and Mass Tort segments, including multi-claimant mass tort invoices. Responsibilities include applying incoming payments, managing past-due balances, and serving as the primary finance contact for law firm clients on billing inquiries, disputes, and payment terms. The role also manages accounts payable and supports procurement, with Ramp as the system for vendor onboarding, purchase approvals, contracts, and payments. Daily work is performed in Ramp, Bill.com, QuickBooks Online, the company's online bank accounts, and the Zipliens portal.

The successful candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and accountable for results. The position is primarily hands-on, with opportunities to contribute to process design, including collections strategy by client segment, automation of routine client communications, and management reporting.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Manage invoicing process for Single Event and Mass Tort clients in the Zipliens portal, including multi-claimant mass tort invoices
  • Oversee the daily intake and deposit of physical checks, and apply all payments received by check, Stripe, Bill.com, and wire to the correct invoices
  • Reconcile invoices against payments, resolve discrepancies, and keep the portal and accounting records in agreement
  • Maintain the AR aging and report on past-due balances, collection progress, and cash expected to the CFO on a set cadence
  • Support month-end close by delivering reconciled receivables and payment batches on schedule
  • Serve as the primary finance contact for law firm clients on billing questions, disputes, and overdue balances
  • Carry out collections by client segment, following an approach set with the CFO, adjusting for clients with longer payment timelines, such as probate matters
  • Negotiate payment plans, settle disputed balances, and escalate accounts to the CFO when needed
  • Keep account activity visible in the portal so sales, account management, and lien resolution teams know where each balance stands and don't duplicate outreach
  • Manage the accounts payable process on Ramp: vendor onboarding, bill intake, coding, approval routing, and payment runs
  • Support the rollout of Ramp as our procurement system, administer purchase requests, approval workflows, spend policies, and card limits according to policies set by the CFO
  • Maintain a central record of vendor contracts, terms, renewal dates, and recurring subscriptions
  • Review recurring spend and flag duplicate tools, unused subscriptions, and renewals that need a decision
  • Collect W-9s and maintain the vendor data needed for year-end 1099 reporting
  • Document the billing, collections, AP, and procurement workflows, and keep them current as they change
  • Help identify and support automation, including scheduled invoice reminders and digests, payment matching, and AI-assisted tasks
  • Work with the product and technology teams on invoicing and payment features in the Zipliens portal

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, or finance operations, including at least 1–2 years owning a process end to end
  • Experience with collections, including negotiating payment terms and resolving disputes directly with clients
  • Experience with tools such as Ramp, Bill.com, QuickBooks Online, and online, or similar platforms, and a willingness to learn new systems
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, with the ability to manage large data sets and reconcile across systems
  • Clear, professional written communication with clients and vendors
  • Experience working remotely and independently
  • Billing experience in legal services, healthcare, or another high-volume service business is a plus

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)

  • Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time & 10 paid Holidays)
  • Parental Leave

jobs.description:
About Very

Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.

We believe that real innovation happens in the grind, working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well.

We’ve built a collaborative, tight-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance.

Our clients include well-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: help them win.

About this role

The Engagement Lead is a distinct career track at Very — separate from engineering and program management — built around a single accountability: the outcome of the client engagement.

PMs run the machine. Engagement Leads own the outcome.

This is a client-facing, commercially-minded role. You will personally own 1–3 active client relationships at a time, ensuring that Very is delivering real business value, that engagements are healthy and profitable, and that clients are growing with us. You will operate at high billability (60–80%), meaning you are not overhead — you are contributing directly to the work while simultaneously holding the altitude of the overall engagement.

You will sit at the intersection of client trust, technical delivery, and business development. The best Engagement Leads are builders who have learned to sell, or sellers who have learned to build — people who are as comfortable writing a Statement of Work as they are reviewing a sprint report.

What you’ll own

Client Relationship & Outcomes

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for 1–3 client engagements simultaneously
  • Maintain client trust at the working level — know your stakeholders, understand their business, and be the person they call when something feels off
  • Drive alignment between client expectations and what Very can actually deliver
  • Escalate early and with a recommendation — never let a problem become a surprise
  • We're remote-first, but travel within the US is part of the job — show up in person when it strengthens client relationships & deliverables

Commercial Ownership

  • Own the profitability of your engagements — understand margin, monitor burn, and proactively flag risk
  • Write and negotiate Statements of Work for new phases and follow-on engagements
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and close them
  • Participate in the sales process for new opportunities — Very's best Engagement Leads are part of the commercial motion

Delivery Health

  • Accountable for the health of delivery on your engagements — scope, schedule, and quality
  • Make tradeoff calls with confidence; bring options, not just problems
  • On smaller engagements (≤ $250–400K, single workstream, small team): run the cadence yourself — standups, sprint planning, milestone reviews
  • On larger engagements: partner with a PM who runs execution; you shift altitude to steering, scope management, and client strategy

Team & Culture

  • Coach team members on what it means to work in a client services organization — communication, expectation management, escalation
  • Model the standard for how Very engages with clients

What success looks like

In the first 90 days:

  • Named as engagement owner on at least one active client; client and internal team know you own it
  • Strong working relationships established with key client stakeholders
  • Reporting consistently in Program Tactical; no surprises to leadership

In year one:

  • 80%+ of clients renew or expand under your ownership
  • At least one new SOW written and closed without direct leadership involvement
  • Engagements you own are consistently at or below budget with healthy margins
  • Your clients would call you first — not Very leadership — when they have a concern or an idea

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (or equivalent hands-on experience) and time spent working as a practicing engineer earlier in your career
  • Technical fluency sufficient to earn the respect of engineering teams and translate client needs into actionable scope
  • 5+ years of experience in client services, technical program management, or a delivery-facing role at a technology consulting or product company
  • Demonstrated experience owning client relationships — not just supporting them
  • Ability to write and negotiate Statements of Work independently
  • Experience managing project budgets and financial indicators
  • Excellent communication skills — written, verbal, and in the room; able to present to executives and lead difficult conversations
  • Experience with IoT, connected hardware, or complex technical product development strongly preferred

Strongly Preferred

  • Background in electronics hardware, firmware, or embedded systems product development
  • History of working directly with contract manufacturers
  • Experience in a pre-sales or solutions engineering capacity
  • 3+ years in a consultancy or client services environment

Skills We Look For in Every Lead-Level Role

  • Communicates Effectively: Expert-level communication across audiences. Can negotiate for positive outcomes on projects of any complexity. Leans into hard conversations.
  • Owns the Room: Independently resets tone when engagements drift. Decisive, direct, and respectful when recommending a different path.
  • Builds Others Up: Teaches best practices; grows the capabilities of the team around them.
  • Estimates Well: Produces accurate scoping and SOW estimates. Uses experience to pressure-test team estimates.
  • Runs Agile Cleanly: Knows how to break work into tickets, sprints, and epics. Holds teams to rhythm without being bureaucratic.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Compensation: $108,750 – $131,250 CAD, commensurate with experience.
Variable Compensation: Up to 20% performance bonus in year one

Perks & Benefits:

  • 401(k) match
  • $150 - $200 /month cell phone + internet stipend (monthly amount based on level)
  • $600/year home office stipend
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid parental leave (95th percentile in the U.S.)
  • Professional development stipend
  • Loaned MacBook Pro
  • Annual team retreat

Why Work for Very

We do not promise an easy ride — we promise meaningful work.

We work hard because our clients’ success depends on it, and we take pride in delivering when others can’t. We collaborate closely, move fast, and stay grounded in results. We take joy in the process — in the problem-solving, the iteration, and the shared wins that come from doing the hard things well.

If you’re looking for a place where every project matters, where the standards are high, and where you’ll grow by pushing yourself and others — welcome to Very.

Interviewing for a new company is a serious time commitment for all parties involved. Please take the time to read this and thoughtfully consider if we would be a good fit for one another. No contractors or agencies. Seriously.

**Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside within the region posted.
**Note: This role requires the ability to travel within the US as needed for client engagements.

The opportunity is to make this proven motion significantly more effective — using AI and modern tooling as genuine force multipliers for a lean, three-person team, while continuously testing and improving how we reach, engage, and convert our market.

You will own the marketing budget, manage two direct reports (Marketing Senior Specialist and Graphic Designer), and maintain strong relationships with our PR and web agency partners.

What You'll Be Accountable For

Pipeline from Marketing Own top-of-funnel conversion and pipeline generation. Campaigns must be attributable to revenue, not just activity.

ABM & Demand Generation Design and run ABM programs for a defined, finite universe of accounts — enterprise hotel groups, brands, and technology providers. Partner closely with Sales to define priority accounts, buying committees, engagement signals, and coordinated account plays. The goal is not to rebuild a campaign each cycle; it's to build a system that learns and improves with each touch. That means using AI to automate research, personalize outreach, score engagement, and surface the next best action — so your team is iterating on what's working, not starting from scratch every quarter. Optimize for accounts that convert, not impressions.

AI-Search & Retrieval Visibility Hapi needs to show up inside the models and search interfaces that buyers now use to build shortlists. Own Hapi's discoverability in AI-generated search results (GEO), not just traditional SEO. This is a core responsibility, not a stretch goal.

Brand & Market Position Sharpen Hapi's positioning against a competitive hospitality-tech landscape. Own voice, visual identity, and narrative consistency. Translate complex data and connectivity concepts into messaging that resonates with hotel IT, loyalty, and marketing buyers.

Content Velocity Build a content operation where taste and distribution are the constraints — not production capacity. Each piece of content should build on what came before: reinforcing a narrative, extending a campaign, feeding a new channel. Use AI to accelerate drafting, repurposing, and personalization so the team is spending its time on judgment and distribution, not production. Own the strategy and the output.

PR Management Serve as Hapi's primary relationship owner with our PR agency. Set the communications strategy, define deliverables, and hold the agency accountable to share-of-pipeline outcomes — not coverage volume alone.

Event Strategy & Execution Own strategy and execution for HITEC, key industry conferences, and Hapi's proprietary events. Events are where our pipeline moves.

Partner & Channel Marketplace Own strategy for Hapi's B2B SaaS provider and technology marketplaces — positioning Hapi for inbound discovery and pipeline generation through channel partnerships.

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Partner with Product, Sales and Customer teams on product positioning, launches, sales enablement and go-to-market strategy. Translate technical capabilities into clear business value for hotel companies and technology partners.

What We're Looking For

Every candidate in 2026 will claim AI fluency. We're not asking if you use AI — we're asking you to explain a workflow you rebuilt: what it was before, what it is now, and what you shut down as a result.

Must-Haves

  • Director-level marketing leadership in B2B SaaS or technology, ideally within an enterprise or complex-sales environment.
  • Experience owning a marketing budget and making investment/trade-off decisions based on business impact.
  • Demand generation and ABM ownership with revenue attribution — not just campaign management
  • A concrete track record of building workflows with AI tools, with before/after metrics to show for it
  • Experience managing agency relationships as primary owner
  • Ability to own event strategy and execution — HITEC or comparable B2B industry events
  • Experience managing content strategy
  • Remote team management experience and strong cross-functional communication

Nice-to-Haves

  • Hospitality industry experience — Hapi's product is deeply industry-specific, and fluency in how hotels and hotel brands evaluate, buy, and implement technology meaningfully shortens the ramp
  • Experience in data, integration, or API connectivity products
  • Exposure to EU or APAC marketing expansion
  • Experience guiding a marketing function through a strategic growth milestone
  • Strong writer who works across technical and commercial audiences

The Team

Two direct reports: Marketing Senior Specialist and Graphic Designer. You'll also manage the day-to-day relationship with our PR and web agency partners. This is intentionally a lean team (no planned expansion through 2027), so the successful leader will be both strategic and hands-on, using agencies, technology and AI to extend the team's capacity.

jobs.excerpt: About ComPsychComPsychⓇ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe.
jobs.description:
About ComPsych

ComPsychⓇ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResourcesⓇ and AbsenceResourcesⓇ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.

About the Role

We're modernizing how ComPsych builds and ships applications — moving to the cloud, standardizing CI/CD, and giving our Software Engineering teams the ability to build, deploy, and own their products end to end. You'll be part of our CloudSecOps team, working alongside your peers there and across multiple application teams to bring consistent, high-quality CI/CD, infrastructure, and deployment practices to the products we ship.

We're looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer who already works this way and wants to help shape how our engineering organization delivers software. This is a high-leverage role: your time goes toward infrastructure design and technical direction across the teams you support, directing AI to build pipelines and automation and validating what it produces before it ships.

What You'll Do

AI changes what your time goes toward. You're still accountable for the full delivery lifecycle across the application teams you support — design, pipelines, security, and production — but your hands-on role in each shifts.

  • Own CI/CD and infrastructure design across the teams you support. Architecture, deployment strategy (blue/green, canary, feature flags), and the specs that direct AI-built pipelines, infrastructure code, and automation — coding yourself when it counts.
  • Decide what needs verification and prove it does the job. Pipeline tests, policy-as-code, and security gates are a design decision, not a default — you validate that they actually prove what they claim.
  • Build shared standards with the rest of CloudSecOps, not one-off fixes per team. Work with your CloudSecOps peers on the common patterns, tooling, and practices that make every team you support faster and safer, and contribute your own experience back into what the group builds.
  • Own application observability and unblock teams in production. Instrument the services you support, tie alerting to product SLOs, and help engineers across teams debug and resolve issues quickly when something breaks.
  • Keep judgment and accountability human. Reviews, deployment calls, on-call response, and what an incident teaches you stay yours, regardless of who or what wrote the code.
  • Raise the bar for how the teams you support work with AI, coaching engineers on specifying, delegating, and validating rather than treating DevOps as someone else's problem.

What We're Looking For

  • You already work this way. Agentic AI is your primary surface for planning and building CI/CD and infrastructure — you write specs it can execute against and catch what it gets subtly wrong, not just what fails a test.
  • You've built and operated production CI/CD and cloud infrastructure at real scale (AWS or Azure), including carrying on-call load, so you know what good looks like independent of who, or what, writes the code.
  • You treat testing, security, and observability as designed-in requirements, not something a separate function catches later. In a system that carries behavioral health data, “it works” and “it's safe” are the same bar.
  • You work effectively across multiple application teams and with your CloudSecOps peers, building practices that generalize rather than solving the same problem differently each time — judgment AI doesn't replace.
  • You have hands-on depth building application CI/CD and deployment automation: containers and Kubernetes for application workloads (Helm or similar), serverless functions, and one or more IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM) used in production, plus fluency in at least one modern language (for example, Python or Java).
  • You build security in, shift-left by default. SAST/DAST/SCA and secrets scanning in the pipeline, least-privilege IAM, and encryption in transit and at rest are the norm, built within the compliance frameworks we operate under, including HIPAA/HITRUST and SOC 2.

Pay Range

USD $150,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Full benefits package, including Paid Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, robust EAP, wellness program, and much more
  • The salary range for this position is $150,000 - $200,000 (USD). The base salary range represents the anticipated low end and high end of the range for this position. The actual compensation will be influenced by a wide range of factors including, but not limited to previous experience, education, pay market/geography, and scheduled hours.

Inbound Sales Performance Leader

Location: Remote.Candidates must be available during U.S. Pacific business hours and possess excellent spoken and written English.

Employment Type: Initial 90-Day Performance Engagement (Contract), with the opportunity to transition into a long-term role based on results.

Help Great Salespeople Become Elite

About TurFresh

TurFresh is the original and most established artificial turf cleaning and maintenance company, serving homeowners and businesses across multiple states.

For over 26 years, we’ve focused on creating cleaner, safer, more enjoyable outdoor spaces while building lasting customer relationships. Every interaction, from the first call to ongoing service, is designed to earn trust and deliver long-term value.

We continuously improve how we sell, coach, operate, and serve by embracing AI, testing new ideas, and holding ourselves accountable. We value curiosity and a commitment to getting better every week.

Through our TurfRescue initiative, we make regular donations to animal shelters and rescues, supporting the care of dogs and helping the organizations that protect and rehome them.

Our sales team isn’t broken.

They’re successful, highly coachable, and committed to continuous improvement. They voluntarily attend weekly training, embrace feedback, and actively seek coaching because they want to become exceptional at their craft.

We’re looking for someone who shares that mindset.

Your Mission

Improve our inbound sales team’s conversion rate.

Everything else, including coaching, accountability, role-playing, call reviews, AI insights, training reinforcement, and performance management, exists to accomplish that goal.

About the Opportunity

This role begins as an Initial 90-Day Performance Engagement because we believe leadership should be demonstrated through results, not resumes or titles.

At the end of the engagement, the question should be simple:

Did our sales team improve because you were here?

If the answer is yes, we’ll want to continue building together in a long-term leadership role.

Our Sales Model

    Our business is different from most home service companies.

    • Every customer begins as an inbound inquiry.

    • Customers have already expressed interest before speaking with our team.

    • Sales consultants educate, qualify, quote, and close customers entirely over the phone.

    • Field technicians verify measurements and perform the work. They do not sell.

    • Marketing generates demand. Sales converts demand.

    We are not trying to generate more leads.

    We are focused on converting more of the opportunities we already earn.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

    TurFresh has been in business for more than 26 years, but we don’t operate like a company that’s satisfied with the status quo.

    We’re constantly refining how we sell through AI, call analysis, operational feedback, experimentation, evolving sales playbooks, and continuous learning.

    You’ll join a company that already has a strong operating foundation, including:

    • AI-assisted call analysis

    • Weekly coaching reports

    • CRM dashboards

    • Sales scorecards

    • Standard operating procedures

    • Structured onboarding

    • Weekly sales workshops

    • KPI reporting

    We don’t expect you to arrive with a canned methodology.

    We expect you to learn our business quickly, contribute ideas, reinforce what works, challenge what doesn’t, and help us continuously improve how we coach and how we sell.

What You’ll Do

    You will:

    • Own the daily performance of our inbound sales team.

    • Coach sales consultants through structured one-on-one coaching.

    • Reinforce and expand on concepts taught during weekly sales workshops.

    • Review recorded sales conversations and AI-generated coaching insights.

    • Conduct role-play sessions using real customer scenarios.

    • Inspect execution to ensure coaching becomes a daily habit.

    • Hold salespeople accountable for consistently executing our sales methodology.

    • Improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, follow-up, and closing.

    • Accelerate new hire development.

    • Reduce sales-created operational issues through better qualification and documentation.

    • Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing, and Operations to improve the customer experience.

    • Identify opportunities to improve both individual performance and our overall sales process.

How You’ll Be Measured

    Success is measured by results, not activity.

    Primary KPI

    • Team Conversion Rate

    Supporting KPIs

    • Revenue per Quote

    • Maintenance Plan Attachment Rate

    • Sales-Created Operational Errors

    • New Hire Ramp Time

    • CRM Hygiene

    • Sales Quality and Consistency

Who Will Thrive Here

    This role is for someone who enjoys owning performance.

    You believe great coaching includes reinforcement, inspection, accountability, and follow-through, not just delivering advice.

    You know how to earn the respect of talented salespeople while challenging them to continually improve.

    You’re comfortable having difficult conversations, coaching through resistance, and ensuring that training becomes consistent execution.

    You thrive in organizations that are constantly learning, testing, and improving.

    Most importantly, you measure your success by one thing:

    The measurable improvement of the people you lead.

Experience We’re Looking For

    We’re far more interested in how you’ve improved sales performance than where you’ve worked.

    The ideal candidate has successfully improved the performance of an inbound sales team by coaching better customer conversations, reinforcing consistent execution, and holding people accountable for improvement.

    You should have experience:

    • Improving conversion rates through coaching and accountability.

    • Reviewing recorded sales calls and identifying coaching opportunities.

    • Conducting one-on-one coaching and structured role-playing.

    • Reinforcing training through consistent follow-up.

    • Using CRM data, call recordings, and performance metrics to prioritize coaching.

    • Helping salespeople consistently execute a defined sales process.

    • Working in an environment where inbound customer conversations, rather than outbound prospecting, drive revenue.

    Experience selling to residential consumers is preferred. More importantly, we’re looking for someone who can quickly learn our business, earn the team’s trust, and measurably improve performance.

What Success Looks Like After 90 Days

    By the end of the engagement, we expect you to have:

    • Earned the trust and respect of the sales team.

    • Established a consistent coaching and accountability cadence.

    • Reinforced our training through daily execution.

    • Improved individual sales behaviors.

    • Begun producing measurable improvements in conversion and overall sales quality.

    • Contributed ideas that strengthen our evolving sales process.

    If you’ve helped our salespeople improve, and the results demonstrate that impact, we’ll be excited to discuss a permanent leadership opportunity.

Our Hiring Process

    We believe performance leaders should demonstrate their ability to improve people, not simply talk about it.

    Our process includes:

    • Recruiter interview

    • Practical coaching exercise using real sales conversations

    • Live coaching simulation

    • Leadership interview

    • Possible paid working session with our sales team

If you’re excited by the opportunity to help great salespeople become elite, and you can prove it, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Principal Environment Artist/ Lead

Location: Remote, UK OR Hybrid Lisbon, EU
Reporting to: Director of Art

Salary: £45k - £70k per annum/ €53,295 – € 82,748 per annum

Contract: Full time, 6 Month FTC (with possibility to move to permanent)

Company Overview

At Lockwood, our vision is to bring people together through Avakin Life, where players can play, share, and socialize in one of the world's largest and most populous metaverses. Avakin Life provides an immersive 3D life simulation experience for millions of users worldwide.

With a focus on innovation and collaboration, Lockwood offers a flexible and creative environment that empowers our teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible. We provide competitive benefits, including an employee share scheme, making Lockwood an exciting destination for those passionate about shaping the future of digital experiences. This position is available as a fully remote role, though there may be occasional meetups for social interaction and strategic sessions.

Role Summary

As a Principal Environment Artist, you will be responsible for defining and delivering world-class, immersive environments for Avakin Life, while driving artistic quality, technical excellence, and innovation across the environment art discipline. You will lead by example through hands-on creation, mentoring, production planning, and the adoption of AI-assisted workflows. Working closely with Art Direction, Experience Design, Technical Art, and Production, you will help shape the visual identity of the game while improving team workflows, scalability, and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Environment Art & Visual Development

  • Translate creative briefs into compelling AI-generated visual concepts, enriching the original vision with innovative ideas while remaining aligned to the creative direction.
  • Transform briefs, concepts, mood boards, concept art, and AI-generated visual explorations into polished, production-ready 3D environments that support gameplay, narrative, and player experience.
  • Create visually stunning and immersive environments for Avakin Life, including interiors, exteriors, landmarks, and interactive spaces.
  • Produce high-quality hard surface and organic 3D assets that meet both artistic and technical standards.
  • Design and create high-quality textures and materials that achieve a cohesive visual style while remaining optimised for mobile platforms.
  • Deliver lighting, simple environment animation, and VFX that enhance mood, atmosphere, and player immersion.
  • Optimise environments and assets to achieve excellent performance across supported mobile devices without compromising visual quality.
  • Maintain and improve the quality of existing environments through bug fixing, optimisation, and continuous polish.

AI Innovation & Workflow Development

  • Champion the integration of AI-assisted workflows across the environment art pipeline, leveraging both proprietary internal tools and external AI technologies.
  • Utilise AI tools for ideation, concept generation, image enhancement, texture creation, material generation, lighting exploration, and 3D asset generation to improve production efficiency.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to enhance quality, speed, and creative exploration.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of internal AI pipelines, implementation standards, and best practices.
  • Promote responsible and effective AI adoption across the art team through documentation, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior creative leader within the Environment Art team, setting quality benchmarks and driving artistic excellence.
  • Under the guidance of the Art Director, lead environment ideation sessions, visual exploration, and workflow planning in collaboration with Experience Designers.
  • Mentor Environment Artists and Prop Artists through regular feedback, technical guidance, workflow coaching, and AI knowledge sharing.
  • Review environment and prop assets, providing constructive feedback to maintain consistent quality across the team.
  • Present work to the Art Director, interpret feedback, and guide the team through implementation.
  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Technical Artists, Engineers, Producers, and QA to ensure environments support gameplay, technical requirements, and production goals.
  • Work effectively with external outsourcing partners by preparing clear briefs, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring outsourced work meets project quality standards.

Production & Delivery

  • Support planning and oversight of environment and prop production, helping artists overcome blockers and ensuring timely delivery.
  • Break down complex environment tasks into achievable work packages, providing accurate effort estimates and identifying dependencies.
  • Prioritise environment work in alignment with production milestones and project objectives.
  • Adapt priorities effectively as project scope evolves.
  • Provide accurate reporting on progress, risks, blockers, and delivery status to Leads, Art Directors, and Production.
  • Contribute actively to creative discussions, planning meetings, and production reviews.

Quality & Testing

  • Deliver high-quality, bug-free assets ready for production.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and artistic issues throughout production.
  • Apply strong quality control practices to minimise defects and improve asset stability

Requirements

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Expert knowledge of 3D environment creation, including both hard surface and organic modelling.
  • Strong understanding of colour theory, composition, lighting, scale, and environmental storytelling.
  • Excellent low-poly modelling and topology optimisation skills.
  • Advanced UV mapping and texture creation experience.
  • Strong understanding of mobile optimisation techniques.
  • Experience creating lighting setups within Unity.
  • Ability to create simple environment animations and visual effects.
  • Experience using AI tools for image generation, concept exploration, texture creation, material generation, and 3D asset generation.
  • Comfortable working with proprietary tools, scripts, shaders, and internal production pipelines.
  • Ability to work effectively from briefs, mood boards, concept art, or AI-generated visual references.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to consistently meet production deadlines.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Proven ability to lead environment ideation and visual development from concept through production.
  • Experience mentoring artists and helping develop team capability.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence presenting work to Art Directors and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide constructive art reviews and maintain consistent quality standards.
  • Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams including Design, Technical Art, Engineering, Production, and QA.
  • Experience managing relationships with external outsourcing vendors.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance artistic ambition against technical constraints.
  • Passion for sharing knowledge, improving workflows, and driving continuous innovation across the team.

Production & Planning

  • Experience planning and overseeing environment and prop production.
  • Ability to estimate task complexity, effort, and production timelines accurately.
  • Strong understanding of game development production pipelines and milestone planning.
  • Comfortable reprioritising work as project requirements evolve.
  • Ability to communicate progress, blockers, dependencies, and risks clearly to stakeholders.

Quality Assurance

  • Strong understanding of asset validation, testing, and bug prevention.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical issues efficiently.
  • Commitment to delivering polished, production-ready content that meets both artistic and technical quality standards.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience shipping live service or mobile games.
  • Experience working on stylised game environments.
  • Experience developing or improving AI-assisted art pipelines.
  • Knowledge of procedural content generation tools and workflows.
  • Familiarity with performance profiling and optimisation techniques for Unity.
  • Experience contributing to studio-wide art standards, documentation, and best practices.

*Please note our initial CV screening may be completed with support from AI

Benefits

At Lockwood, you’ll be part of an inclusive, creative, and highly motivated team. You’ll work on systems used by millions of players, shaping the live game experience and ensuring we can deliver new content and events rapidly and reliably. This is your opportunity to make a real impact—not just on our games, but on the future of how we operate. 

  • Private Healthcare Plan
  • Pension Plan
  • Life Assurance
  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development
  • Employee Assistance Programme

*benefits will depend on location and local legislation

jobs.excerpt: Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming backCommunity Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses.
jobs.description:
Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming back

Community Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses. We are looking for someone who combines strong email and SMS marketing skills with sales follow-through and organized day-to-day coordination.

Your work will connect three things: campaigns that generate interest, conversations that turn interest into bookings, and pickup games that run smoothly enough for people to return. You will help sell available sports facility time and permit-backed bookings, support pickup-game operations remotely, and build email and SMS campaigns that increase participation and repeat business.

What you will own

Email and SMS marketing

• Plan, write, build and send campaigns promoting available facility time, pickup games, registration opportunities and relevant offers.

• Create useful segments by location, sport, expressed interest, booking history and engagement.

• Build and improve welcome messages, lead follow-up, incomplete-booking recovery where supported, reminders, repeat-booking and win-back flows.

• Write clear English copy with specific offers and calls to action. Adapt existing brand assets into mobile-friendly emails.

• Check audiences, dates, time zones, prices, links, personalization and suppression rules before launch.

• Monitor delivery failures, bounces, complaints and opt-outs; maintain consent records and healthy lists.

• Test messaging, timing, offers and journeys, then report qualified enquiries, paid bookings, repeat participation and revenue alongside engagement metrics.

Permit and facility-time sales

• Maintain an accurate view of available locations, dates, time slots, capacity and approved pricing.

• Respond to enquiries from teams, coaches, leagues, organizers and other customers looking for sports space.

• Understand what customers need, recommend suitable availability, prepare approved quotes and follow up through booking and payment confirmation.

• Keep the sales pipeline current, document customer commitments and pursue renewals or repeat bookings.

• Coordinate with the operations team before promising availability or exceptions. Escalate pricing, terms and conflicts outside your authority.

Pickup-game coordination

• Create and maintain accurate game listings, including location, start time, capacity, pricing and player instructions.

• Monitor registrations and fill levels; use targeted outreach to help fill available places.

• Coordinate with local hosts and venue contacts, making sure each game has the information and support it needs.

• Manage routine player questions and waitlists, and communicate approved changes promptly.

• Identify low-enrolment games, host gaps or venue problems early and escalate cancellation, refund or safety decisions to the appropriate manager.

• Track attendance, feedback and repeat participation, and use what you learn to improve future games.

This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome. Please apply once using your preferred location listing.

Requirements

What we are looking for

• Practical experience building email campaigns and automations, plus hands-on SMS experience.

• Strong written and spoken English for North American customer conversations.

• Confidence following up with leads, explaining an offer and asking for the booking.

• Strong attention to detail with schedules, prices, customer records and competing deadlines.

• Experience with a CRM and an email/SMS platform; examples include Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Mailchimp or comparable tools. Experience with every platform is not required.

• Comfort using spreadsheets and reports to understand conversion, bookings and campaign performance.

• Dependable communication and willingness to own the next action until an issue is resolved.

• Availability to work evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time is required. This is when most games and customer activity take place, so these shifts are a core part of the role. The specific weekly schedule will be agreed before hiring.

Experience in sports, venue bookings, inside sales, event coordination, customer service or ecommerce retention is helpful. You should enjoy both campaign execution and customer follow-through.

What success looks like

In the first month, learn the inventory, customer journeys and operating processes; audit existing campaigns and establish a reliable follow-up and QA routine.

Over the following two months, take ownership of the campaign calendar and sales pipeline, improve priority automations, and make pickup-game coordination dependable. We will agree measurable goals for paid bookings, use of available facility time, game fill rates, repeat participation and service quality after reviewing the baseline.

Apply with your resume and answer the questions in this application. Remove customer data and confidential employer information from examples. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome; the selected location is a recruitment location, not a residence requirement.

Required assessments

Please complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners with that email, indicate this in the application.

  • Culture Index survey
  • Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits

Remote from Latin America. Monthly base of US$800–US$1,000 based on experience, plus expected variable commissions of US$500–US$1,000. Expected total US$1,300–US$2,000 per month. Commissions depend on performance and are not guaranteed. Evening and weekend work in Toronto/Eastern time is required, when most games and customer activity take place. The specific weekly schedule and commission terms will be agreed before hiring.

jobs.title: Media Buyer for a U.S. Relationship Coaching Brand
jobs.excerpt: Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent.
jobs.description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to gifted people, regardless of location.

About the Client

Our client helps high-achieving men rebuild their lives from the inside out, marriage, family, identity, and purpose.

They have an established content engine and a large existing audience across social platforms, with hundreds of long-form videos and a deep library of short-form content, client testimonials, VSLs, and organic content continually being produced and tested. They’re looking for a Meta Media Buyer who can turn that creative engine into predictable, scalable customer acquisition.

About the Role

Paid acquisition is a major growth channel for our client, and we need a dedicated owner of our Meta advertising.

This is not a general digital marketing position, and it is not a role for someone who simply launches campaigns and checks Ads Manager once a day. You will own Meta campaign execution and optimization end to end: campaign structure,

budgets, testing, creative performance, audiences, tracking, lead quality, and scaling. You’ll work closely with our organic and creative teams. When content breaks out organically, you should know how to test it as paid creative. When an ad works, you should understand why it works and be able to tell the creative team what we need more of. Ultimately, your job is not to generate cheap clicks or leads. Your job is to help us acquire qualified prospects and customers at economics that allow us to scale.

Responsibilities

1. Meta Campaign Management

  • Own day-to-day execution across Facebook and Instagram advertising through Meta Ads Manager.
  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across the customer acquisition funnel.
  • Manage campaign structure, budgets, bidding, audiences, placements, optimization events, and spend allocation.
  • Monitor account performance consistently and make informed adjustments rather than allowing declining campaigns to run unchecked.
  • Maintain clean campaign structures and naming conventions so the account remains organized, understandable, and scalable.

2. Performance & Budget Optimization

  • Own the numbers behind paid acquisition.
  • Monitor and analyze the metrics that matter, including CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, cost per booked call, CAC, conversion rates, lead quality, spend, and revenue performance.
  • Understand where performance is breaking down. A rising CAC does not automatically mean the audience is the problem, and a low CPL does not automatically mean the campaign is successful.
  • Follow the lead beyond Meta. Work with our sales team to understand whether campaigns are generating qualified applications, booked calls, show-ups, and customers — not simply form submissions.
  • Identify where additional budget can be deployed profitably and where spend needs to be reduced or redirected.

3. Creative Testing & Analysis

  • Develop and maintain a structured testing system for hooks, angles, messaging, formats, offers, CTAs, and creative concepts.
  • Analyze creative performance and identify patterns across winning and losing ads.
  • Be able to explain more than “this ad has the lowest CPL.” We want someone who can identify why an angle is resonating, which hooks are producing qualified prospects, what is losing effectiveness, and what should be created next.
  • Give the creative team specific, actionable briefs and feedback based on performance data.
  • Work closely with our Social Media Manager to identify organic winners that should be tested as paid creative, including reusing organic post IDs where appropriate to carry existing social proof.

4. Testing & Scaling

  • Build a disciplined testing process rather than making random changes inside the ad account.
  • Know how to determine whether a test has enough data to make a decision and distinguish meaningful performance changes from normal fluctuations.
  • Identify winners, iterate on them, and scale them intelligently.
  • Know when to increase spend, when to consolidate, when to introduce new creative, when to let a campaign stabilize, and when something genuinely needs intervention.
  • Balance growth with efficiency. We don’t want someone afraid to spend money when the economics support scaling — or someone who increases budgets simply because Meta is reporting good numbers.

5. Tracking & Attribution

  • Ensure Meta Pixel, Conversions API, conversion events, UTMs, landing-page tracking, and relevant CRM attribution are functioning correctly.
  • Identify tracking discrepancies and work with the appropriate team members to resolve them.
  • Understand the limitations of platform attribution and use available business data to develop a more complete picture of campaign performance.
  • Paid acquisition doesn’t end when someone submits a lead form. You should be able to connect ad → lead → appointment → sales outcome → customer acquisition cost.

6. Reporting & Communication

  • Own clear and consistent reporting on paid acquisition performance.
  • Communicate what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what you’re doing next.
  • Report on spend, lead volume, CPL, qualified leads, booked calls, CAC, creative performance, testing results, and relevant funnel metrics.
  • Flag meaningful performance changes quickly rather than waiting for someone else to notice them.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).
  • Strong proficiency with Meta Ads Manager.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and scaling meaningful paid advertising budgets.
  • Strong understanding of direct-response and performance marketing.
  • Experience with lead-generation and conversion-focused campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of campaign structure, audiences, bidding, budgeting, optimization, and scaling.
  • Strong creative analysis and ad-testing skills.
  • Ability to interpret advertising and funnel data and translate it into specific actions.
  • Understanding of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, conversion events, UTMs, and attribution.
  • Ability to evaluate performance beyond platform metrics and connect advertising results to downstream sales outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and proactively identify and solve performance problems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with high-ticket coaching, education, personal development, mental health/fitness, or information-product businesses.
  • Experience working with a setter/closer sales model and understanding what happens to paid leads after they enter a CRM.
  • Experience with application, booked-call, VSL, or similar high-ticket acquisition funnels.
  • Experience working with founder-led or personality-driven brands.
  • Experience turning organic content into successful paid creative.
  • Strong understanding of CRM attribution and the connection between ad-platform data and actual sales outcomes.

What We’d Like to See From Candidates

We’re much more interested in proof of work than media-buying buzzwords.

Be prepared to show accounts or case studies you’ve personally managed and explain your role in the results.

We want to understand the monthly Meta spend you’ve personally managed, the type of business and offer you advertised, your CPL/CAC or other relevant acquisition results, how you approached creative testing, what you successfully scaled, and an example of a campaign that stopped performing and how you diagnosed it.

You should be able to explain your decision-making, not simply show us a screenshot of a successful Ads Manager dashboard.

Out of Scope for This Role

This is specifically a Meta Media Buyer position.

You are not responsible for organic social media management, community management,

email/newsletter marketing, or managing Google, YouTube, TikTok, or other paid advertising platforms.

Our Social Media Manager owns organic social end to end and influences paid creative but does not run the ad accounts.

This role also provides enterprise-wide oversight for workforce planning and program growth, partnering with market operators and executive leadership to ensure outstanding clinical outcomes, member satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

  • Collaborate with market operational and clinical leaders to address performance variation, develop market-specific improvement plans, and drive consistent execution of enterprise cardiology priorities.

  • Oversee ambulatory cardiac monitoring workflows and EMR/PACS integration to support reliable operations and end-user adoption across cardiology systems.
  • Cultivate relationships with community providers, strategic partners, and market stakeholders to strengthen referral pathways, program visibility, and service line growth.
  • Provide leadership, operational expertise, and project oversight for organizational performance improvement initiatives and other enterprise operational priorities as assigned.

Reporting Relationship / Span of Control:

This role provides routine updates on service line performance, access, quality, growth initiatives, and operational barriers. Span of control includes direct leadership of cardiology service line resources and indirect influence across market-based operational, clinical, and support teams involved in cardiology care delivery. The role is expected to maintain a regular operating cadence with Regional Ops SVPs and Sr MMDs to review results, address performance gaps, coordinate market readiness, and ensure consistent execution of enterprise cardiology priorities.

  • Track record of building high-performing teams and developing leaders across clinical and operational functions.

  • Customer-service orientation with a strong focus on member experience, quality outcomes, and care excellence.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize operational, financial, and clinical data to identify opportunities, develop solutions, and drive measurable performance improvement across multiple markets.
  • Strong understanding of value-based care principles, healthcare utilization management, and strategies that improve quality while reducing unnecessary cost of care.

Experience in cardiology, cardiovascular services, or related clinical operations preferred but not required.

Product

This role will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of solutions that enable healthcare brands to deliver highly targeted, omnichannel engagement with healthcare providers (HCPs) and consumers, powered by IQVIA’s proprietary data and analytics.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of data, analytics, and marketing technology—responsible for translating complex healthcare datasets and behavioral signals into scalable, client-facing products that drive measurable engagement and business outcomes.

Product Strategy & Roadmap

    o Behavioral intelligence and engagement platforms (e.g., activity and content consumption insights)
    o HCP data and profiling solutions (e.g., multi-attribute segmentation and targeting)
    o Audience products (intent-based, predictive, and modeled audiences)

    • Deliver capabilities that enable right message, right channel, right time engagement across digital touchpoints.

Data & Analytics Innovation

• Drive development of:

o Identity resolution and audience building capabilities
o Predictive models and intent signals
o Real-time or near-real-time engagement triggers
• Work closely with data science teams to operationalize advanced analytics into market-ready offerings.

Customer-Centric Product Development

o Validate product-market fit

o Gather requirements and prioritize features
o Ensure products deliver measurable marketing impact
• Incorporate feedback loops into roadmap decisions and product evolution.

Commercial Performance

    • Track performance against product KPIs such as usage, revenue contribution, and client outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Drive alignment across stakeholders in a matrixed organization.
    • Ensure products meet privacy, compliance, and consent standards critical to healthcare data usage.

8–12+ years in product management, with experience delivering data-driven or platform-based products

Background in one or more of:

o Marketing technology (martech/adtech)

o Data and analytics platforms

o Healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries (strongly preferred)

Experience working with:

o Audience segmentation and targeting products
o Behavioral data or digital engagement signals
o AI/ML or predictive modeling (practical application vs theory)

    • Ability to translate complex data and technical concepts into clear product value propositions

Preferred

Personalization is a core driver of modern healthcare engagement. IQVIA Digital’s Personalization Science platform connects data, analytics, and activation to enable more relevant, human-centered interactions across the care continuum.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Search Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About CardiffCardiff lends to small businesses.  Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between.
jobs.description:
About Cardiff

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

The role

Search is Cardiff's highest-intent channel and our most contested one. When an operator with a payroll problem types "business loan same day" into his phone, we are bidding against OnDeck, Fundbox, Bluevine and a long tail of brokers for a click that will cost us real money and may be worth a $150,000 funded deal. You own that auction.

Scope and budget

This role owns roughly a third of Cardiff's total paid media, about $700K–$1M a month today, on Google Ads, with an explicit mandate to grow it. Microsoft Ads is expected to come under this role as well, and as we expand into additional search and intent-based platforms, they will land here too. While structured as an individual contributor without direct reports, this position holds complete accountability for our search strategy, total media spend, and channel-level performance.

What you will own

  • Own the account end to end. Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen and YouTube structure, budgets, bid strategies, geo and device modifiers, the full build. You are the person who knows why the account looks the way it does.
  • Run the keyword and search term program. Brand versus non-brand economics, competitor conquesting, aggressive negative keyword hygiene, and match type strategy in a category where a single loose broad match term can burn a week of budget on "personal loans no credit check."
  • Close the loop to funded revenue. Own offline conversion imports from Salesforce back into Google so Smart Bidding optimizes toward funded deals rather than applications. Diagnose and fix attribution gaps, a meaningful share of our qualified leads have historically arrived without clean campaign attribution, and shrinking that number is explicitly part of this role.
  • Make PMax earn its place. Asset group strategy, audience signals, search theme control, and the reporting work required to see inside a black box. If PMax is cannibalizing brand search, we expect you to prove it and act.
  • Own Microsoft Ads as a real second channel. Bing skews older and higher-income than Google, which maps unusually well to a 45-year-old business owner. We run it lightly today. You will own building it out properly, import discipline, independent budget and bid strategy, and its own read on fund rate rather than a copy-paste of the Google account.
  • Grow the search portfolio. You are accountable for scaling search spend against aggressive growth targets while protecting cost per MQL and fund rate. That means knowing where the next $200K a month can actually go - incremental query space, new campaign types, new platforms - and being honest about where it cannot.
  • Evaluate and launch new search and intent platforms. As paid search fragments - retail and marketplace search, AI answer-engine placements, comparison and aggregator inventory - you will be the person who tests them, sizes them, and either builds or kills them. New intent-based channels land in this role.
  • Drive landing page strategy with the web team. Pre-filled URLs measurably out-perform generic entry points on our site. Take that further: pre-filled ad landing pages, keyword-matched apply experiences, and a mobile apply flow with fewer questions between click and answer.
  • Build the Spanish-language search program. Not translated ad copy — a real parallel account structure with keyword research done in Spanish, matched landing pages, and its own performance targets across TX, CA, FL and AZ.
  • Partner with SEO. Our organic small business loans content is a top traffic source. Coordinates so paid and organic are not bidding against each other or duplicating each other's ground.
  • Report in the language of the business. Weekly and monthly reporting on spend, cost per MQL, MQL rate, MQL-to-fund and ROI — with a point of view about what to do next, not just a table.

What we are looking for - Search-specific

In addition to the baseline qualifications listed on page one:

  • 3–5 years managing Google Ads directly, including hands-on Performance Max and large-scale Search accounts.
  • You have personally managed $500K to $1M + a month in paid search spend, or a comparable annual figure, and you have grown a budget at that scale rather than inheriting and holding it.
  • Demonstrated experience with offline conversion imports or an equivalent server-side conversion setup, this is close to a hard requirement.
  • Strong command of Google Ads Editor, scripts or the API for bulk work; you should not be making 400 changes in the UI.
  • Comfortable defending a decision to pause a campaign that looks profitable on last-click.
  • Google Ads certification is fine; a rebuilt account structure and a spend curve you can walk us through are better.

Nice to have

  • Microsoft Ads (Bing) management experience, a significant advantage, since this channel is coming under the role either way.
  • Experience standing up a brand-new paid channel from zero to meaningful spend.
  • Experience with a paid search program in a regulated or lending category.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, GTM and a warehouse-based reporting stack.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • Full account audit with a prioritized list of what is wasting money and what is under-funded.
  • Offline conversion import path verified end to end, with fund-rate reporting by campaign.
  • Negative keyword and search term hygiene brought current, with a standing weekly cadence.
  • A tested Spanish-language search pilot live in at least two states.
  • A recommendation, build, hold or fold, on Microsoft Ads, with the numbers behind it.

Compensation and perks

  • Base pay range: $95,000 - $130,000
  • Annual performance bonus of up to 15%
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans.
  • 401(k) retirement savings program.
  • Flexible vacation policy alongside standard company holidays.
  • Fully distributed workplace, complete with stipend funding for workspace essentials.

Cardiff operates as an equal opportunity employer. We prioritize constructing an inclusive workplace, extending equal consideration without regard to protected attributes including race, belief, gender identity, age, or veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAIM is seeking a commercially minded Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant who can connect business needs with technology, lead compelling customer conversations, and turn opportunities into clearly defined projects.
jobs.description:
About the Role

AIM is seeking a commercially minded Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant who can connect business needs with technology, lead compelling customer conversations, and turn opportunities into clearly defined projects.

This role combines business discovery, functional solution design, project scoping, presales, demonstrations, and marketing support. You will work closely with our sales, delivery, and marketing teams to help customers understand the value of Dynamics 365 and establish a practical path to implementation.

The ideal candidate brings experience across ERP and CRM, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one core Dynamics 365 area and the ability to shape solutions across interconnected business processes.

Exceptional presentation and communication skills are a critical success factor. You must be able to engage executives, facilitate productive workshops, explain complex concepts clearly, and deliver persuasive demonstrations grounded in customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

Business Discovery and Solution Design

  • Lead discovery workshops with executives, business leaders, and operational teams.
  • Understand customer objectives, business processes, pain points, existing systems, and reporting requirements.
  • Translate requirements into future-state processes and recommended Dynamics 365 capabilities.
  • Conduct fit-gap assessments, prioritizing standard functionality and identifying justified extensions or integrations.
  • Define phased implementation roadmaps with clear outcomes, priorities, and dependencies.
  • Collaborate with specialists and technical architects to validate cross-application, integration, security, and data migration requirements.

Project Scoping and Estimation

  • Develop statements of work covering deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, customer responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Break projects into workstreams and estimate functional effort, collaborating with technical and delivery leads to validate the overall plan.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and factors that could affect cost or timelines.
  • Recommend implementation phases that balance business value, budget, and delivery capacity.
  • Ensure a complete handover from sales to delivery, maintaining alignment between customer expectations and project commitments.

Presales, Presentations, and Demonstrations

  • Partner with sales to qualify opportunities and assess customer needs and solution fit.
  • Lead executive presentations that connect Dynamics 365 capabilities to business priorities.
  • Build and deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting the customer’s industry, processes, and challenges.
  • Use clear storytelling to explain how a solution improves day-to-day work and business performance.
  • Respond confidently to questions, manage objections, and communicate tradeoffs honestly.
  • Clearly distinguish standard functionality from configurations, integrations, and custom development.
  • Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, executive presentations, and customer workshops.
  • Maintain reusable demonstration environments, scripts, and business scenarios.
  • Support licensing discussions alongside licensing specialists.

Marketing and Practice Development

  • Collaborate with marketing to create solution one-pagers, presentations, webinars, demo videos, and campaign content.
  • Translate technical capabilities into compelling business use cases and customer outcomes.
  • Present at customer events, partner sessions, and webinars.
  • Help develop repeatable assessments, implementation packages, and industry-specific offerings.
  • Bring customer insights and recurring requirements into AIM’s service development process.

Delivery Collaboration

  • Support functional design, configuration, testing, training, and adoption where required.
  • Maintain continuity between the proposed solution and implementation.
  • Help resolve functional questions and assess change requests during delivery.
  • Mentor junior consultants and improve discovery, documentation, and demonstration standards.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Typically 5+ years of Dynamics 365 functional consulting experience, including multiple completed implementations.
  • Ideally, experience across both ERP and CRM, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one core area:
    • ERP: Business Central or Finance and Supply Chain Management.
    • CRM and service applications: Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, or Project Operations.
  • Ability to lead discovery across interconnected business processes, scope cross-application solutions, and engage specialists where deeper expertise is required.
  • Demonstrated experience leading discovery workshops, fit-gap assessments, tailored demonstrations, and project scoping.
  • Strong understanding of business processes within the candidate’s primary area of expertise.
  • Experience producing clear requirements, process maps, functional designs, proposals, and statements of work.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform and the role of automation, analytics, and integrations within Dynamics 365 solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with sales, technical, delivery, and marketing teams.

Critical Success Factor: Presentation and Communication

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

  • Executive presence: Confidence and credibility when engaging senior decision-makers.
  • Clear communication: Ability to explain complex business and technology concepts in accessible language.
  • Compelling demonstrations: Ability to tell a coherent story through customer-specific workflows and outcomes.
  • Strong facilitation: Ability to ask thoughtful questions, listen actively, manage discussions, and build alignment.
  • Persuasive business writing: Ability to produce clear proposals, scopes of work, presentations, and marketing content.
  • Audience awareness: Ability to adapt the level of detail and message for executives, business users, and technical teams.
  • Commercial judgment: Ability to communicate value, address objections, and set realistic expectations.

Candidates should be prepared to deliver a short solution presentation or demonstration and discuss how they would scope a customer opportunity as part of the interview process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within a Microsoft partner or consulting organization.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications.
  • Experience with legacy ERP or CRM migrations.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, and agent-based business scenarios.
  • Experience developing packaged services, industry solutions, or marketing content.
  • Background in finance, accounting, supply chain, professional services, or customer operations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers understand the proposed solution, its business value, and the implementation approach.
  • Presentations and demonstrations build confidence and advance qualified opportunities.
  • Scopes of work contain realistic estimates, clear assumptions, and achievable commitments.
  • Delivery teams receive complete, actionable handovers.
  • Sales and marketing gain reusable assets that strengthen customer engagement.
  • AIM develops a more repeatable and scalable Dynamics 365 practice.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You combine functional expertise, commercial judgment, and outstanding communication. You can move confidently from an executive conversation to a detailed process workshop, then translate what you have learned into a compelling demonstration and a well-defined project scope. You take ownership and understand the delivery implications of the commitments you make.
